title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About

We’re building Nomina: a platform allowing power users to access onchain markets and run sophisticated trading strategies in a single interface. We’re looking for early team members to help us bring this ambitious vision to life.
We’re a team who already built a platform that processed over $70M leading to our $18M fundraise from top investors including Pantera, Two Sigma Ventures, Coinbase Ventures alongside angel investors including Stani Kulechov (founder of Aave), Sandeep Nailwal (cofounder of Polygon) and more.

We are growing rapidly and we need ambitious and experienced team members to join us to help scale crypto's future.

About the Role

Establish world-class product discovery practices while identifying and dominating our first niche in the onchain trading ecosystem, setting the foundation for our vision to become the go-to terminal of the onchain economy.

Outcomes

  1. Month 1
    1. Implement structured user research process and complete 20+ user interviews.
    2. Work with CEO to aggregate user interview feedback and prioritize development.
    3. Work with CTO to turn user feedback into concrete engineering plans.
  2. Month 2:
    1. First experiments live with measurable success criteria.
    2. Running user interviews reverse-shadowed by CEO.
    3. Running engineering standups, planning, retros, and prioritizing engineering work with CTO oversight.
  3. Month 3:
    1. Build-measure-learn loops are in full swing, iterating on the product quickly in response to constant user feedback.
    2. Fully owning user research conversations.
    3. Fully owning engineering planning and prioritization.

What Success Looks Like

  • You're talking to users daily and shipping improvements weekly
  • Engineers come to you excited about user insights
  • We have a clear thesis on our first niche within 90 days

Requirements

  • 5+ years of PM experience with at least 2 years in product discovery/0-to-1
  • Strong working knowledge of financial products (spot, futures, yield, options, perps). Must be able to reason about how these products work, their mechanics, and what traders care about. Experience as a trader, quant, analyst, or having built in this domain is a plus
  • Track record of finding PMF in ambiguous spaces
  • Excellence at user research and synthesis
  • Located in US or Europe
  • Able to quickly and efficiently convert user research into actionable engineering work

Competencies

  • Customer centric orientation — actively thinks about how to improve the user experience of trading on Nomina
  • User research mastery – design and execute user research, build lasting relationships with users, transform qualitative insights into quantitative experiments
  • Detail oriented – every pixel matters. Ensure the user experience is perfect
  • Autonomous — specifically seeks to take greater ownership and responsibility and thrives in their personal growth by doing so
  • Action oriented — we are looking for people who take action by default, consistently driving forward progress without asking for permission
  • Highly intelligent — learns quickly and can participate in abstract intellectually engaging conversations
  • Effective communicator — clearly articulates ideas and engages in debates in a productive manner that leads us to making better decisions

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with trading platforms or financial products
  • Familiarity with crypto/DeFi (can be learned if you're sharp)
  • Technical background (helpful but not required)

Benefits

Our benefits include competitive compensation, token packages for all employees, regular team off-sites around the world and unlimited PTO. In addition, you'll join a team of high-caliber people innovating at the frontier of crypto that work collaboratively to help one another accelerate their personal growth.


Values

We are a mission driven company. We believe deeply that through software engineering we can build a self-sovereign society. In our day to day, we make decisions based upon our company values and operating principles:

Company values

  • Customer centricity
  • Long-term orientation
  • Courage

Operating principles

  • High-trust & autonomy
  • Kindness & respect
  • Collaboration
  • Humility & low-ego
  • Transparency
  • Data driven
  • Precise communication
  • Results oriented
  • “Kerplunk”: clean handoffs and acknowledgement of ownership between team members
The future belongs to all of us, independent of our origins. Nomina is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sexual orientation, gender or any other status protected under federal, state or local law.

title: Outpatient Mental HealthTherapist (CA/WA Full-Time/Part-Time)
description:
About Nolia Health:

Founded in Seattle, Washington, Nolia is a healthcare company dedicated to providing personalized, clinically-supported, and virtual-first services for older adults and their family caregivers or care partners. We understand that chronic and serious illnesses related to aging impact not only those diagnosed but also those who care for them. Nolia’s mission is to elevate family caregiving as a central component of healthcare. Our goal is to transform the way caregiving is perceived and valued, ensuring that family caregivers have the resources, knowledge, and support they need so no one has to navigate this journey alone.

Our Vision, Mission and Values are very important to us and can be found here.

Position Overview:

As a member of our transdisciplinary team, you will deliver virtual outpatient therapy to individuals affected by chronic conditions and their family caregivers. We understand that a diagnosis such as Alzheimer’s disease impacts not only the person with the condition but the entire family system, which is why we view the illness as a key component of treatment. Your therapy services will focus on adults, older adults, and family caregivers, addressing both the emotional and psychological challenges that arise on this journey.

By offering centralized support for inquiries, scheduling, insurance contracting, billing and collections, our therapist gets to focus on supporting patients on this often difficult journey.

Join us in redefining healthcare by ensuring our caregivers receive the comprehensive support they deserve. Together, we can create a more compassionate, accessible, equitable and effective care system!

Schedule: Part-time, 20–25 hours per week. Hours are scheduled based on client demand and team needs.

Primary Responsibilities Include (but are not limited to):

  • Perform remote clinical counseling services to clients of Nolia as scheduled and in accordance with company policies

  • Maintain proper licensure and abide by all laws, rules, regulations, and codes of ethics which are binding upon or applicable to the services performed at Nolia
  • Completion of written records for each patient including, but not limited to: intake notes, progress notes, treatment plans, termination notes, contract notes, and other forms or documents which may be needed or required from time-to-time by Nolia or third parties in conjunction with the treatment of the patient.
  • Maintain up to date and accurate patient files at all times.

Experience/Skills:

  • Master’s degree or Doctoral degree in counseling or social work; and
  • Active, unrestricted license (LMFT, LMHC, LICSW) in the State of California or Washington. A copy must be provided to Nolia.
  • Required experience with completing assessments, treatment plans, and clinical case notes in compliance with healthcare plans
  • Ideally 2 years of experience (professional or lived) in understanding the needs and challenges faced by family caregivers and older adults
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of cultural humility and the ability to communicate and effectively interact with individuals from different cultures, abilities, genders, ethnicities, and races.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to demonstrate and model stable, appropriate boundaries with clients.
  • Specialty or training in ACT and/or CBT highly preferred.
  • Social justice oriented and practices anti-racism work
  • Proficiency in another language, other than English, is a plus but not required.

Work environment

  • This is a fully remote role for candidates licensed in the state of Washington or California.

Benefits of being a part of the Nolia Care Team:

  • In-house billing support to coordinate benefits and eligibility and submit claims
  • In-house scheduler to answer calls and schedule intake appointments. Regular individual clinical supervision
  • Regular case consultation
  • Nolia is an early-stage startup committed to healthcare transformation. The opportunities to learn, grow and contribute to our mission are endless
  • Various training programs, workshops, and resources are available to help you enhance your skills, knowledge, and expertise in the fields of caregiving and aging. We will pay for licensing updates.
  • We are focused on caregiving and this permeates our working culture. Most of our team have lived experiences as family caregivers. We prioritize your wellbeing and provide a flexible work schedule to accommodate other life responsibilities.
  • This is a remote first position that allows for some scheduling flexibility.
  • We prioritize inclusivity, teamwork, open communication, and mutual respect, fostering a positive work environment where you can excel and contribute to our shared goals.
  • Nolia is dedicated to creating and sustaining a workplace environment that fully integrates diversity, equity and inclusion to all aspects of our operations. Consequently, we actively prioritize and welcome Black, Indigenous and people of color, a multigenerational workforce, LGBTQ+ and people with disability to join our highly talented team.

Don’t meet every requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. If you’re excited about our mission and values, and the job itself, but your past experience doesn’t perfectly align, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Hiring Process:

Candidates selected for a brief initial screening call will have the opportunity to discuss the role and next steps. Those moving forward will then meet with at least two members of our clinical leadership team for a 45-minute interview.

Salary: $37.50 - $40.00 / hr

title: Patient Services Coordinator
description:

For additional information visit

OTHER DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and Experience

Required: High school diploma or GED. Experience using a PC in a Windows environment.

Preferred: Experience working in a medical setting.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of medical insurance.
  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Excellent computer, 10-key and keyboarding skills, including familiarity with Windows.
  • Excellent interpersonal & problem solving skills.
  • Ability to work in a team environment.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Ability to engage others, listen and adapt response to meet others’ needs.
  • Ability to align own actions with those of other team members committed to common goals.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to perform job duties in a professional manner at all times.
  • Ability to understand, recall, and communicate, factual information.
  • Ability to understand, recall, and apply oral and/or written instructions or other information.
  • Ability to organize thoughts and ideas into understandable terminology.
  • Ability to apply common sense in performing job.

Work Schedule: Monday-Friday; 8:00am-5:00pm

title: Director, Platform Enablement
description:
JOB TITLE: Director, Platform Engineering

FLSA STATUS: Exempt

DEPARTMENT: Technology

REPORTS TO: SVP, Technology and Information Security

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: Yes

JOB LOCATION: Nashville, TN / Remote

TRAVEL: Occasional for conferences, strategic planning sessions, and key stakeholder meetings

SUMMARY OF POSITION:

This is a senior engineering leadership role, not a management role with an engineering title. You will operate as a hands-on practitioner at the intersection of platform engineering, multi-cloud architecture (AWS/Azure), and solution delivery contributing directly to architecture decisions, reviewing infrastructure code, and engaging in your team's hardest technical problems. You will partner closely with Solution Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Service Operations to ensure the platform delivers the capabilities those teams depend on, while building and developing an engineering team capable of sustaining that bar over time.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Platform Strategy & Technical Leadership

  • Own and operate the i3 Platform as an internal product: maintain a published roadmap, a prioritized backlog, and a regular cadence of shipped capabilities.
  • Develop and execute the technology organization's overall platform strategy in alignment with business goals. Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, identifying and implementing innovative platform solutions to enhance business outcomes.
  • Maintain the platform's catalog of reference architectures, designed to the i3 Well-Architected Framework, in partnership with Solution Architecture Platform Engineering owns the reusable implementation; Solution Architecture owns the framework and review function.
  • Define and track platform KPIs - self-service ratio, IaC coverage, mean time to provision, policy violation rate, platform adoption holding the team accountable to outcomes, not activity.
  • Evaluate and manage relationships with cloud service providers and platform tooling vendors (AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, Hashicorp/Scalr, and others).
  • Communicate platform roadmap, KPIs, and investment rationale to the SVP of Technology & Cybersecurity and the CTO on a regular cadence.
  • Maintain multi-cloud consistency as a first-class objective: a single operating model, toolchain, and standards bar across AWS and Azure, so that provider choice is an implementation detail for consuming teams rather than a source of divergence in how the platform behaves.

Engineering & Technical Execution

  • Lead as a hands-on practitioner contributing to architecture decisions, reviewing infrastructure code, and engaging directly in solving the team's hardest problems. This role does not manage from a distance.
  • Own the Company's IaC ecosystem currently Terraform with Scalr governance. Lead the evolution of the module and artifact registry as the primary assets Platform Engineering produces, developing reference implementations, templates, and accelerators that engineering teams can adopt and extend.
  • Drive the "Everything as Code" standard across all platform capabilities: infrastructure, configuration, policy, security controls, pipelines, and runbooks.
  • Establish and maintain the enterprise technical standards framework in active partnership with Solution Architecture and Cybersecurity, ensuring security and compliance controls (SOC-2, PCI, HIPAA, FedRAMP, CJIS) are implemented at the platform layer by default.
  • Conduct deep-dive technical reviews of platform systems, identifying optimization opportunities, technical debt, and modernization priorities, and lead proof-of-concept initiatives for emerging technologies and architectural patterns before they're adopted platform-wide.

People & Organizational Leadership

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Engineering team. Maintain clear performance expectations, conduct regular calibration, and invest in individual development plans for every team member.
  • Recruit engineering talent to an above-bar standard; accept longer time-to-fill rather than compromise on quality.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop engineering talent as a core leadership responsibility growing individual contributors into senior and principal-level engineers and building the technical depth and platform-as-a-product thinking the team needs to sustain itself. This is the Director's direct contribution to the organization's "Raising the Bar" commitment to continuous skill development and leadership excellence.
  • Own the quality bar for Cloud Engineers executing project delivery work against Platform Engineering standards. Define and maintain the standards, templates, and review processes delivery teams use ensuring delivered infrastructure meets a high-quality bar.
  • Act as a trusted technical partner to Solution Architects and Cybersecurity, ensuring the i3 Platform delivers the capabilities they need to fulfill vertical commitments. Provide the observability tooling Service Operations depends on for 24x7x365 monitoring and incident response and ensure operational signals from Service Operations feeds back into platform improvements.
  • Champion a culture of architectural thinking, technical excellence, and continuous improvement using data-driven insights and operational learning to drive ongoing platform improvements with measurable governance, reliability, and efficiency gains.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline; or equivalent demonstrated experience.

Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure), platform engineering, or DevOps/SRE disciplines, with demonstrated progression from hands-on engineering into technical leadership.
  • Proven track record architecting and operating large-scale, production-grade infrastructure in enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated experience influencing technical direction and driving adoption of platform standards across multiple teams including teams outside your direct reporting line.
  • History of leading major platform or infrastructure initiatives from concept through delivery, including modernization and multi-cloud consolidation programs.

Functional Skills

  • Excellent leadership and people management skills, with strong verbal and written communication skills and a demonstrated ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, able to navigate ambiguity and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Strategic thinking capability with a track record of translating business objectives into an effective platform strategy.
  • A natural mentor and teacher who elevates the capabilities of those around them with a demonstrated track record of coaching and developing engineering talent, growing individual contributors into senior and staff-level engineers over time, not just managing performance.
  • Self-directed and outcome-focused, with the ability to drive initiatives independently while collaborating effectively across teams.

Technical Skills

  • Deep working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure; ability to design, evaluate, and govern multi-cloud architectures, with a solid understanding of Well-Architected principles.
  • Deep working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, including module development, state management, and IaC governance at scale with mastery of Terraform or comparable tools and experience establishing IaC standards at scale.
  • Deep working knowledge of networking, security, and infrastructure technologies, including compliance frameworks (SOC2, PCI, HIPAA, FedRAMP, CJIS).
  • Working knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/EKS/AKS, or equivalent), serverless architecture and integration patterns.
  • Programming proficiency in at least one general-purpose language (Python, Golang, or similar) for platform tooling and automation development.
  • Experience supporting both Linux- and Windows-hosted workloads in cloud environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to review and evaluate engineering work products including application code, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD pipelines for quality, security, and adherence to platform standards.
  • Relevant certification(s) from AWS or Azure (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) or proven expertise implementing solutions aligned with the relevant Well-Architected Framework.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Strategic Leadership

  • Demonstrated experience achieving engineering, operational, and tooling parity across AWS and Azure, not solely deep expertise in a single provider.
  • Experience leading a multi-team or multi-cloud consolidation effort directly relevant given this role's origin as a merger of the AWS and Azure Cloud Services teams.
  • Proven ability to build and execute a multi-year platform roadmap.
  • Track record of successful vendor evaluation, negotiation, and relationship management.
  • Experience establishing architecture review processes, platform guilds, or centers of excellence in partnership with Solution Architecture.
  • Background in heavily regulated industries with complex compliance requirements (SOC2, PCI, HIPAA, FedRAMP, CJIS).

Platform & Technical Experience

  • Experience building or scaling an internal developer platform ("platform-as-a-product”, golden paths, self-service infrastructure) rather than only traditional cloud administration.
  • Direct experience with the Company's specific toolchain (Terraform + Scalr) or comparable multi-cloud IaC governance platforms.
  • Current certification in AWS or Azure at the architect or professional level (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Professional and Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
  • Experience architecting for high-availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity at scale.
  • Experience scaling FinOps practices and cost optimization strategies for cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with observability platforms, SRE practices, and incident response at scale.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted and agentic engineering practices (AI coding assistants, agentic development workflows) and sound judgment for where these patterns genuinely improve platform engineering work versus adding noise.
  • Familiarity with architecting platforms for AI workloads, including agentic AI orchestration patterns and infrastructure needs.

title: Warehouse Processing Team Member - Dollywood Theme Park - Full Time Seasonal
description:

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Physical Requirements | Environmental Conditions

title: Erfaren maskinfører til anlægsprojekter
description:
Er du en erfaren maskinfører, og drømmer du om at udføre varierende projekter med skiftende arbejdslokationer og frihed til at planlægge din arbejdsuge? Så har vi et fast job til dig i Forstas’ anlægsafdeling.

Hvad skal du lave?

Som maskinfører kommer du bl.a. til at arbejde med:

  • Maskinkørsel ved jord-, kloak- og afvandingsarbejde
  • Udgravning til rør, brønde, kabler og forsyningsledninger
  • Planering, terrænregulering og jordflytning
  • Arbejde på vej-, sti- og infrastrukturprojekter
  • Kørsel med gravemaskine og andre entreprenørmaskiner
  • Dagligt tilsyn med maskinerne
  • Samarbejde med rørlæggere, håndmænd og formænd
  • Praktiske opgaver uden for maskinen, når der er brug for det

Et af vores kommende projekter, du bliver en del af, er etableringen af en cykelsti i Midtjylland. Derudover har vi flere igangværende og vundne projekter, som vi skal bruge flere dygtige folk til.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Har erfaring som maskinfører fra anlægs- eller entreprenørbranchen
  • Har arbejdet med jord, kloak, forsyning, vej eller andre lignende anlægsopgaver
  • Kan betjene entreprenørmaskiner sikkert og rutineret
  • Gerne har erfaring med GPS samt tegninger, koter og laser
  • Er klar til at hjælpe til uden for maskinen, når opgaven kræver det
  • Arbejder selvstændigt, er stabil og tage ansvar
  • Samarbejder godt med resten af holdet
  • Har kørekort B

Har du kurset ”Vejen som arbejdsplads”, er det en fordel. Ellers sørger vi for, at du får det efter din opstart.

Hvad får du hos os?

  • Et fast job med opstart hurtigst muligt
  • Mulighed for egen firmabil
  • Stor frihed til at planlægge dine timer og arbejdsdage, evt. 4-dages arbejdsuge
  • Varierende projekter og arbejdssteder
  • Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer
  • Pension og sundhedsforsikring
  • Mulighed for kurser og efteruddannelse
  • Et stærkt hold med hjælpsomme kollegaer i et uformelt miljø

Der kan være perioder med ekstra travlhed, hvor vi har brug for fleksibilitet. Til gengæld får du stor indflydelse på, hvordan din arbejdsuge bliver planlagt.

Du bliver tilknyttet vores anlægsafdeling i Fredericia, men møder som udgangspunkt direkte ude på byggepladserne. De fleste opgaver ligger i Midt- og Sydjylland, men der kan også være projekter andre steder i Jylland og på Fyn.

Det er jobbet til dig, der trives med variation og ikke behøver at sidde i den samme maskine på den samme plads hver dag.

Hvad laver anlægsafdelingen?

Forstas’ anlægsafdeling udfører en bred vifte af anlægsprojekter – særligt inden for vej, bane og forsyning. Vores egne folk løser bl.a. jord- og kloakarbejder, belægning, perronarbejde, kabelprojekter, jordflytning, regnvandsbassiner og stitunneller. Ved behov samarbejder vi med underentreprenører og får hjælp fra Forstas’ øvrige afdelinger.

Vi lægger vægt på, at alle kender projektet, kundens forventninger og deres egen rolle i opgaven. Det skaber arbejdsglæde, et stærkt sammenhold og gode resultater.

Hos os er der plads til forskellighed og godt humør. Vi styrker fællesskabet gennem bl.a. kurser, ture på fagmesser og en uformel grillpølse ved gravemaskinen.

Det praktiske

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer om ugen. Vi holder samtaler løbende, og vi ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål, kan du kontakte Christian Martens på tlf. 2382 4131 eller mail chma@forstas.dk.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Du er også velkommen til at ringe og tage en uformel snak om jobbet.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

title: Senior Game Designer (Full Time - Remote)
description:
The Collective Ace Group is a one-stop service hub in the gaming industry, providing best-in-class solutions for our clients. We're seeking an experienced Game Designer to help shape the core systems of a strategy mobile title.

Role Overview: As a Senior Game Designer, you'll own key gameplay systems and drive player engagement through thoughtful economy design, progression tuning, and live-ops integration. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Art, and Analytics in a collaborative, international team, while providing guidance and mentorship to growing designers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and iterate on core strategy mechanics: exploration, resource economies, tech progression, and combat systems
  • Balance progression curves, difficulty scaling, and reward structures for mobile sessions
  • Create clear design documentation, flowcharts, wireframes, and system specifications
  • Prototype mechanics (paper or in-engine) to validate design hypotheses
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Art to implement and polish features
  • Partner with LiveOps and Analytics to define KPIs and design A/B tests
  • Analyze player data and feedback to optimize mechanics, economy, and monetization
  • Support QA with scenario testing and balance validation
  • Mentor junior designers through design reviews, feedback sessions, and documentation standards
  • Lead design discussions and advocate for player-first solutions across disciplines
  • Drive design quality and consistency across features, establishing best practices for the team

What We Offer:

  • Global team of industry veterans from leading gaming and tech companies
  • High-impact projects where your decisions shape the player experience
  • Flexible hours and fully remote work environment
  • Competitive compensation with clear growth path
  • Autonomy and ownership in a dynamic, entrepreneurial culture

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of game design experience with at least one shipped title
  • Strong understanding of strategy/RPG game economies, progression systems, and meta-loops
  • Experience with live-service games (events, seasons, retention mechanics)
  • Proficiency with design tools (Excel/Sheets, Miro, Figma, Notion, etc.)
  • Familiarity with F2P monetization and game economies
  • Analytical mindset: comfortable with KPIs, player metrics, and data-driven iteration
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to document complex systems clearly
  • Proven ability to mentor team members and elevate design quality
  • Experience leading feature development from concept to launch
  • Preferred - Mobile game design background
  • Strongly Preferred –
    Experience with strategy, 4X, or grand strategy title

Nice to Have:

  • Basic scripting/prototyping skills (Lua, Python, C#, or similar)
  • Hands-on Unity experience
  • Active engagement with player communities
  • Previous experience managing or leading small design teams

title: 3D Render Artist
description:
Company Overview: Bold AI is an AI transformation company. We help enterprises use AI to change how they work, get found inside AI answers, and create content at scale. We build the platforms that make it real.

Role Overview: As a 3D Render Artist on Bold AI's Flywheel team, you build and render 3D work with AI as a native part of your pipeline and finish in Blender. You move fast across the Creative and Production phases, taking a brief from concept to on-brand, photoreal or stylized execution at a volume that would be impossible by hand. You produce for named enterprise accounts, hold the line on brand, and feed every learning back into the system so each cycle starts sharper than the last.

About the Flywheel Platform: Flywheel is our proprietary platform that runs the content supply chain end to end. Our production team operates it, and you create inside it every day. It ingests a brand from a URL or brand book into a structured, prompt-ready profile (palette, tone, audience, visual direction), then lets you brief and generate across multiple models from one workspace, including image, motion, and text-to-3D. You organize, compare, and approve output in Collections, run an automated brand-fit and brand-safety check with Persona Lens, repair AI artifacts with Pixel Fix, and upscale to final delivery resolution. A production calendar keeps every asset and deadline on track, and one-click export ships shareable review links.

The stack you'll work in: Flywheel, Superscale, Luma, Open Art AI, Higgsfield, Canva, Claude, ChatGPT, Adobe Creative Cloud, Linear, and Topaz.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with the team in our time zone, which is EST Toronto, Canada

  • Model, texture, light, and render 3D assets for product, social, campaign, and motion

  • Use AI 3D and image tools to generate base meshes, concepts, textures, and references at high throughput inside Flywheel

  • Take generated and rendered output the last mile in Blender and Adobe: shading, lighting, compositing, and finishing to brand standard

  • Build and maintain asset libraries, material and shader presets, render templates, and prompt references that raise first-pass yield

  • Hold the line on brand across hundreds of executions for accounts like Nature Fresh Farms and Samsung

  • Keep work on-brand and platform-native, never generic AI output

  • Partner with the Creative Director and brand and production leads inside production pods

  • Feed learnings back into Flywheel so each cycle starts sharper and the system gets smarter

What You Bring

  • A strong portfolio of 3D render and motion work across product, brand, and campaign

  • Deep Blender skills: modeling, shading, lighting, and rendering (Cycles and EEVEE)

  • Daily, hands-on command of AI 3D and image tools across text-to-3D, image, video, and upscaling; you adopt new models fast (our stack includes Luma, Higgsfield, Open Art AI, Superscale, and Topaz)

  • Strong texturing and look-dev sense (Substance a plus)

  • A finishing eye that tells a good generation or raw render from a finished frame and closes the gap

  • Comfort with high throughput; you produce volume without dropping quality

  • Brand discipline to carry a client's visual identity across large execution counts

  • 4+ years of 3D and render experience in agency, studio, or in-house settings

Nice to Have

  • Motion and animation (keyframe, simulation, or procedural)

  • Real-time pipelines (Unreal Engine, Spline) or alternate DCCs (Cinema 4D, Houdini, ZBrush)

  • GPU rendering experience (Octane, Redshift, KeyShot)

  • Compositing in After Effects or Nuke

  • Experience building or maintaining 3D asset and material libraries

Role Details

  • Team: Flywheel

  • Focus: On-brand, platform-native 3D and render work at high throughput across digital initiatives

  • Collaborative, cross-functional environment with international stakeholders

At Gentle Dental, we believe a great smile can make a lasting difference—and our Orthodontic Treatment Coordinators play an important role in helping patients and families confidently begin their orthodontic journey.

We are looking for an experienced, motivated Orthodontic Treatment Coordinator who combines exceptional patient service with strong communication, relationship-building, and treatment presentation skills.

You'll partner closely with our orthodontists and clinical teams to help patients understand their recommended treatment, expected timeline, insurance benefits, costs, financing, and payment options. title: Specialpedagog till Spängerskolan
description:
1 plats(er).

Välkommen till oss på Spängerskolan som är en enparallellig F-9 skola, med ungefär 260 elever, i natursköna Arkelstorp.

Genom framgångsrik undervisning, utifrån visionen ”Lärande för livet - tillsammans är det givet”, arbetar vi för elevers lärande och god måluppfyllelse. Elevhälsans arbete ska börja i klassrummet. Pedagogiska utvecklingsgruppen under ledning av rektorerna, leder utvecklingsarbetet på skolan. Fokus sker i nära samverkan med skolans elevhälsoteam, bestående av specialpedagog, speciallärare, kurator, skolsköterska och rektorer. Även skolläkare och skolpsykolog ingår i vårt team.

Fokus över tid, är lärmiljöer som främjar lärande för individen i gruppen, studiestrategier, samverkan med hemmen, bemötande och goda relationer.

Din roll hos oss

Utifrån analyser på individ-, grupp- och organisationsnivå arbetar du handledande med fokus på grupp och organisation. Du bidrar aktivt till att kvalificerade samtal kring lärsituationer och utveckling av skolmiljön förs tillsammans med rektor, arbetslag och elevhälsoteam. Vidare stödjer du pedagogerna i att strukturera sitt arbete i syfte att underlätta elevernas inlärningssituation. Med ett salutogent förhållningssätt bidrar du till att hälsofrämjande och förebyggande arbete bedrivs.

Att arbeta med frågor rörande inkludering och värdegrund ingår som en naturlig del i din arbetsvardag. Du arbetar för att undanröja hinder och svårigheter i lärmiljön, utveckla alternativa lärmiljöer och lärverktyg.

I arbetet skapar du relationer såväl internt som externt som karakteriseras av ömsesidig respekt och förtroende och du möter eleverna där de befinner sig. Du engagerar, entusiasmerar och stimulerar eleverna till lärande och eget ansvar, samt leder och organiserar arbetet så att en trygg lärandemiljö skapas som grundar sig på ömsesidig respekt och samarbete. På ett systematiskt sätt reflekterar du över och utvärderar det praktiska arbetet enskilt och tillsammans med andra. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår också att planera, prioritera och ta ansvar för sin egen tid och utveckling.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som i första hand har lärarlegitimation med behörighet att bedriva undervisning i åk 7-9 i grundskola. I andra hand dig som har lärarlegitimation med behörighet att bedriva undervisning i åk 4-6 i minst två kärnämnen. Arbetet kräver också att du har specialpedagogexamen och erfarenhet av 3 års väl vitsordat arbete som lärare. Du har väl vitsordad förmåga att handleda och erfarenhet av undervisning som lärare i åk 7-9 eller 4-6 i grundskola är det meriterande. Har du även arbetat med utredningsarbete är det meriterande.

Vidare krävs god förmåga att omsätta verksamhetens uppdrag när det gäller elever i behov av särskilt stöd samt kunskap att anpassa arbetsmetoder och tillvägagångssätt till olika gruppers och individers förutsättningar. Givetvis är du väl förtrogen med aktuell specialpedagogisk forskning och har goda kunskaper avseende alternativa lärverktyg.

Du har god kunskap om och förmåga att arbeta utifrån rådande styrdokument. Du kan systematiskt reflektera över och utvärdera det praktiska arbetet enskilt och med andra. I rollen behöver du kunna använda digital teknik som redskap för att söka information, planera, kommunicera, presentera och dokumentera. Att utöva ett situationsanpassat lärande och ledarskap som bygger på att du sätter dig in i elevernas situation och värderingar och möter dem där de befinner sig hanterar du utan svårigheter. Du skapar relationer såväl internt som externt som karakteriseras av respekt och förtroende och kan engagera, entusiasmera, stimulera och stärka eleverna till lärande och eget ansvar.

För att vi ska kunna ta ställning till din ansökan ska du bifoga examensbevis samt lärarlegitimation. När vi vill erbjuda dig tjänsten krävs det att du visar upp ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister för att vi ska kunna anställa dig, enligt bestämmelser i 2 kap. 31-33 §§ i skollagen.

Det här är vi

Barn- och utbildningsförvaltningen bedriver pedagogisk verksamhet som sträcker sig från förskola till vuxenutbildning. I en trygg, kreativ och demokratisk miljö som värnar alla människors lika värde arbetar vi för lärande, kunskap och omsorg. Vi söker dig som vill vara med och forma framtiden!

Vi erbjuder

Vi är drygt 7000 medarbetare i Kristianstads kommun som gör skillnad i människors vardag, varje dag. Hos oss hittar du medarbetare som brinner för välfärden och vill utveckla idéer till verklighet. Kristianstads kommun erbjuder flera olika karriärvägar så att du kan utvecklas genom hela arbetslivet. Läs mer om våra förmåner och oss som arbetsgivare här.

Bra att veta

Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte ansöka via ansökningsknapp. Istället skickar du din ansökan med posten eller lämnar ansökan på Rådhus Skåne. Märk kuvertet med titel och referensnummer. Har du frågor kan du kontakta medborgarcenter 044-13 50 00.

Har du frågor kring hur du gör din ansökan, kontakta systemets support på telefon 0771-69 36 93. Välj 1 - Visma Recruit och 2 - arbetssökande.

Lön

Kristianstads kommun tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning.

Tillträde Tillträde för tjänsten är enligt överenskommelse

Löneform: Månadslön. Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning. Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.

title: Principal Business Analyst – Operations Transformation - Remote with Travel
description:
Category: IT Services

Location: Jacksonville Florida United States


Principal Business Analyst – Operations Transformation - Remote with Travel

Position Summary

The Principal Business Analyst for Operations Transformation will play a key role in the design and implementation of a future-state operating model for a multi-credit-union shared-services organization. This individual will serve as the primary bridge between business operations, technology, data, AI/automation teams, and project leadership. Previous Credit Union experience is a MUST HAVE. Understanding of regulatory and legal issues regarding US financial services and data security requirements affecting credit unions. In particular, please describe your ability to comply with: - Gramm-Leach-Bliley data security and privacy requirements; - SSAE 18, SOC 2 Type 2; 10 | Page - ISO 27001; - NCUA Regulation 748 A & B.

The Senior Business Analyst will lead current-state discovery, process analysis, requirements definition, KPI baselining, future-state process design, and benefits validation, with an initial focus onDeposit Operations. The role will help identify opportunities to improve efficiency, service quality, scalability, control, and member experience through workflow orchestration, automation, artificial intelligence, and improved use of institutional knowledge.

The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis and process transformation capabilities with hands-on experience incredit unions, retail banking, or regulated financial-services operations.

Key Responsibilities

Current-State Assessment & Process Discovery

  • Lead structured discovery sessions with credit union and shared-services subject matter experts to understand current business processes, systems, controls, data flows, handoffs, exception paths, and manual activities.
  • Document end-to-end current-state processes using process maps, workflows, business rules, requirements, and supporting analysis.
  • Analyze processes across participating credit unions to identify common workflows as well as institution-specific policies, configurations, and exceptions.
  • Identify process bottlenecks, duplicate activities, manual workarounds, control gaps, rework, and opportunities for standardization or automation.
  • Facilitate interviews and workshops in a manner that encourages candid input from employees and stakeholders impacted by future process changes.

Deposit Operations Analysis

  • Lead detailed analysis of Deposit Operations processes, including areas such as:
    • ACH and share-draft exception processing
    • Returned deposits
    • ACH research and reclamations
    • Manual payroll processing
    • Card and member-account support processing
    • Remote/mobile deposit review
    • Exception and research workflows
  • Evaluate opportunities to automate, augment, or redesign activities using workflow orchestration, AI, document intelligence, robotic process automation, and related technologies.
  • Develop recommendations for prioritizing automation opportunities based on business value, implementation complexity, risk, volume, and readiness.
  • Ensure future-state workflows appropriately address exceptions, escalations, human review, and audit requirements.

Business Requirements & Future-State Design

  • Translate business needs into clear, testable business, functional, data, workflow, integration, reporting, and control requirements.
  • Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, process models, and requirements traceability documentation.
  • Partner with solution architects, developers, AI specialists, security teams, and business SMEs to ensure proposed solutions address operational requirements.
  • Support the design of configurable workflows capable of accommodating multiple credit unions, operating models, systems, policies, and approval structures.
  • Help distinguish requirements best addressed through commercial technology from capabilities that should be incorporated into the strategic orchestration layer.
  • Ensure business requirements consider scalability to additional business lines, including Lending and Collections, and to future participating credit unions.

KPI Baselining & Benefits Realization

  • Establish and validate baseline operating metrics for targeted business processes, including:
    • Transaction and work volumes
    • Manual effort and FTE utilization
    • Cycle time and throughput
    • Error and rework rates
    • Exception rates
    • Cost to serve
    • Service-level performance
  • Partner with business and project leadership to develop credible efficiency and business-benefit estimates.
  • Define measurable success criteria for proposed automation initiatives.
  • Develop a benefits-tracking framework comparing baseline results with post-implementation performance.
  • Analyze realized results and provide fact-based recommendations supporting implementation and expansion decision gates.

Stakeholder & Change Management

  • Serve as a trusted liaison among operations personnel, credit union leadership, technology teams, compliance stakeholders, and implementation teams.
  • Facilitate workshops to validate current-state findings, future-state workflows, requirements, and implementation assumptions.
  • Identify organizational impacts resulting from automation and process redesign.
  • Support change-readiness assessments, communications, training, knowledge transfer, and transition planning.
  • Ensure institutional knowledge and critical business rules currently held by individual employees are identified, documented, and incorporated into future-state processes where appropriate.
  • Maintain a member-service-oriented perspective when evaluating operational changes and automation opportunities.

Risk, Controls & Regulatory Considerations

  • Incorporate operational risk, compliance, privacy, security, and internal-control considerations into business requirements and future-state workflows.
  • Work with compliance and technical teams to ensure requirements appropriately address the regulated credit union environment, including considerations related to GLBA, NCUA expectations, data privacy, auditability, and third-party risk.
  • Identify requirements for human-in-the-loop review, approvals, exception handling, explainability, and audit trails associated with AI-enabled processes.
  • Assist in identifying and documenting operational, process, data, technology, adoption, and implementation risks and associated mitigation actions.

Testing, Implementation & Governance

  • Support solution validation through requirements reviews, prototypes, demonstrations, and user acceptance testing.
  • Develop or support test scenarios and acceptance criteria based on documented business requirements.
  • Coordinate with business stakeholders to validate that implemented workflows meet operational needs before production deployment.
  • Track requirements, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, issues, and scope changes throughout the engagement.
  • Prepare business-analysis deliverables supporting project governance and executive/Board decision gates.
  • Provide clear status, findings, risks, and recommendations to project leadership and client stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressively responsible business analysis, business process transformation, or operational improvement experience.
  • Demonstrated experience withincredit unions, retail banking, banking operations, financial-services shared services, or another highly regulated financial-services environment.
  • Experience analyzing complex operational processes involving multiple systems, business units, handoffs, controls, and exception scenarios.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead requirements gathering and process-discovery workshops with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong experience developing:
    • Current- and future-state process maps
    • Business and functional requirements
    • User stories and acceptance criteria
    • Business rules and decision logic
    • KPI and benefits frameworks
    • Requirements traceability matrices

title: Senior Indemnity Claims Specialist
description:
The Senior Indemnity Claims Specialist handles complex and high-profile Workers' Compensation claims following company standards. This role works closely with case managers and attorneys, manages subrogation, and negotiates settlements. The Senior Indemnity Claims Specialist ensures the best possible outcome for the claim, meeting customer service expectations, and supporting the goals of the Claims Department and CorVel.

  • Coordinates early return-to-work efforts with the appropriate parties
  • Manages subrogation and litigation of claim as it applies

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and related experience
  • Minimum of 3 years’ industry experience and claim handling

  • State Certification or license as an experienced claims adjuster
  • Current license or certification in Workers’ Compensation must be maintained throughout employment with CorVel

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location. Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors: federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions. Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range: $61,053 – $98,334

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

ABOUT CORVEL:

CorVel, a certified Great Place to Work® Company, is a national provider of industry-leading risk management solutions for the workers’ compensation, auto, health and disability management industries. CorVel was founded in 1987 and has been publicly traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange since 1991. Our continual investment in human capital and technology enable us to deliver the most innovative and integrated solutions to our clients. We are a stable and growing company with a strong, supportive culture and plenty of career advancement opportunities. Over 4,000 people working across the United States embrace our core values of Accountability, Commitment, Excellence, Integrity and Teamwork (ACE-IT!).

A comprehensive benefits package is available for full-time regular employees and includes Medical (HDHP) w/Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account Options, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Pre-paid Legal Insurance, Parking and Transit FSA accounts, 401K, ROTH 401K, and paid time off.

title: BOC Operator (Temporary)
description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

*Este es un rol temporal*

Su nueva función

En Warner Bros. Discovery estamos buscando un/a BOC Operator (temporal) para sumarse a nuestro equipo de Broadcast Operations. Esta posición será responsable de monitorear y garantizar la correcta emisión de señales de televisión, asegurando la continuidad operativa de los contenidos y brindando soporte ante eventuales incidencias técnicas en transmisiones grabadas y en vivo.

Responsabilidades de su puesto

  • Opera señales de video mediante un sistema automático de emisión, controlando el horario de emisión, la presencia y niveles de video, audio, subtitulados, logotipos de identificación, tonos de comando remotos y otros efectos y eventos secundarios, realizando los cambios en el listado de emisión necesarios para corregir los desajustes, errores o problemas detectados y para adecuar la duración de eventos y bloques de eventos para mantener la programación de acuerdo a la cronología planificada o establecida siguiendo las instrucciones de su supervisor o jefe.

  • Efectúa controles en la salida de emisión y también en la recepción satelital; para determinadas señales cuenta con el apoyo de alarmas de fallas de audio y video.

  • Ante fallas o problemas realiza las siguientes acciones o algunas de ellas:

    • Conmutación a equipos de respaldo mediante sistemas electrónicos.

    • Cambios de contenido por material de emergencia previsto a tal efecto.

    • Activación o desactivación manual de dispositivos.

    • Cambio de fuente de video a servidor alternativo y/o fuentes externas.

    • Redireccionamiento de canales de audio.

    • Cambio de eventos en la lista de emisión.

  • Informa y eventualmente documenta los problemas detectados y acciones correctivas realizadas.

  • Realiza la revisión del material almacenado para su futura emisión y la prueba de gráficas, subtitulados y otras verificaciones operativas del equipamiento y/o contenido de acuerdo a indicaciones del supervisor.

  • Las tareas enumeradas precedentemente se realizan tanto en las emisiones de material grabado como de programas en vivo.

Cualificaciones y experiencia

  • Experiencia de 2 a 3 años en posiciones similares dentro de áreas de broadcasting, operaciones de emisión, master control o entornos audiovisuales.

  • Inglés intermedio en adelante.

  • Título técnico, estudios universitarios o experiencia equivalente en Operación Tecnica en Televisión, Audiovisión, Imagen y Sonido, o afines.

  • Capacidad para identificar, analizar y resolver incidencias operativas en tiempo real.

  • Buen manejo de herramientas informáticas y sistemas de monitoreo operativos.

  • Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión y tomar decisiones rápidas ante situaciones críticas.

  • Perfil detallista, organizado y con buenas habilidades de comunicación.

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

title: Quality Improvement Associate - Northbrook, IL (Hybrid Position)
description:
Come join our JCFS (Non-Profit) Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) team! Are you a people person and a data person? This Quality Improvement Associate position includes providing guidance and support to staff to drive process improvement through data analysis, report writing, and evaluation. The role requires strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, communication skills, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. New graduates and early career professionals are encouraged to apply!

*Please note that we require all applicants to attach both a cover letter and a resume to be considered for this role. *

Each of the following responsibilities are within the scope of the position, however, not all staff in the position do all the items listed here. Responsibilities may be assigned based on rotational assignments, agency need, growth opportunities, and bench strength. This position is hybrid with two to three days a week in the Elaine Kersten Children’s Center in Northbrook, IL and occasional days at other JCFS locations.

Responsibilities:

  • Support and monitor effectiveness of CQI program committees: provide individualized attention and support to assigned program CQI committees, improvement plans, and program leadership.
  • Participate in CQI Team efforts to determine efficient and accurate methods for extracting data from multiple client databases. This includes developing models, as assigned, and providing detailed reviews of models written by colleagues.
  • Aggregate and analyze data and write accurate, detailed reports for identified CQI committees, creating evaluation tools as needed.
  • Conduct program specification with agency programs and services with the support of department leadership.
  • Actively participate in CQI committees.
  • Apply CQI principles in daily work and actively promote understanding of these principles in interactions with program staff. Prior experience with CQI principles is preferred, but not required.
  • Support agency-wide CQI activities that may include, but are not limited to, annual client and stakeholder satisfaction surveys, utilization review, agency statistics, program performance summaries, grant reporting, program evaluation, and provision of data to the development team.
  • Model options and develop reports from data in multiple client information systems related to CQI, program evaluation, and development processes.
  • Identify problems, develop and test solutions, evaluate outcomes, and recommend data-informed next steps.
  • Support programs, the organization, and compliance staff with reporting information for regulatory audits and accreditation reviews, as needed.
  • Provide training to agency staff on outcome measurement tools and evaluation processes.
  • Represent JCFS and its programs in a positive manner to both internal and external contacts.
  • Demonstrate a structured, evidence-based approach to questioning and problem-solving. Actively ask questions, test assumptions, and seek clarification to confirm understanding.
  • Provide transparent communication, sharing progress, challenges, and insights at all stages of work to promote collaboration, alignment, and accountability.
  • Maintain availability, responsiveness, and productivity during standard working hours, including when working remotely.

Traits/Competencies

  • Effective meeting facilitation, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to manipulate large amounts of data accurately.
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail, including the ability to identify inconsistencies in quantitative data.
  • Ability to accurately follow and execute multi-step instructions in both written and verbal formats.
  • Ability to explain complex concepts clearly and articulately to program staff and team members in a manner that is understandable to individuals who may have limited exposure to CQI concepts.
  • Ability to navigate varying stakeholder needs, including resistance or differing levels of engagement, while maintaining accountability and collaborative relationships.
  • Takes ownership of assigned projects, proactively identifying issues and driving solutions while regularly communicating progress and risks without prompting.
  • Ability to engage in systematic inquiry.
  • Adept at situational analysis.
  • Maintains professionalism and strives for integrity.
  • Customer service orientation.
  • Maintains composure and effectiveness during higher-pressure periods, such as reporting cycles or deadlines, while sustaining consistent performance during routine operations.
  • Feedback oriented mindset: Openly receives constructive feedback and uses it to improve performance while providing thoughtful, respectful feedback to team members.
  • Effective prioritization, time management, and follow-through.
  • Demonstrates a growth mindset and a commitment to lifelong learning; actively seeks opportunities to expand knowledge and skills.
  • Approaches the unfamiliar with a sense of curiosity.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited program.
  • Strong organization, meeting facilitation, professional written and oral communication, and presentation skills.
  • Experience with data collection, data visualization, and data management principles, and familiarity with statistical software.
  • Must have at least intermediate Microsoft Excel and Word skills.
  • Experience working with report writing tools such as Power BI, Power Query, SQL, and Survey Monkey preferred.
  • This position requires all work to be completed in Illinois with occasional site visits to locations other than Northbrook, IL. Not all site locations are accessible by public transportation and a reliable method of travel within the Chicago metropolitan area is required.

      WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT US:

      • Mission-driven work: Be part of a team dedicated to making a positive impact in the community.
      • Collaborative culture: Work alongside supportive colleagues who value respect, inclusivity, and shared success.
      • Ongoing growth and development: We invest in QIAs through continuous training, professional development opportunities, and mentorship. You’ll be supported to strengthen your skills, explore new areas of expertise, and grow as a professional.

      • Paid time off: Includes vacation days, sick days, paid federal holidays, and paid Jewish holidays.

      • Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance. 401(k) with base contribution and match. Additional health and wellness benefits, financial benefits, professional training, tuition reimbursement, 6 weeks paid parental leave, and much more.

      • Compensation: The compensation for this role starts at $51,000.

JCFS prohibits illegal discrimination and harassment and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, sex, age, religion, disability, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, source of income, housing status, military service or discharge status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other protected category established by law, statute or ordinance.

title: Senior Backend Developer - PHP - santander
description:
PayXpert is a pioneer in omnichannel payments and a subsidiary of the Société Générale group. We serve a diverse array of local and international brands both online and in-store, spanning various sectors. At the heart of our vision is the creation of a payment ecosystem that fosters an inclusive commerce experience for all.

We have developed services that focus on revenue optimisation, performance enhancement, fraud prevention, and seamless payment orchestration. Our expertise extends to cross-border payments and alternative payment methods such as Alipay+ and WeChat Pay. Furthermore, our solutions are designed with accessibility in mind, offering features that cater to the visually impaired, ensuring everyone can engage in the modern commerce landscape.



Todos los candidatos deben asegurarse de leer atentamente la siguiente descripción del puesto y la información antes de enviar su solicitud.

The Senior Backend Developer is responsible for designing, building and evolving the backend services that support PayXpert's Payment Gateway, Secure Store and other security‑sensitive components within the core payments platform

The role spans mainly on the PHP‑based e‑commerce gateway but also on the Java/Kotlin payments platform components, working across these stacks to deliver and maintain secure transaction services

The role operates with advanced technical expertise and high autonomy, developing complex backend features, maintaining service integrity and ensuring the protection of sensitive transactional data within a regulated and compliance‑driven environment.


Key Responsibilities


Backend Development & Secure Domain Ownership

  • Design, develop, and maintain payment-oriented backend services across both PHP (e‑commerce gateway) and Java/Kotlin (core payments platform) codebases
  • Contribute to core payment backend applications with a strong focus on security-sensitive transaction flows.
  • Identify gaps or limitations in core backend services and propose technical solutions aligned with business needs.
  • Analyze business and technical requirements to assess feasibility and implementation impact.
  • Own backend components end-to-end, from design and implementation through production support. Act as a co‑owner of the PHP e‑commerce gateway, sharing accountability for its evolution, security and reliability.

Security, Reliability & Performance

  • Apply secure coding practices appropriate for transaction-critical and sensitive data environments.
  • Support the implementation of payment protocols and security-related service interactions.
  • Participate in incident analysis and troubleshooting related to payment services.
  • Ensure backend services meet reliability, performance, and data integrity requirements.
  • Critically review AI-assisted code for security, correctness and compliance before it reaches production, treating AI output as a draft to be validated rather than trusted by default. Ensure no sensitive transactional data, secrets or regulated information is exposed to AI tooling.

Testing, Quality & Continuous Integration

  • Design and perform unit and integration testing for payment services.
  • Debug and resolve defects identified during CI pipelines and iterative builds.
  • Maintain and continuously improve test coverage and backend quality standards.
  • Participate actively in code reviews to ensure consistency, quality, and security standards.
  • Use AI coding assistants to accelerate test authoring, refactoring and debugging, while retaining full ownership and accountability for the quality of the delivered code.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work closely with Product Managers to design and deliver backend solutions using agile methodologies.
  • Collaborate with peer developers, QA engineers, and release teams across the Core Business Domain.
  • Provide technical support for complex production issues and internal problem-solving when required.

Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to improving backend architecture, service interactions, and development practices.
  • Support documentation and knowledge sharing related to Secure Store services.
  • Actively contribute to improving system robustness and long-term maintainability.
  • Help mature the team's practices for effective and responsible AI-assisted development, sharing prompts, patterns and guardrails that improve productivity without compromising security.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
  • 7–10 years of total backend development experience, including secure, high‑risk backend systems.
  • 4–6 years in similar senior PHP/Java/Kotlin backend roles, owning production services and developing secure backend features.
  • Experience working with REST-based backend architectures and service-oriented systems.
  • Strong familiarity with development and delivery tools: Git, GitLab, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and issue-tracking tools.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants in a professional software development workflow, with an understanding of their security and data-confidentiality implications.
  • Experience working in payments, fintech, or other regulated and security-sensitive environments is a strong plus.
  • Exposure to or ability to collaborate on systems built with Java / Spring Boot is a great plus.
  • Fluent English is mandatory.
  • French and/or Spanish are a plus.


Our Culture & Ways of Working

Our culture is built around people, ownership and continuous progress. We strive to create an environment where individuals feel trusted, supported and challenged to grow, with regular feedback and meaningful follow-up.

We value collaboration over hierarchy. Ideas can come from anywhere, and every voice matters; we expect our teams to contribute, challenge and shape the way we work.

We are strongly product-oriented, with a hands-on mindset and a genuine openness to new ideas. Innovation is not limited to specific teams; it is a shared responsibility.

We believe in continuous improvement over perfection. Each quarter, we actively look for ways to optimise our processes, enhance our solutions and raise the bar as an organisation.


At PayXpert, we want you to grow, feel valued and enjoy your work experience. Here’s what we bring to the table:


Compensation & Stability

  • Competitive salary package with a permanent contract
  • Flexible working hours and a wellbeing-focused intensive summer schedule.


Work Environment & Flexibility

  • International, diverse and collaborative teams across Spain, France & the UK
  • Regular engagement events to build strong connections


Growth & Career Development

  • Real ownership and visible impact on key HR initiatives
  • Continuous learning opportunities tailored to your development plan
  • Free language courses (Spanish, French, English) to support your global career
  • Involvement in exciting and innovative fintech projects


Recognition & Rewards

  • Employee referral bonus program

title: Data Scientist
description:
Job Title: Data Scientist

Job Category: Science

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

Anticipated Posting End: There is not an anticipated end date for this posting since applications are needed on an ongoing basis.

The Opportunity

Join a team dedicated to advancing national security through data-driven insights, advanced analytics, and innovative technology. CACI is seeking Data Scientists at the Journeyman and Senior levels to support a mission-focused program delivering analytical, advisory, and operational capabilities across geographic and functional Combatant Commands.

In this role, you will apply data science, statistical analysis, automation, and emerging technologies to complex operational challenges within the information environment and irregular warfare (IW) mission space. You will work with diverse datasets to identify trends, develop analytical models, measure operational effects, and transform complex information into actionable insights for mission partners and senior decision-makers.

This is an opportunity to combine technical data science expertise with real-world national security missions, working alongside intelligence, operations, research, and technology professionals to help address evolving global threats.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze large, complex, and diverse datasets to establish baselines, identify patterns and trends, develop indicators, and support operational decision-making.

  • Develop and automate analytic workflows using Python, R, and related data science tools to accelerate data discovery, processing, and analysis.

  • Apply statistical and quantitative techniques including regression, hypothesis testing, sampling, longitudinal analysis, network analysis, modeling, and reliability/validity assessment.

  • Develop prototypes, scripts, and analytical tools that improve data collection, processing, integration, visualization, and synthesis.

  • Apply AI/ML and Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to structured and unstructured data, including text, survey responses, social media, and operational reporting.

  • Conduct qualitative and mixed-methods analysis using techniques such as thematic coding, classification, sentiment analysis, and NLP-assisted analysis.

  • Develop dashboards, visualizations, and analytical products that communicate complex findings to operational leaders and mission stakeholders.

  • Integrate analytical findings with intelligence and operational reporting to establish baselines, measure effects, identify emerging trends, and assess OIE/IW activities.

  • Manage and optimize analytical datasets, databases, metadata, and longitudinal data to support repeatable analysis and research.

  • Apply geospatial analysis and visualization techniques to assess information environment dynamics, geographic patterns, and audience characteristics.

  • Leverage social media and publicly available data using automated collection, analytics, AI/ML, and NLP techniques to evaluate reach, behavior, trends, and operational effects.

  • Support research and assessment design by developing analytical methodologies, data collection strategies, assessment criteria, and measures of performance and effectiveness.

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across intelligence, operations, technology, and research functions to translate mission requirements into data-driven analytical solutions.

Required Qualifications
