title: Data engineer (in opleiding)
description:
Je bent data analist en wil meer bouwen aan de achterkant: stabiele datapipelines, slimme modellen en betrouwbare platforms. In ons 1,5-jarig programma groei je stap voor stap naar de rol van volwaardig Data Engineer. Je werkt projectmatig bij een opdrachtgever, met ruimte om jouw route te kiezen. Blijf jezelf voor: we helpen je vooruit, op jouw manier. Na 1,5 jaar kun je na jouw opleiding in dienst treden bij de opdrachtgever!

Dit ga je doen
  • Je volgt een leerroute richting Data Engineer en past die direct toe in je opdracht.
  • Je ontwerpt en bouwt datapipelines (batch en/of realtime) en zet ETL-processen op, dit zodat je geen frustratie meer ervaart omdat je zelf bepaalt hoe duurzaam en robuust het gebouwd wordt. Dit doe je samen met collega's.
  • Je werkt mee aan het ontwerpen en bouwen van een dataplatform binnen een Microsoft Azure omgeving, waarbij je data uit verschillende bronnen samenbrengt en ontsluit. Dit doe je middels de Medaillion architectuur.
  • Je modelleert data en levert datasets op die klaar zijn voor rapportages en analyses.
  • Je borgt kwaliteit met testen, monitoring en heldere documentatie, bijvoorbeeld via Microsoft Purview.
  • Je stemt af met stakeholders; de inhoud verschilt per opdrachtgever en project
Je bent fit for the job als je...
  • je minimaal 3 jaar ervaring hebt als data analist, data scientist of BI developer.
  • je een hbo- of wo-diploma hebt behaald in Informatica, Data Science, (Technische) Bedrijfskunde, (Toegepaste) Wiskunde, Econometrie of vergelijkbaar.
  • je een stevige basis hebt in Power BI en Python en/of SQL
  • je ervaring hebt opgedaan met data modelleren binnen een cloud (Microsoft Azure) omgeving is een pré.
  • je enige ervaring hebt met Azure Datafactory, Databricks/Spark, dbt, CI/CD (Azure DevOps), Tests & Monitoring en/of Git workflows of soortgelijke tools zijn een sterke pré.
  • Je jezelf committeert aan een ontwikkeltraject van 1,5 jaar en beschikbaar bent voor 36-40 uur per week.
Dit krijg je van ons

We bieden een salaris tussen de 3.800 en 6.000 euro bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week passend bij je ervaring en expertise.

Vanuit jouw rol als data analist groei je op opdracht naar een data engineer. Wij zorgen voor passende opdrachten die deze ontwikkeling stap voor stap mogelijk maken. Het ontwikkelprogramma ondersteunt je hierin en versnelt jouw groei naar een volwaardig data engineer. Je volgt praktische trainingen waarin je erkende certificeringen behaalt richting de Azure stack, krijgt coaching van je performance manager en maakt deel uit van een groep die dezelfde ontwikkeling doormaakt. Juist door samen te leren en ervaringen te delen, versnellen jullie elkaars groei.
Klik hier voor onze onepager met alle belangrijke informatie die je nodig hebt voordat je besluit te solliciteren op dit programma!

  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist
Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is, of het nu gaat om een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis. Dat doen we door slimmer te werken, ideeën van papier naar praktijk te brengen en de juiste mensen op de juiste plek te zetten. Voor grote transformaties én snelle oplossingen. Van start up tot multinational: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.

Binnen team Technology werken we in twee focusgebieden: Data & Analytics en IT. Jij maakt onderdeel uit van Team Data & Analytics, samen met zo'n 35 professionals binnen een unit van 100 specialisten. Onze cultuur is business casual: hard werken, veel humor en volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Het mooie van Technology? We werken niet sectorgebonden. IT en data raken elke sector, daardoor vind je bij ons altijd een project waar jouw kennis, ideeën en energie perfect tot hun recht komen.

Op vrijdag werken we samen in ons clubhuis in Arnhem. Deze dag staat in het teken van kennisdeling, sparren met collega's en het versterken van de verbinding met Team EIFFEL. Verwacht een opdrachtgever je die dag op locatie? Dan gaat dat natuurlijk voor.

EIFFEL is onderdeel van Team EIFFEL: een community van 3.000+ experts, verspreid over 24 kennisdomeinen en actief bij 600+ opdrachtgevers. Groot in schaal, maar persoonlijk in aanpak. Ons clubhuis staat open voor iedereen die zichzelf wil blijven ontwikkelen en voor wil blijven.

#LI-GH1

Deze skills komen van pas
  • SQL
  • RESTful API development
  • Kennis van programma's en portfolio's
  • Kennis van BI-tools
  • ETL processen

Je werkt gestructureerd, denkt in oplossingen en vindt het leuk om dingen te automatiseren. Nieuwsgierigheid en eigenaarschap helpen je om snel meters te maken als Data Engineer.

title: Construction Management Specialist
description:
Overview

MPR is seeking an experienced Construction Management Specialist to play a lead role in our risk-informed approach to project execution for complex commercial and government capital projects in fossil and nuclear power generation, nuclear materials processing, power transmission, energy storage and distribution, and radioactive waste processing and storage/disposition. The ideal candidate will bring deep domain knowledge of construction management to support a holistic project view that integrates both technical and project management elements.

Construction Management Specialists at MPR are expected to apply skills and knowledge across project planning and execution, including schedule development, cost estimation, risk analysis, contract management, construction oversight, startup/commissioning, and claims mitigation. The role involves guiding, challenging, and mentoring multi-disciplinary MPR project teams staffed with personnel having engineering and project controls skills.

This position requires the ability to work effectively across a broad variety of capital projects driven by diverse client needs and opportunities. Candidates must be comfortable adapting quickly to changing project scopes, taking initiative in ambiguous situations, and applying construction management expertise across a variety of challenging technical problems. While construction management will be the primary focus, successful candidates will value continuous learning and be eager to take on challenging technical work beyond their specific field, supported by MPR's collaborative, multi-disciplinary team approach to tackling first-of-a-kind projects for our clients.

Duties/Responsibilities

The Construction Management Specialist will:

  • Serve as a steward of the client’s resources, bringing an independent perspective and providing clear, transparent feedback on project status and recommendations to decision makers.
  • Plan, lead, and enable multi-disciplinary project teams to support construction management efforts, including coaching and mentoring other professionals through execution of the work.
  • Take a lead role in client and stakeholder interactions, engaging with contractors and other external audiences, effectively communicating conclusions and recommendations.
  • Deliver project management expertise to develop and implement project plans, processes, and tools focused on influencing project success.
  • Develop periodic reporting strategies for capital projects, identifying meaningful content and formatting.
  • Develop mitigating strategies to enhance project execution efficiency or achieve schedule recovery.
  • Provide services for a range of technical challenges across various projects including, for example:
    • Project planning (cost estimation, schedule development, risk analysis, contingency development, baseline development).
    • Project controls and reporting support (e.g., cost tracking, schedule updates, earned value analysis, variance analysis).
    • Construction oversight (e.g., compliance with specifications, standards, codes, and regulatory requirements).
    • Contract management (e.g., bid evaluation, change order management, contractor coordination).
    • Contractor management and vendor oversight, focusing on activities that drive project risk to capture value from contractors.
    • Nuclear, power, and other industrial system startup and commissioning (e.g., system turnover optimization, punch list management).
    • Independent project reviews and assessments (e.g., external independent cost reviews, constructability reviews, schedule evaluations).
  • Review work and analyses performed by other MPR professionals.

Qualifications

  • Associates or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
  • Advanced degree or professional certifications (Project Management Professional, Certified Construction Manager, etc.) are a plus but not required.

Technical Experience

  • Ten (10) or more years’ work experience in the field of construction management, preferably in the energy and nuclear sectors.
  • Strong planning and management skills with fundamental understanding of the underlying first principles of construction management.
  • Familiarity developing project execution plans to construct and commission complex facilities.
  • Demonstrated expertise in project controls, cost estimation, risk analysis, and schedule management.
  • Familiarity with commercial nuclear and fossil power generation facilities, and government (e.g., DOE) facilities.
  • Detailed familiarity with construction means and methods.
  • Ability to teach and enforce best practices to less experienced professionals to provide accurate, optimal, and efficient solutions.
  • Experience with contract management strategies and vendor oversight in a variety of contracting approaches (e.g., owner construction management, turnkey EPC, cost-plus).
  • Experience in claims avoidance and mitigation.
  • Familiarity with environmental compliance and regulatory requirements for construction and commissioning of industrial facilities.
  • Experience with startup and commissioning activities, including system turnover processes.
  • Experience with independent reviews and constructability reviews to optimize design and planning for construction efficiency.
  • Ability to establish reasonableness by applying industry norms regarding quantities, unit rates, work hours, and schedule durations and sequencing.
  • Demonstrated expertise in risk management and mitigation strategies, and knowledge of risk and contingency analysis for large capital projects.
  • Strong background in earned value management systems and performance measurement.

Leadership & Communication Skills

  • Persistent, questioning attitude and the ability to accept that in others.
  • Ability to multi-task across teams of engineers and managers on various projects.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across functional teams.
  • Ability to accept and grow from constructive feedback.
  • Motivated to expand skills and knowledge, as well as tackle new problems and take on new responsibilities.
  • Ability to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
  • Solution oriented with a goal of enabling our clients’ success.

Required

This position involves Export Control compliance requirements, therefore a “US Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R § 120.15 is required. “US Person” includes US Citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.

LogisticsLocations: Alexandria VA (HQ), East Lyme CT, Burlington MA, or Salt Lake City UT

Position Type: Full-time, exempt

Travel: Likely 20-25%, but this will vary based on project assignments. This includes travel to client sites and visits between MPR offices

Compensation: The salary range for this position is $150,000 to $220,000 annually. Actual compensation is based on several factors, including but not limited to experience, internal parity, education, and skills. We offer comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts, a 401(k) and profit sharing, as well as paid time off.

About MPRMPR Associates is a thriving multi-discipline, specialty engineering services and consulting firm founded in 1964. Headquartered in Alexandria, Virginia, with additional offices in East Lyme, Connecticut; Burlington, Massachusetts; and Salt Lake City, Utah, MPR serves a wide and continually growing client base across the power and energy industries, federal services (DOE, DOD, and DHS), and the health and life sciences sector throughout the United States and internationally. For more than 60 years, MPR has built a reputation as the organization to which clients turn for specialty engineering solutions developed with integrity and technical excellence.

We make challenging projects successful by delivering reliable technical solutions throughout our client’s entire project or product life-cycle to benefit both our clients and society as a whole. We are an adaptive technical organization that identifies and responds to client needs, helping frame complex problems into workable technical and managerial solutions. We provide top-tier engineering services by focusing on first principles and relying on our multi-disciplined teams to bring energy, passion, and natural curiosity to solve unique and challenging first of a kind problems.

Our value lies in our people -- highly skilled and motivated professionals who value interesting, challenging technical work and have a desire for continuous learning. We hire the best and brightest, fostering a high-performance culture built on trust and respect that makes MPR an exceptional place to work. The combination

of our talented people working together as a team with clients and our dedication to technical rigor enables us to develop innovative solutions that create lasting value for clients and society.

MPR Associates, Inc. is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, who participates in E-Verify. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, religion, age, disability, veteran’s status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information or any other classification as required by applicable laws. MPR is a certified Virginia Values Veterans (V3) employer.

title: Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer (Freelance)
description:
Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Vibecode specialists to join the Tendem project () and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world use cases. Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Senior Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world applications. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirement.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Demonstrated experience handling anti-bot mechanisms and dynamic site structures at scale
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, OpenRouter, or similar) applied to automation tasks
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $45 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

title: Field Service Technician
description:
Hall's Culligan in Cleveland is searching for our next Field Service Technician. This position is ideal for someone who has mechanical aptitude and is looking to train for a lifelong career.

Our opportunity: As the premium provider of drinking water and water treatment services for the greater part of a century, Hall’s Culligan continues to innovate and expand our business nationwide by offering tailored solutions to meet the specific needs of each customer backed by our superior Culligan service.

As a Service Technician, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring the proper installation and service of our products and systems for customers. This role requires technical expertise, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering high-quality Culligan service. The ideal candidate for this role will have strong mechanical aptitude, the ability to troubleshoot and diagnose our systems following training and will be comfortable consulting with customers to effectively understand their needs.

Why you’ll love working here:

  • We offer a full-time, Monday-Friday work schedule.
  • Pay rate starting at $20.50/hr. plus bonus pay
  • You’ll receive paid time off (PTO) at a generous accrual rate.
  • You’ll be eligible for a full benefits package, including a 401k with company match, following your introductory period.
  • We’re a stable and growing family-oriented company who regularly offers career advancement opportunities.
  • We believe in upskilling our employees and promoting from within.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to utilize Culligan equipment in your home free of charge!

What you’ll do:

Installation and Service:

  • Install and service products and systems at both commercial and residential customer locations.
  • Test and troubleshoot equipment to ensure proper functionality.
  • Follow standard operating procedures (SOP’s) and safety protocols.

Customer Service:

  • Interact with customers in a professional and courteous manner.
  • Communicate effectively to explain installation processes and answers questions.

Technical Support:

  • Provide technical support to customers during and after installations.
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues in a timely manner.

Training and Education:

  • Train customers on the proper use and maintenance of installed products and systems.
  • Provide basic technical guidance to customers.
  • Aid and/or provide training to coworkers and other departments.

Documentation:

  • Maintain accurate records of installations and troubleshooting steps, including pictures.

Safety:

  • Operate service vehicles safely; adhere to safe driver policies and complete required vehicle inspections and maintenance.
  • Load, unload, and secure service vehicles as required.

Where you’ll work:

Culligan Service Technicians spend much of their time traveling to their customers’ location and completing on-site installation – this means you should feel comfortable working in various environments including indoor and outdoor spaces, a variety of in-home conditions, as well as situations involving pets. While you’ll be traveling during working hours, you’ll be back at the dealership by the end of your day. You may be required to work in tight spaces such as crawl spaces. This role is physically demanding and requires the Technician to stand, kneel, bend, crawl, and lift heavy equipment up to 100lbs regularly.

Who should apply:

The personal attributes that will set you apart in our hiring process include integrity and accountability – our Technicians must be honest, trustworthy, and willing to take complete ownership over their role. We expect you to be punctual and reliable as our customers rely on timely, consistent service and installation. Effective communication and attention to detail will be key in this role given the need to manage customer information and paperwork for correctness, as well as efficiently communicate with customers, managers, and team members. The Service Technician should be comfortable quickly adapting to changing circumstances, adjusting to different tasks and working conditions, as well as committing to ongoing learning to stay updated on industry trends, new technologies, and best practices.

Technically speaking, the ideal candidate for this role will be highly customer oriented, comfortable managing their time and solving problems, and committed to following SOP’s. Proficiency in using hand tools and basic power tools is of the utmost important in this position.

Your qualifications:

  • Must maintain a valid Driver’s License.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age or older, and must be able to successfully pass, and maintain, an acceptable driving record check to be insurable by the company to operate a company vehicle.
  • Must be able to safely operate a commercial vehicle daily for approximately 8-10 hours.
  • Must be able to successfully pass criminal background check and drug screening checks, as well as any ongoing screenings per company requirements.
  • Must remain physically capable, with or without reasonable accommodation, of performing the duties required of this position.

title: Senior Project Coordinator / Coordonnateur principal de projet, North America
description:
The Senior Project Coordinator works with Project Managers, Clinical Trial Managers, Site Selection Team and Clinical Research Associates (CRA) to provide administrative and coordinating support for site activation activities and other site level deliverables through all phases of the clinical trial lifecycle. As a Senior Project Coordinator, you will take the lead to ensure timeframes, targets and the quality of the deliverables are in line with internal and external customer expectations. As a Senior member of the team, you work autonomously to ensure optimized site activation and maintenance and you may be asked to mentor junior project coordinators


This role will be perfect for you if:

  • You have a minimum of 2 years of experience as a Project Coordinator or equivalent position in clinical research and in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and/or CRO industry.
  • You have proven Site Start-Up experience in the management of clinical trials and/or staff in a global/multi-regional environment.…
  • You have an interest in project administration and clinical research;
  • You want to have an impact in a fast-growing company.


More specifically, the Senior Project Coordinator:

  • Prepare Investigator Sites to conduct clinical trials through the review and approval of essential clinical trial and regulatory documents.
  • Establishes site activation timelines with selected sites and coordinates activities to meet planned activation timelines.
  • Communicate with clinical sites during site start-up
  • Collaborates with other functional departments to ensure alignment of activities to meet site activation targets
  • Escalates to the Project Manager risks to site activation schedule.
  • Communicates directly with the study teams, external site staff, to ensure tasks and priorities are aligned to the defined study timelines.
  • Collects, reviews and files sites essential documents.
  • Ensures essential documentation is complete and of good quality to successfully first pass review for site activation
  • Ensures that the electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) contains the relevant regulatory documents for site activation and ongoing study management.
  • Collects and distributes documents from / to sites
  • Produces meeting minutes from project meetings.
  • Maintains ADI log.
  • Assigns documents for internal project-specific training and coordinates training reconciliation and documentation.
  • May assist with drafting of study documents and study plans for clinical trials.
  • Acts as a main point of contact for all site correspondences for non-protocol related issues.
  • Assists sites with local ethics submissions.
  • Assist internal and external teams with access to study-specific systems
  • Assist with initiating and maintaining study files.
  • Assist with assembling and shipping the Investigator’s Study File
  • Maintains project timeline dates, enrolment tracking tools, and study material inventory.
  • Prepares shipments of study supplies to clinical sites, when applicable.
  • Assists with preparation of Investigators’ Meeting
  • Distributes study correspondence to sites.
  • Serves as in-house contact to support CRAs when traveling.
  • Reviews and reconciles investigators site and vendor payments
  • Assists with project tracking activities and status reports preparation.
  • Participates in various administrative tasks as required to accomplish the goals of the project and the needs of the project team.
  • May support Health Authority inspection and pre-inspection activities.
  • May support audit preparation & Corrective Action / Preventative Action preparation for project related issues.
  • May perform project management duties on designated trials.
  • May mentor junior Project Coordinators and assist with onboarding activities.
  • May assist with process improvement and creation of training material within the Site Activation and Project Coordination department.



Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research or equivalent experience.
  • Specialized graduate diploma in drug development is an asset

Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Project Coordinator or equivalent position in clinical research and in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and/or CRO industry.
  • Proven Site Start-Up experience in the management of clinical trials and/or staff in a global/multi-regional environment.…

Knowledge and skills

  • Good knowledge of essential documentation requirements for clinical trials.
  • Proficiency in English (written and oral) is required.
  • Bilingual French and English or fluency in another European or Asian language is an asset.
  • Excellent knowledge and competency in Word, Excel, and Power Point.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple assignments to meet deadlines.
  • Attention to detail. • Quick learner, good adaptability and versatile.
  • Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving and multi-tasking skills.
  • Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

At Indero, formely Innovaderm, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.


As a Senior Project Coordinator, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Flexible schedule
  • Home-based position
  • Ongoing learning and development


Work location

The successful candidate for this position is given to work remotely anywhere in Canada.


About Indero, formely Innovaderm

Indero, formely Innovaderm is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology. Since its beginnings in 2000, our organization has benefited from a solid reputation for the quality of its research and services exceeding the expectations of its clients. Based in Montreal, Indero, formely Innovaderm continues to grow and expand in North America and Europe.

Indero, formely Innovaderm is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero, formely Innovaderm will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Indero, formely Innovaderm only accepts applicants who can legally work in Canada

Description de poste

Le coordonnateur principal de projet travaille en collaboration avec les chefs de projet, les gestionnaires d’essais cliniques, l’équipe de sélection des sites et les associés de recherche clinique (ARC) afin d’offrir un soutien administratif et organisationnel pour les activités de mise en place des sites ainsi que pour d'autres livrables au niveau des sites, et ce, à toutes les phases du cycle de vie des essais cliniques. En tant que coordonnateur principal de projet, il prend les devants pour assurer que les échéanciers, les objectifs et la qualité des livrables répondent aux attentes des clients internes et externes. Membre senior de l’équipe, il travaille de manière autonome pour optimiser l’activation et le maintien des sites, et il peut être appelé à encadrer des coordonnateurs de projet juniors.


Ce poste est fait pour vous si :

  • Vous avez un minimum de 2 ans d’expérience à titre de coordonnateur de projet ou dans un poste équivalent en recherche clinique, dans les secteurs biotechnologique, pharmaceutique ou en CRO.
  • Vous possédez une expérience avérée en démarrage de sites dans le cadre de la gestion d’essais cliniques et/ou d’équipes dans un environnement global ou multirégional.
  • Vous avez un intérêt pour l’administration de projets et la recherche clinique.
  • Vous souhaitez avoir un impact dans une entreprise en forte croissance.


Plus précisément, le coordonnateur principal de projet :

  • Prépare les sites investigateurs à la conduite d’essais cliniques par la révision et l’approbation des documents essentiels et réglementaires.
  • Établit les échéanciers d’activation des sites sélectionnés et coordonne les activités nécessaires pour respecter ces échéanciers.
  • Communique avec les sites cliniques pendant la phase de démarrage.
  • Collabore avec d’autres départements fonctionnels pour assurer l’alignement des activités et le respect des objectifs d’activation.
  • Escalade les risques associés au calendrier d’activation des sites au chef de projet.
  • Communique directement avec les équipes d’étude et les intervenants des sites pour assurer l’alignement des tâches et des priorités avec les délais établis.
  • Recueille, révise et classe les documents essentiels des sites.
  • S’assure que la documentation essentielle est complète et de qualité suffisante pour passer la révision initiale avec succès.
  • Veille à ce que le fichier maître électronique (eTMF) contienne les documents réglementaires requis pour l’activation et la gestion continue de l’étude.
  • Recueille et distribue les documents aux sites et en provenance de ceux-ci.
  • Rédige les comptes rendus des réunions de projet.
  • Maintient à jour le registre ADI.
  • Attribue les documents pour les formations internes spécifiques aux projets et coordonne la documentation et la conciliation de ces formations.
  • Peut contribuer à la rédaction des documents d’étude et des plans d’étude.
  • Agit comme point de contact principal pour toute correspondance avec les sites ne touchant pas au protocole.
  • Assiste les sites dans leurs soumissions aux comités d’éthique locaux.
  • Soutient les équipes internes et externes pour l’accès aux systèmes spécifiques à l’étude.
  • Aide à l’initiation et à la tenue à jour des dossiers d’étude.
  • Contribue à l’assemblage et à l’envoi du dossier de l’investigateur.
  • Maintient à jour les échéanciers, les outils de suivi de l’enrôlement et l’inventaire des documents et matériels de l’étude.
  • Prépare les envois de matériel aux sites cliniques, lorsque requis.
  • Participe à la préparation des réunions d’investigateurs.
  • Distribue la correspondance d’étude aux sites.
  • Sert de contact interne pour le soutien aux ARC en déplacement.
  • Vérifie et concilie les paiements des sites investigateurs et des fournisseurs.
  • Contribue aux activités de suivi de projet et à la préparation des rapports d’état.
  • Participe à diverses tâches administratives nécessaires à l’atteinte des objectifs du projet et aux besoins de l’équipe projet.
  • Peut soutenir les inspections des autorités de santé et les activités pré-inspection.
  • Peut contribuer à la préparation d’audits et des plans d’actions correctives et préventives (CAPA) pour les enjeux liés au projet.
  • Peut assumer certaines responsabilités de gestion de projet sur des essais désignés.
  • Peut encadrer des coordonnateurs de projet juniors et participer à leurs activités d’intégration.
  • Peut contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus et à la création de matériel de formation au sein du département de coordination de projet et d’activation des sites.



Profil recherché

Formation

  • Baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent à la recherche clinique ou expérience équivalente.
  • Un diplôme d’études supérieures spécialisées en développement du médicament constitue un atout.


Expérience

  • Minimum de 2 ans d’expérience à titre de coordonnateur de projet ou dans un poste équivalent en recherche clinique, dans les secteurs biotechnologique, pharmaceutique ou en organisation de recherche sous contrat (CRO).
  • Expérience avérée en démarrage de sites dans le cadre de la gestion d’essais cliniques et/ou d’équipes dans un environnement global ou multirégional.


Connaissances et compétences

  • Bonne connaissance des exigences documentaires essentielles aux essais cliniques.
  • Maîtrise de l’anglais (écrit et oral) requise.
  • Bilinguisme français et anglais ou maîtrise d’une autre langue européenne ou asiatique constitue un atout.
  • Excellente maîtrise des logiciels Word, Excel et PowerPoint.
  • Capacité à prioriser plusieurs tâches pour respecter les délais.
  • Souci du détail.
  • Apprentissage rapide, bonne capacité d’adaptation et polyvalence.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en organisation, communication, résolution de problèmes et gestion de tâches multiples.
  • Bonne connaissance des bonnes pratiques cliniques (BPC) ainsi que des règlements et lignes directrices applicables de Santé Canada et de la Food and Drug Administration (FDA).


Notre entreprise

L’environnement de travail

Chez Indero, vous travaillerez avec des collègues compétents et dynamiques. Nos valeurs sont la collaboration, l’innovation, la fiabilité et la réactivité. Nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant ainsi que de belles perspectives d’évolution professionnelle.

Dans ce poste, vous bénéficierez des conditions suivantes :

  • Horaire de travail flexible
  • Poste permanent à temps plein
  • Gamme complète d’avantages sociaux (assurances médicales, dentaires, vision, régime de retraite, vacances, journées personnelles, clinique médicale virtuelle, rabais sur le transport en commun, activités sociales)
  • Formation et développement continu


﻿Lieu de travail

La personne embauchée pourra travailler à distance de n’importe quelle ville au Canada, ou depuis notre bureau principal à Montréal (conformément aux politiques de l’entreprise et aux directives de santé publique).

Des visites occasionnelles à notre siège social pourraient être requises ou encouragées.


﻿À propos d’Indero

Indero est une entreprise de recherche clinique contractuelle (CRO) spécialisée dans les essais cliniques. Depuis ses débuts, notre entreprise à taille humaine s’est forgé une solide réputation pour la qualité de ses recherches et de ses services, surpassant les attentes de nos clients. Basée à Montréal, Indero poursuit sa croissance à travers l’Amérique du Nord et l’Europe.

Indero s’engage à offrir un traitement équitable et des chances égales à tous les candidats. Des accommodements peuvent être offerts à toute étape du processus de recrutement pour les personnes en situation de handicap, sur demande.

Indero n’accepte que les candidatures de personnes légalement autorisées à travailler au Canada.

Of je je wilt verdiepen in cloudtechnologie of juist jouw brede DevOps expertise verder wilt uitbouwen: bij ons bepaal jij je route.

Dit ga je doen

Als DevOps Engineer werk je binnen onze Business Unit Technology aan uiteenlopende projecten. Je maakt deel uit van een team van 30 IT consultants en werkt voor verschillende soorten organisaties. Dat betekent afwisseling, nieuwe uitdagingen en veel ruimte om je technische én adviesvaardigheden in te zetten. Je schakelt intensief met development en operations teams en speelt een belangrijke rol in het vormgeven van moderne DevOps werkwijzen. Jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Ontwerpen en implementeren van CI/CD pipelines voor diverse projecten.
  • Automatiseren van infrastructuur met tools zoals Terraform, Ansible of Pulumi.
  • Beheren en optimaliseren van cloudomgevingen, zoals Azure en AWS.
  • Adviseren van klanten over DevOps strategieën en best practices.
  • Monitoren en verbeteren van security en compliance binnen DevOps processen.
  • Samenwerken met development en operations teams om een cultuur van Continuous Improvement te stimuleren.
Je bent fit for the job als je...

Je hebt ruime ervaring als DevOps Engineer en voelt je thuis in een dynamische consultancy omgeving. Je kent containertechnologieën en cloudplatformen door en door en schakelt moeiteloos tussen techniek en advies. Met jouw communicatieve vaardigheden weet je klanten helder mee te nemen in keuzes, oplossingen en best practices. Je wilt blijven groeien, nieuwe technieken ontdekken en werkt graag in omgevingen waar je impact maakt.

Harde eisen:

  • Hbo opleiding richting business IT & management of een vergelijkbare studie.
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als DevOps Engineer binnen consultancy of een vergelijkbare dynamische omgeving.
  • Diepgaande kennis van Docker en Kubernetes, sterke ervaring met Azure en goede scriptingvaardigheden (bijv. Python, Bash).

Zachte eisen:

  • Je hebt ervaring met Infrastructure as Code en configuratiemanagement en zet dit effectief in.
  • Je communiceert sterk in het Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk (minimaal C1 niveau).
  • Je schakelt makkelijk tussen klantvragen, technische uitdagingen en adviesrollen.

For international candidates: our consultants must be able to communicate in Dutch at a minimum of C1 level, both spoken and written.

Dit krijg je van ons

Je ontvangt een salaris tussen 6.000 en 7.800 euro bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, kennis en relevante certificaten. Daarnaast krijg je toegang tot meer dan 950 trainingen en cursussen die je onbeperkt kunt volgen.

Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten in een inspirerende consultancy omgeving waar je niet sectorgebonden bent. Binnen de Business Unit Technology werk je samen met 75 consultants, waarvan 30 IT consultants in jouw directe team. De sfeer is business casual: hard werken, veel humor en volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist
Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is Team EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is. Of je nu werkt voor een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis: jij helpt teams slimmer werken en brengt ideeën van papier naar praktijk. Soms voor grote transformaties, soms voor snelle oplossingen. Van startup tot multinational: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.

Binnen de Business Unit Technology werk je met 75 consultants verdeeld over drie specialisaties: Data & Analytics, IT en GEOS. Als DevOps Engineer maak je deel uit van het IT team, samen met zo’n 30 collega consultants. Omdat we niet sectorgebonden werken, krijg je de kans om in verschillende omgevingen ervaring op te doen. IT raakt alle sectoren, daardoor is er altijd een project dat past bij jouw kennis, ambitie en energie.

Elke vrijdag is onze samenwerkdag in het clubhuis in Arnhem. Die staat in het teken van kennisdeling, sparren met collega’s en het versterken van de onderlinge verbinding. Moet je opdrachtgever je die dag op kantoor hebben? Dan gaat dat natuurlijk voor.

Team EIFFEL is onderdeel van een community van ruim 3.000 experts, verspreid over 24 kennisdomeinen en meer dan 600 opdrachtgevers. Groot in omvang, maar persoonlijk in cultuur. Ons clubhuis staat open voor iedereen die wil groeien, ontwikkelen en zichzelf scherp wil houden.

Deze skills komen van pas
  • Software testing en automatisering

Je communiceert sterk en weet klanten op een duidelijke, rustige manier mee te nemen in complexe DevOps vraagstukken. Je werkt graag samen en stimuleert teams om continu te verbeteren. Met jouw analytische blik zie je snel waar knelpunten zitten en vind je oplossingen die werken, altijd met aandacht voor security en compliance. Je blijft op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in DevOps en cloudtechnologie en past die kennis toe in je werk. Je houdt van hard werken, maar zeker ook van humor op de werkvloer. xrurlwr En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent gericht op groei en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Explore an exciting and rewarding career journey with Darigold! We are seeking an experienced and motivated Senior Data Engineer to join our Data & Business Intelligence team. This key and critical role will report directly to our Vice President, Data & Business Intelligence. The ideal candidate will have deep, hands-on expertise across the core Microsoft data platform & ecosystem with demonstrated ability to design and deliver end-to-end solutions and will possess a meaningful working knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Oracle enterprise applications, with particular emphasis on data integration patterns.

Darigold is the fifth largest dairy cooperative in the United States based on milk volume and one of the largest privately held organizations headquartered in the state of Washington. Since 1918, our producers have taken pride in producing dairy products with unsurpassed quality. Today, we are one of the nation's largest agricultural cooperatives, producing over 8.5 billion pounds of milk every year.

Through innovative technology and our efficient and flexible production capabilities, we deliver value-added products and customer-driven solutions. Darigold is now known throughout the world for bringing fresh, wholesome dairy products and ingredients from the Northwest to people all around the globe.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines that ingest, transform and serve data from ERP, MES, WMS, IoT and third-party systems.
  • Lead architecture decisions for the enterprise data lakehouse, establishing standards for data modeling, pipeline patterns and platform governance.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders in manufacturing operations, supply chain, finance and executive leadership to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Optimize data platform performance, cost and reliability across Microsoft Fabric, Azure and SQL Server environments.
  • Ensure data quality, lineage and observability through automated testing, monitoring and alerting.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level data engineers; conduct code reviews and enforce engineering best practices.
  • Partner with the Oracle Applications team to maintain and evolve integration patterns between Oracle ERP/OCI and the Azure/Fabric data platform.
  • Support regulatory and audit requirements related to data retention, access controls, and traceability.
  • Partner with the Oracle Applications team to maintain and evolve integration patterns between Oracle ERP/OCI and the Azure/Fabric data platform.
  • Support regulatory and audit requirements related to data retention, access controls and traceability.

What You Will Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Minimum of 12 years of experience, including knowledge of and experience with the following:
  • Microsoft Data Platform - Microsoft Fabric
  • Architect and implement lakehouses, warehouses and data pipelines within Microsoft Fabric.
  • Design medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architectures in OneLake.
  • Build and manage Fabric Data Factory pipelines and Dataflows Gen2.
  • Develop real-time intelligence solutions using Eventstream and KQL databases.
  • Configure workspaces, capacity management and governance policies.
  • Integrate Power BI semantic models within Fabric for self-service analytics.
  • Azure Data Services
  • Design and implement solutions using Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics and Azure Databricks.
  • Develop and optimize Spark-based transformation workloads.
  • Implement Azure Event Hubs and Stream Analytics for real-time data ingestion.
  • SQL Server
  • Design and tune complex queries, stored procedures and functions.
  • Implement partitioning, indexing strategies and query plan optimization.
  • Manage SQL Server Always On availability groups and replication.
  • Oracle ERP / Cloud Applications Integration
  • Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Data Integration, OCI Data Flow (Apache Spark) and Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW).
  • Familiarity with OCI Object Storage and GoldenGate for real-time data replication.
  • Understanding of Oracle ERP Cloud (Oracle Fusion) data models, including Financials, Procurement and Supply Chain modules.
  • Experience extracting data from Oracle ERP using BIP (Business Intelligence Publisher) reports, OTBI or direct OTBI-Enterprise extracts.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) for application-to-application and B2B integration.
  • Cross-Platform Integration Patterns.
  • Design and implement hybrid integration architectures bridging Oracle and Microsoft ecosystems.
  • Knowledge of data synchronization strategies between Oracle and Azure/Fabric environments.
  • Manufacturing & Distribution/Supply Chain domain experience. Deep familiarity with the data and operational contexts of industrial environments is strongly preferred:
  • Manufacturing
  • OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) analytics and shop floor data integration.
  • MES (Manufacturing Execution System) and SCADA data pipelines.
  • Bill of Materials (BOM), work orders and production scheduling data models.
  • Quality management, SPC (Statistical Process Control) and defect tracking.
  • IoT sensor data ingestion, time-series analysis and predictive maintenance.
  • Distribution & Supply Chain
  • Warehouse Management System (WMS) integration and inventory analytics.
  • Transportation Management System (TMS) data and freight analytics.
  • Demand forecasting, replenishment and S&OP data pipelines.

Nice To Have:

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate.
  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certification.
  • Exposure to real-time streaming with Kafka or Azure Event Hubs.
  • Experience with Lean/Six Sigma operational data in manufacturing.
  • Familiarity with Python or PySpark for complex transformations.
  • Background in ERP implementations (Oracle, SAP or similar).

Benefits of Working at Darigold:

We understand that as an employee, benefits that support you and your family in and out of work are important. We’re proud to offer eligible positions a competitive total rewards package that includes:

  • 401k competitive employer matching
  • Comprehensive medical, dental & vision benefits
  • Employer paid life & disability coverage
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • 8 weeks paid parental leave
  • Education assistance
  • Employee assistance program
  • Flexible hybrid working arrangement where it applies (up to 1 day/week after initial 90 days and approval by hiring manager and HR)
  • Compensation range: $143,077.55 - $214,616.33 (individual wage based on previous experience, knowledge, and skills)

Our Commitment to Diversity:

Achieving our vision to Lead Dairy Forward requires cultivating and supporting a team with varying backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are committed to providing a workplace based on mutual respect where all employees feel included and can bring their best and authentic selves to work every day. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and Affirmative Action Employer. We welcome all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, gender identity and expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability, marital status, creed, religion, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. As a condition of employment applicants offered a role will be required to successfully pass our pre-employment background screen, receive a negative drug screen result & confirm eligibility to work in the U.S. We participate in E-Verify - please follow the links for details, English / Spanish & view our Right to Work Statement, English / Spanish.

description:

If you have orthodontic experience, enjoy connecting with patients and families, and thrive on helping people overcome financial or scheduling barriers to treatment, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

As an Orthodontic Treatment Coordinator, you will guide patients and families from their initial orthodontic consultation through treatment acceptance and scheduling.

You'll partner closely with our orthodontists and clinical teams to help patients understand their recommended treatment, expected timeline, insurance benefits, costs, financing, and payment options. Your ability to build trust, communicate value, and follow through with patients will directly contribute to an exceptional patient experience and successful orthodontic treatment starts.

  • Help patients and families overcome financial, scheduling, or other barriers to beginning treatment
  • Establish treatment schedules and coordinate orthodontic start appointments
  • Follow up consistently with patients who have completed consultations but have not yet started treatment
  • Monitor patient progress and maintain accurate treatment plan information in the practice management system
  • Track consultations, pending treatment, case acceptance, and treatment starts
  • Maintain knowledge of applicable insurance plans, benefits, exclusions, and limitations
  • Submit required documentation and predeterminations to third-party benefit providers
  • Clearly communicate insurance status and patient financial responsibility
  • Collaborate with orthodontists, clinical teams, and office leadership to support patient care and practice goals
  • Deliver an exceptional patient experience from consultation through treatment

What We're Looking For

  • Previous treatment coordination experience strongly preferred

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and relationship-building skills

title: Software Quality Assurance Manager – IEEE 802.15.4 / Zigbee / OpenThread
description:
Silicon Labs (NASDAQ: SLAB) is the leading innovator in low-power wireless connectivity, building embedded technology that connects devices and improves lives. Merging cutting-edge technology into the world’s most highly integrated SoCs, Silicon Labs provides device makers the solutions, support, and ecosystems needed to create advanced edge connectivity applications. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Silicon Labs has operations in over 16 countries and is the trusted partner for innovative solutions in the smart home, industrial IoT, and smart cities markets. Learn more at .

The Role

Silicon Labs is building a world-class Software Centre of Excellence in Hyderabad, and we are looking for an experienced Software Quality Assurance (SQA) Manager to build and lead our IEEE 802.15.4, Zigbee, and OpenThread QA team.

This team will be responsible for driving the quality of software and firmware for Silicon Labs EFR wireless SoCs, with primary focus on IEEE 802.15.4-based connectivity solutions, including Zigbee and Thread/OpenThread. The team will also validate relevant end-to-end ecosystems such as Matter over Thread and interoperability with devices, controllers, border routers, and third-party implementations.

The manager will combine strong people leadership with sufficient technical depth to guide validation strategy, quality engineering, automation, interoperability, and release readiness for low-power mesh networking products used across smart home, industrial, commercial, and other IoT markets.

This position is based out of Silicon Labs, Hyderabad. The role requires close collaboration with global teams across the USA and Europe and therefore requires flexibility in work hours to accommodate meetings and stakeholder engagement later in the day.

What You Will Do

  • Lead, build, and manage a high-performing SQA team in Hyderabad focused on IEEE 802.15.4, Zigbee, and Thread/OpenThread technologies.
  • Own people management responsibilities including hiring, onboarding, resource planning, mentoring, performance management, career development, and retention of a highly skilled QA organization.
  • Drive validation strategy and execution for Silicon Labs EFR-based IEEE 802.15.4 solutions, with deep focus on Zigbee and OpenThread/Thread and relevant Matter over Thread use cases.
  • Ensure comprehensive quality coverage across protocol functionality, network formation and operation, security, interoperability, system integration, negative and stress scenarios, performance, reliability, and regression testing.
  • Guide validation of representative Zigbee behaviors and ecosystems, including commissioning/network formation, routing and mesh behavior, application-layer interactions, security, interoperability, and long-duration network stability.
  • Guide validation of Thread/OpenThread networking, including commissioning/attachment, mesh formation and routing, IPv6/6LoWPAN behavior, security, border-router interactions, interoperability, and network robustness.
  • Partner closely with protocol-stack development, firmware, embedded software, applications, program management, product teams, and global engineering organizations to align priorities, schedules, defect resolution, and release readiness.
  • Establish measurable quality processes and metrics covering test effectiveness, automation, defect trends, regressions, release risk, and execution predictability.
  • Drive scalable automation for protocol and system validation, reduce legacy/manual test backlog, and steer automation architecture toward reusable, maintainable frameworks and lab infrastructure.
  • Drive interoperability and ecosystem validation with third-party devices and implementations, and support readiness for relevant Zigbee, Thread, and Matter certification activities.
  • Regularly communicate project status, quality metrics, risks, trade-offs, and mitigation plans to local and global leadership.
  • Champion continuous improvement in QA methodologies, tools, infrastructure, engineering productivity, and team effectiveness.
  • Drive adoption of modern engineering productivity practices, including responsible use of Gen AI-assisted development and QA tools, to improve automation velocity, debugging efficiency, and engineering effectiveness.

What We Are Looking For

  • Proven experience building and managing software quality assurance, software development in test, or embedded wireless validation teams, preferably in the semiconductor or wireless connectivity domain.
  • Strong technical understanding of IEEE 802.15.4 and hands-on experience testing, validating, debugging, or developing Zigbee and/or Thread/OpenThread solutions. Strong candidates should have depth in at least one of Zigbee or OpenThread and meaningful working knowledge of the other.

  • Experience with interoperability, certification-oriented validation, or ecosystem testing involving multiple vendors/devices.
  • Strong understanding of data communications and networking concepts and the ability to translate protocol requirements and customer use cases into effective validation strategies.
  • Experience working closely with cross-functional global teams including development, program management, product, and field/application engineering, with the ability to work flexibly across time zones supporting teams in the USA and Europe.
  • Strong track record of driving execution, prioritizing across concurrent deliverables, resolving project risks, and delivering to schedule commitments.
  • Experience with CI/CD workflows, automated regression systems, test infrastructure, and quality practices.
  • Proficiency in Python for test automation and debugging; working knowledge of C/C++ and embedded debugging is strongly preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of Git and issue/project tracking tools such as Jira.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills, with a creative, pragmatic, hands-on, and problem-solving leadership style.

Experience Required

  • 12+ years of overall experience in embedded software, wireless connectivity, networking, or related engineering fields, with substantial experience in IEEE 802.15.4-based technologies.
  • 2+ years of experience directly managing an engineering/SQA team of approximately 5–8 members, including hiring, performance management, mentoring, resource planning, and delivery ownership.

  • Ability to operate independently, make sound technical and execution trade-offs, and drive results with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Silicon Labs EFR platforms, Simplicity Studio, Gecko SDK, or comparable wireless SoC platforms and SDKs.
  • Deep experience in either Zigbee or Thread/OpenThread protocol-stack validation or development, with practical exposure to the other technology.

  • Experience with protocol analyzers and packet sniffers such as Wireshark and IEEE 802.15.4 capture/debug tools, as well as embedded development/debug environments.
  • Experience designing scalable automated test beds, RF/network test infrastructure, device farms, and long-duration or large-network validation environments.
  • Familiarity with coexistence considerations involving IEEE 802.15.4 and other 2.4 GHz radios such as Bluetooth LE or Wi-Fi.

title: UAS Airspace Integration System Field Service
description:
About OWT Global

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Tampa, FL, OWT Global is an SBA Small Business delivering reliable, operationally proven expertise and mission-focused support to the U.S. Government, industry partners, and commercial clients. Recognized as a Top Workplace by the Tampa Bay Times from 2022–2026, OWT Global specializes in deployed Field Services, Engineering Support, RDT&E, Technical Program & Project Management, logistics, maintenance, training, and operational support for advanced technologies and mission systems across Unmanned Systems (UxS), Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Cyber, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (CSISR), and Air Domain Awareness & Defense (ADAD) mission areas. Our unique services-first and vendor-agnostic approach provides customers with dedication, quality, flexibility, and reliability from a partner that prioritizes mission success above all else. OWT Global proudly supports the DoD SkillBridge Program, helping transitioning service members move into civilian careers. With a workforce comprised of more than 90% veterans from the very operational communities we support, our team brings unmatched mission understanding, operational experience, and technical expertise to every effort.

Position Overview

OWT Global LLC is seeking an experienced UAS Airspace Integration System Field Service Engineer (FSE) to support UAS operations and low-altitude airspace management across supported mission locations. This is a remote position requiring approximately 50–75% travel to DoD and USAF installations and other mission locations for site surveys, installation, integration, training, exercises, sustainment, and system support activities.

The UAS Airspace Integration System FSE will provide remote and on-site technical expertise to ensure the effective operation, integration, troubleshooting, and sustainment of UAS platforms and associated airspace infrastructure in support of safe, compliant, and efficient unmanned aircraft operations.

The FSE will support the installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of UAS platforms and associated infrastructure. The position will contribute to airspace coordination and situational awareness by enabling the management of operational UAS traffic and integration with external airspace data services, including flight authorization systems, Remote ID, and real-time airspace awareness tools.

The selected candidate will work closely with government stakeholders, airspace managers, and UAS operators to facilitate compliant flight operations, deconfliction, and airspace utilization in accordance with applicable FAA and DoD guidance. The FSE will also support the integration of UAS capabilities with supported installation systems and, where applicable, provide coordination with air domain awareness and Counter-UAS (C-UAS) systems.

In addition to technical support, the UAS FSE will deliver user training, develop and refine standard operating procedures (SOPs), maintain technical and operational documentation, and provide reach-back coordination with engineering teams to resolve technical issues, implement system updates, and support continuous system improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, operate, maintain, and troubleshoot UAS systems and supporting infrastructure at supported mission locations.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot hardware, software, network, and system integration issues to ensure continuous operational availability.
  • Support integration of UAS platforms with external airspace services, including flight authorization systems, Remote ID, weather services, and airspace data feeds.
  • Assist with real-time airspace coordination, including deconfliction of cooperative UAS operations and dynamic airspace management.
  • Coordinate with government personnel, airspace managers, UAS operators, and other stakeholders to support safe and compliant flight operations.
  • Support integration and coordination with air domain awareness and C-UAS systems, as required.
  • Provide technical reach-back support and interface with engineering teams for issue resolution, system updates, configuration changes, and capability enhancements.
  • Develop, maintain, and update system documentation, configuration baselines, technical records, and operational logs.
  • Deliver user training and assist in the development and refinement of standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Support site surveys, system installations, integration activities, testing, exercises, sustainment, and operational system support.
  • Collect and analyze system and operational data to assess performance, identify issues, and support informed technical recommendations.
  • Apply test instrumentation and telemetry data to support system evaluation, troubleshooting, and operational readiness.
  • Support flight test activities and UAS system validation in operational and test environments.
  • Coordinate with engineering and technical teams to translate operational observations and test results into actionable technical insights.
  • Maintain awareness of applicable FAA, DoD, USAF, and installation requirements affecting UAS operations and low-altitude airspace management.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience with UAS and/or Counter-UAS systems.
  • 5–7 years of experience in flight test engineering, UAS testing, or aerospace systems validation.
  • Experience with telemetry systems and flight test instrumentation.
  • Strong experience with data analysis, data collection, and visualization tools.
  • Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
  • Experience with technical documentation and test reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot technical issues in dynamic operational environments.
  • Ability to work independently in remote and field environments while coordinating effectively with government, engineering, and operational stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience with UAS platforms, UAS Traffic Management (UTM), or digital airspace management systems.
  • Familiarity with integration of UAS with air domain awareness and C-UAS systems.
  • Knowledge of RF systems, sensors, or aviation-related technologies.
  • Experience supporting DoD, USAF, or multinational-level operations.
  • FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot certification.
  • Experience with system documentation, configuration management, and systems control processes.
  • Exposure to Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) or Digital Engineering environments.
  • Experience with low-altitude airspace management concepts and UAS architecture.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of low-altitude airspace management concepts and UAS architecture.
  • Ability to analyze system performance and diagnose technical issues in real time.
  • Strong problem-solving skills in dynamic, mission-critical environments.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities with minimal supervision.
  • Effective interpersonal and communication skills for coordination across diverse stakeholders.
  • Ability to adapt to evolving technologies, operational requirements, and mission needs.
  • Attention to detail in system configuration, documentation, testing, and operational execution.
  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work effectively with government personnel, UAS operators, airspace managers, engineering teams, and external partners.

Work Environment

  • Remote position with a home-based primary duty location.
  • Requires approximately 50–75% travel to supported DoD and USAF installations and other mission locations for site surveys, installation, integration, training, exercises, sustainment, and system support activities.
  • Operational environment supporting live UAS and airspace management activities.
  • May require coordination with multiple stakeholders, including government personnel, contractors, and external partners.
  • Frequent travel is an essential function of the position and is expected to average 50–75%.
  • May require flexible hours, including support during testing events, exercises, and mission operations.

Location

  • Remote
  • Approximately 50–75% travel to supported DoD and USAF installations and other mission locations.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive benefits starting day one (medical, dental, vision)
  • 401(k) with generous company match and immediate vesting
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and Federal holidays
  • Opportunity to support meaningful missions impacting national security

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Coverage: Health, Dental, and Vision insurance through UnitedHealthcare with a 50% employer contribution.
  • Insurance Protection: Competitive short- and long-term disability, basic life insurance, and Workers’ Compensation coverage.
  • Retirement Plans: Traditional and Roth 401(k) options with a 4% employer match through Principal with immediate vesting.
  • Paid Time Off: Generous PTO, including 160 hours of PTO and 11 days of paid holiday leave.

title: Commercial Director, PSS Global
description:
Global Commercial Director, Radiology and Pathology Solutions

Elsevier │ Physician Specialist Solutions (PSS)│ Global

Remote ET or CET│ Director Level │ Full-Time

Do you want to lead commercial strategy for a global portfolio of clinical decision support tools that help clinicians make faster, more confident diagnostic decisions?

About Our Team

Physician Specialist Solutions (PSS) is Elsevier’s portfolio of specialist clinical tools for radiology and pathology. The portfolio spans point-of-care decision support — STATdx for radiology, ExpertPath and ImmunoQuery for pathology — and curriculum-based education and training tools for residents and practicing physicians: RADPrimer for radiology and PATHPrimer for pathology. Used at institutions across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America, these tools help clinicians make accurate diagnostic decisions and build specialist expertise throughout their careers.

Our commercial team is responsible for protecting and growing this global portfolio. We work closely with Product, Content, Marketing, Sales, and Account Management to design and deliver go-to-market strategies that create measurable customer value.

About the Role

Reporting to the Senior Director Specialist Solutions, the PSS Global Commercial Director owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for a sizeable global recurring revenue portfolio. This is both a strategic and hands-on role: you will set direction, lead cross-functional execution, and serve as the commercial authority for a portfolio spanning multiple products and regions.

You will drive growth through renewals excellence, new business enablement, pricing and packaging innovation, and strategic technology partnerships that embed our content into clinical workflows. Success in this role directly protects and grows revenue, accelerates deal velocity and deal size, opens new sales channels and strengthens Elsevier’s position in specialist clinical decision support.

What You’ll Do

GTM Strategy & Execution

  • Develop and own the annual PSS GTM plan: market segmentation, targeting and positioning, sales plays, pricing strategy, and packaging across all global regions.
  • Identify and develop strategic technology partnerships to embed PSS content into clinical workflows, increasing institution-wide adoption and renewal stickiness.
  • Design scalable packaging and cross-sell offers — including specialist bundles — to increase average deal value and expand the customer base.
  • Lead B2B and B2C growth motions, including campaigns to build early loyalty among residents and early-career clinicians.

Renewals Excellence & Revenue Protection

  • Own renewal strategy across all regions, enabling Account Management with usage data, ROI frameworks, and value-articulation tools to retain at-risk accounts and grow the base.
  • Build and deliver standardized retention enablement packages for regional Account Management and Sales teams.

Sales Enablement & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Equip Sales and Account Management teams with segment-specific plays, target lists, templates, and competitive tools to improve conversion and cross-sell rates.
  • Partner with Product and Marketing on events and campaigns to drive lead generation.
  • Represent PSS commercial priorities in senior leadership and cross-functional forums; act as the commercial voice of the business.
  • Attend conferences and customer meetings as the subject matter expert (SME)

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years in a commercial, GTM, or sales role in healthcare IT, clinical SaaS, or a related field.
  • Proven track record managing and growing a multi-million dollar global recurring revenue portfolio.
  • Experience designing and executing multi-region GTM strategies including renewals programs, sales enablement, partnerships and pricing.
  • Experience in working directly with customers and collaborating with sales teams
  • Strong analytical skills: market segmentation, commercial modeling, and KPI reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functionally and influence without formal authority in a matrixed organization.
  • Excellent communication and customer presence.

Nice to Have

  • Domain knowledge in radiology, pathology, or specialist physician workflows.
  • Experience with health IT ecosystem partnerships or workflow-embedded commercial models.
  • Background in B2B and B2C commercial motions.

Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance through wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals.

  • Fully remote with flexible working arrangements
  • Collaborative, inclusive culture with in-person team touchpoints
  • Coaching, mentorship, and leadership development programs

Working for You

  • Disability, life, and accident insurance
  • Retirement benefits (Salary Investment Plan / Employer Stock Purchase Plan)
  • Dependent Care and Commuter Spending Accounts
  • Modern Family Benefits, including adoption and surrogacy support

About Elsevier

Elsevier is a global leader in information and analytics, helping researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes. Building on a heritage of trusted publishing, Elsevier combines high-quality content, vast data sets, and innovative technology to support clinical practice, research, and education worldwide.
