title: Senior Director Financial Planning/Analysis
description:
Senior Director Financial Planning & Analysis

Johnson Outdoors is a global leader in innovative outdoor recreation equipment, dedicated to creating the best possible outdoor experiences for consumers around the world! With a portfolio of market-leading brands and a passion rooted in adventure, the company designs and manufactures premium products across fishing, diving, camping & watercraft categories.

Check out each of the unique Johnson Outdoor brands in Fishing, Watercraft, Camping and Diving!

With 1,300 employees, 19 global facility locations and selling in over 80 countries, the Johnson Outdoors team is continuing to grow! This new role, as Senior Director Financial Planning & Analysis, provides enterprise-wide leadership and strategic ownership for Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) across Johnson Outdoors. Partners with the CFO and executive leadership team to set the direction for enterprise financial planning, performance management, resource allocation, and strategic decision support. Leads the FP&A organization and strengthens the processes, governance, analytics, and capabilities needed to drive profitable growth and long-term shareholder value.

Located at our beautiful Headquarters along Lake Michigan in downtown Racine: 555 Main Street, Racine, WI.

Key Responsibilities:

Enterprise FP&A Leadership

  • Provides enterprise leadership for FP&A and establishes the strategy, governance, and operating framework for financial planning, forecasting, performance management, and executive decision support across Johnson Outdoors.
  • Direct and integrates the annual operating plan, forecasts, long-range planning process, and executive financial reviews to support enterprise priorities and business performance.
  • Provides financial leadership and due diligence support for acquisitions, divestitures, strategic partnerships, and other enterprise growth initiatives.

Executive Partnership & Strategic Finance

  • Serves as a trusted strategic advisor to the CFO and executive leadership team, providing financial insight and recommendations on growth strategies, investment priorities, resource allocation, and business performance.
  • Oversee and directs enterprise financial analyses, scenario planning, and strategic modeling to support critical business decisions and long-term value creation.

Enterprise Performance & Capital Management

  • Leads and drives the development of enterprise financial and operational performance metrics, reporting, and management review processes.
  • Oversee the evaluation of business performance, identifies risks and opportunities, and recommends actions to improve profitability, efficiency, and return on investment.
  • Leads enterprise capital allocation analysis, investment evaluations, and strategic business cases to optimize deployment of resources and maximize long-term shareholder value.

Financial Transformation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drives ongoing enhancement of planning, forecasting, reporting, and analytical capabilities across the enterprise.
  • Champions the use of technology, automation, advanced analytics, and emerging tools to improve business insights and organizational effectiveness.
  • Partners across business functions to strengthen financial systems, processes, and data-driven decision-making.

Technology and AI Integration

  • Champions an AI-first mindset and the responsible integration of AI and other digital technologies into business strategy, prioritization, risk management, decision-making, and operations. Guides organizational adoption while ensuring alignment with company governance, security, privacy, and ethical standards.

Other

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Performs human resources responsibilities for staff, which includes but is not limited to the following: hiring and terminating employees, promotions/pay adjustments, staff development, performance evaluations, resolution of employee concerns and disciplinary counseling.
  • Oversee the development of budgets, and ensures budgets are managed within approved guidelines.
  • Oversee the development and approval of policies, procedures, and guidelines to meet business needs.

What you need to succeed:

  • Advanced Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting or equivalent. MBA and/or CPA preferred.
  • Typically requires a minimum of 10 years finance leadership experience, including enterprise FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, performance management, strategic financial analysis, and leadership of finance teams in a complex, multi-business or global organization.
  • Advanced knowledge of enterprise FP&A, forecasting, budgeting, long-range planning, performance management, financial reporting, cash flow management, working capital optimization, and capital planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead enterprise-wide FP&A processes, establish governance, improve planning discipline, and drive consistent financial practices across business units.
  • Strong understanding of strategic finance, business performance drivers, capital allocation, investment evaluation, and value creation.
  • Ability to translate complex financial data, trends, risks, and opportunities into clear insights and actionable recommendations for executive leadership.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, challenge assumptions, and present complex financial information clearly to executive and Board-level audiences.
  • Ability to identify and implement process improvement, automation, systems enhancement, reporting, and advanced analytics capabilities to support data-driven decision-making.
  • Strong business acumen and cross-functional leadership ability, with the ability to connect financial performance to operational priorities, market conditions, enterprise strategy, and business unit objectives.
  • Strong understanding of AI capabilities, limitations, business impact, governance, risk, and ethical expectations. Ability to apply AI-supported insights to strategic decision-making, lead change, set expectations, and model responsible use.

A few pointers about our culture:

  • We value team members who are willing to wear many hats; who take personal initiative, anticipating what needs to be done, and figuring things out to make them happen; but who are also willing to ask for help, to assist others and work together.

What you will receive:

  • Find work/life balance with generous Paid Time Off and holiday benefits, a full benefits package, and broad range of employee support and fitness and wellness plans.
  • Further your career with performance development and training opportunities, including our tuition assistance program.
  • Have fun at work, enjoy a collaborative and casual work environment, participating in fun company events, and taking advantage of great employee discounts on all our outdoor recreational products.
  • Plan for your future with our 401(k) with company match and deferred retirement contributions, Sons & Daughters Scholarship program, college savings program, life and LTD insurance, and more.

title: Product Marketeer
description:
Ben jij een ervaren strategisch Marketeer die weet hoe je producten en proposities in de markt moet zetten? En lijkt het je leuk om dit te doen voor een bouw- en vastgoedbedrijf? Lees dan zeker deze vacature!

Welkom bij Van Wijnen!

Bij Van Wijnen ben je onderdeel van een grote familie met 32 vestigingen door heel Nederland. Hier combineer je de kracht van een landelijke organisatie met het warme contact van een lokaal team. Als Product Marketeer bouw jij bij Van Wijnen elke dag aan iets dat ertoe doet. Samen maken we Nederland een stukje mooier, stap voor stap, steen voor steen. Dát bouwen wij.

Van Wijnen is een ontwikkelaar, ingenieursbureau, bouwbedrijf en vastgoedbeheerder. Onze missie is ‘Samen bouwen aan ruimte voor een beter leven’. Onze vestigingen zijn lokaal en ondernemend, maar tevens landelijk verbonden. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Baarn faciliteren we onze collega’s door het land. Onze landelijke stafafdelingen zijn er gevestigd, maar tegelijkertijd is het ook de ontmoetingsplek voor onze stafcollega’s uit de regio’s. Samen met directe en indirecte collega’s, ieder vanuit zijn/haar eigen expertise, draag je in Baarn bij aan het verder brengen van de organisatie. Je staat dichtbij het managementteam en er is veel ruimte voor eigen initiatieven en persoonlijke ambities. Onze kernwaarden zijn oprecht, gedreven en grensverleggend. Collegialiteit staat bij ons hoog in het vaandel en we vinden het belangrijk dat je bij ons jezelf kan zijn. We werken hard, maar vinden werkplezier net zo belangrijk. Zo worden er tijdens de lunch regelmatig dartpijlen gegooid in de kantine, organiseren we ieder jaar een gezellige zomerbarbecue en vieren we het begin van de Kerstvakantie met een winterfeest.

Jij gaat in deze functie onderdeel uitmaken van onze landelijke marketing- en communicatieafdeling. Jouw eigen team bestaat uit vier andere marketingspecialisten en een teamleider. Verder werk je nauw samen met onze collega’s van corporate communicatie en online marketing. De standplaats is het hoofdkantoor in Baarn, waar we twee tot drie dagen per week samenkomen. De rest van de werktijd ben je vrij om vanuit huis te werken.

Dit bouw jij

Als Product Marketeer werk je bij ons op het snijvlak van strategie, innovatie en marktimpact en word je verantwoordelijk voor de marketing van onze producten en proposities die inspelen op de grootste uitdagingen in de woningmarkt van vandaag. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan onze fabriekswoningen onder het merk Fijn Wonen – een woningconcept waarmee we inzetten op industrieel bouwen en daardoor sneller en betaalbaarder nieuwbouwwoningen kunnen realiseren. Daarnaast werk je aan proposities omtrent andere actuele maatschappelijke thema’s, zoals vergrijzing en verduurzaming. Jij zorgt ervoor dat deze producten en proposities onderscheidend en relevant zijn voor de doelgroep én succesvol in de markt worden gezet. Een belangrijke missie dus! Concreet ziet jouw takenpakket er als volgt uit:

  • De positionering en kernboodschap van onze producten en proposities ontwikkelen en bewaken;

  • Doelgroepen en klantbehoeften in kaart brengen en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen vertalen naar commerciële kansen, waarvan je vervolgens zelf de go-to-market strategie bepaalt en deze omzet in een concrete marketingaanpak;

  • Samen met onze Markt Analist proposities onderbouwen met marktdata en klantinzichten;

  • Samen met onze Online Marketeers campagnes die bijdragen aan leadgeneratie, klantconversie en digitale groei ontwikkelen en optimaliseren;

  • Verder werk je ook nauw samen met commerciële collega’s door het hele land en zorg je in samenwerking met onze Content Marketeer voor overtuigende salesmaterialen;

  • En natuurlijk monitor je doorlopend de resultaten van jouw werk en gebruik je inzichten uit de markt om proposities en campagnes doorlopend te verbeteren.

Een diverse functie dus, waarbij je veel samenwerkt met zowel collega’s vanuit je eigen team als met collega’s vanuit het hele land en alle business units die Van Wijnen kent. Aan het einde van iedere werkdag weet je: dit is werk dat telt.

Wat jij zoekt in een baan

  • Werken bij een vooruitstrevend en duurzaam bouw- en vastgoedbedrijf waar collega’s met trots elke dag het verschil maken;

  • Je kan bij ons rekenen op een salaris van €5.000-€5.800 bruto per maand op basis van fulltime dienstverband (afhankelijk van ervaring), aangevuld met vakantiegeld en een gratificatieregeling;

  • Een goede werk-privébalans vinden we belangrijk, daarom kan je bij ons deels thuiswerken en zelf je werktijden indelen;

  • 26 verlofdagen plus 11 extra dagen, want bij hard werken hoort ook zéker tijd voor ontspanning;

  • De reiskosten die je voor je werk maakt vergoeden wij;

  • Wij faciliteren jouw thuiswerkplek en regelen dat je altijd goed bereikbaar bent met een zelf uitgekozen telefoon;

  • Ontwikkelen en groeien? Dat kan bij ons zeker! Via het Van Wijnen College krijg jij alle ruimte om jouw talenten te laten bloeien;

  • En natuurlijk een werkgever die jouw gezondheid en vitaliteit serieus neemt, met een mooie bijdrage aan je aanvullende zorgverzekering.

Hier herken jij jezelf in

Jij bent een echte commerciële denker en krijgt energie van het ontwikkelen van onderscheidende proposities. Daarmee maak jij graag het verschil! En met jouw sterke communicatieve vaardigheden én enthousiasme weet je vervolgens anderen ook mee te krijgen in jouw ideeën. Verder sta je in jouw omgeving bekend als een aanpakker en beschik je over het volgende:

  • Minimaal vijf jaar werkervaring in een vergelijkbare rol, waardoor jij inmiddels een scherp gevoel ontwikkeld hebt voor marktontwikkelingen en deze vervolgens goed weet te vertalen naar concrete commerciële kansen;

  • Een HBO of WO diploma.

Toe aan een baan waarin jij écht het verschil maakt? Reageer dan snel via de button hieronder. Wie weet bouwen we binnenkort samen aan iets moois!

The technologist will analyze patient EEG recordings, both in real-time and in previous data history, annotating the record, eliminating recording artifacts, and equipment, and lead troubleshooting and other actions typical in the normal course of EEG monitoring.

Key Skills and Responsibilities

  • Competence in deciphering artifacts from cortical activity
  • Proficient in operating/troubleshooting multiple EEG instruments and software.

title: Senior Full-Stack (Java/React)
description:
Newfire Global Partners is a leading technology firm that specializes in building transformative software solutions for some of the world’s most innovative companies. With a presence across four continents, Newfire Global brings deep expertise in digital healthcare, AI-driven analytics, and enterprise technology. The firm’s track record of delivering scalable, high-impact solutions has made it a trusted partner for organizations seeking to drive meaningful change through technology.
We are passionate about the purpose-driven mission to help improve the quality of care for patients and are building a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive culture. We are a fully funded company founded by serial entrepreneurs with a stable client base.

Opportunity for impact
Newfire Global Partners, a leader in developing disruptive healthcare technology, collaborates with Fortune 500 companies and start-ups to drive transformation.

Newfire is seeking a Senior Full-Stack (Java/React)

What's the Project?Our client is a well-established company in the luxury retail industry undergoing a major technology transformation. They have chosen Newfire as their long-term engineering partner for their digital ecosystem: a large custom e-commerce platform, multiple online storefronts, and ERP integrations. The goal is to modernize the platform and speed up software delivery, taking release cycles from several months down to about one.
We're building a team of experienced engineers who enjoy solving hard technical problems, improving large production systems, and working through real-world technical debt. This is not a greenfield project; it's a chance to make a real impact on the reliability, scalability, and delivery speed of a platform the business runs on. Development here is AI-native, with agentic development tools like Claude Code and CodeRabbit available, and part of every engineer's job is making the codebase work well for this way of working.

Your day-to-day activities:

  • Shipping customer-facing features behind feature flags, in small reviewed PRs
  • Improving the code you touch: decomposing oversized services, adding tests, migrating backend code toward Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.x
  • Building component and integration tests as part of everyday feature work
  • Making the repos you work in AI-ready: context files, custom commands, patterns that let agents work safely

Il nostro candidato ideale ha:

title: Quality Inspector
description:
As a Quality Inspector, you’ll play an important role in ensuring incoming materials, purchased products, and customer returns meet Inpro’s quality standards. You’ll perform visual and dimensional inspections, document results, identify nonconforming products, and work closely with teams across the organization to resolve quality concerns.

This is a great opportunity for someone with manufacturing inspection experience who is detail-oriented, comfortable reading blueprints, and enjoys hands-on quality work.

Hours and Location

  • Inpro World Headquarters, Muskego, WI
  • 1st shift, Monday - Friday; 7:00am - 3:00pm

What You’ll Do

  • Inspect incoming materials and products according to established Quality Control Plans and work instructions.
  • Use variable and attribute measuring instruments and inspection techniques to verify products meet specifications.
  • Identify nonconforming materials and initiate Material Reject Records when necessary.
  • Accept, reject, hold, or pull products based on quality requirements.
  • Provide recommendations for improvements to incoming Quality Control Plans based on product history and inspection findings.
  • Prepare rejected products for return to suppliers as needed.
  • Process customer product returns, including receiving, counting, cleaning, inspecting, and repackaging products when applicable.
  • Inspect returned products to help verify customer quality claims, including evaluating appearance and damage.
  • Document inspection findings and communicate quality concerns to the appropriate teams.
  • Pull and inspect inventory when quality issues arise and work with appropriate team members to determine next steps.
  • Complete required transactions and documentation in NetSuite.
  • Maintain accurate quality and inspection records.
  • Maintain and continuously improve 6S standards within the receiving inspection and returns areas.
  • Support additional quality initiatives, projects, and plant objectives as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment performing basic product or quality inspections.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify product defects or inconsistencies.
  • Ability to follow established quality procedures, work instructions, and safety requirements.
  • Comfortable working independently while also collaborating as part of a team.
  • Ability to safely use applicable inspection and measuring equipment.
  • Above-average Munsell Hue Test classification, per procedure, when responsible for determining visual color acceptance.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
  • Basic computer skills; experience with NetSuite or another ERP system is a plus.

Who You’ll Work With

You’ll work closely with Production, Distribution, Purchasing, Customer Service, and Quality to help ensure products meet Inpro’s standards.

This position receives day-to-day work direction and process guidance from the Quality Assurance Team Lead and reports to the Director of Quality, EHS & Customer Service.

Your Impact

In this role, you’ll have the authority to:

  • Accept or reject products based on established quality requirements.
  • Pull or place inventory on hold for further evaluation or disposition.
  • Stop an operation when an unsafe condition is identified in accordance with Inpro’s safety standards.
  • Report non-compliance with company policies, procedures, and quality requirements.

Benefits

  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Generous employer 401k contributions
  • Flexible spending account
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Generous paid time off
  • Employee assistance program
  • Vision insurance
  • Employee discount
  • Life insurance
  • Referral program

If you’re detail-oriented, have a strong eye for quality, and enjoy working in a hands-on manufacturing environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Your New Role

The Producer, Global Digital Video is responsible for pitching and producing video news stories that resonate with CNN’s digital audience. This role monitors daily news developments, researches stories, writes scripts, edits video content, and supports video production both in-office and occasionally in the field. The position plays a key role in identifying compelling story angles, experimenting with creative storytelling approaches, and delivering engaging news content across digital platforms.

The ideal candidate is a video-first storyteller who thrives in a fast-paced news environment and enjoys the challenge of short-form editing. They are a reporter who values accuracy and fairness; a team player willing to jump in and help at a moment’s notice. They should have extensive experience working independently, writing scripts and editing projects in Adobe Premiere. They can assess the news value of a story and use data to predict audience interest. A love of news and creative mindset are a must, along with an ability to navigate a large deadline-driven organization.

This role involves participation in a rotating weekend roster, and candidates must be comfortable working weekends when scheduled.

Your Role Accountabilities

  • Research, write scripts, edit video content, and produce stories for all digital platforms.

  • Identify compelling angles on news stories and develop creative approaches to explain complex topics.

  • Monitor breaking news, live events, search trends, and social media activity to identify audience-focused story opportunities.

  • Generate and pitch story ideas on a regular basis.

  • Shoot video in office and studio environments and occasionally support field reporting on breaking news and enterprise stories.

  • Experiment with emerging video formats and storytelling techniques across multiple platforms.

  • Collaborate with colleagues across CNN bureaus worldwide to coordinate coverage and gather content.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Extensive experience working at a major media outlet, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Deep understanding of digital video production and social media platforms.

  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere is required, with experience editing digital video content to a professional standard.

  • Experience fact-checking stories and conducting interviews.

  • Passion for breaking news and current events.

  • Track record of collaborating in a deadline-driven environment.

  • Availability to work holidays, weekends, overnights, and extended hours as required by the news cycle and production deadlines.

  • Foreign language skills are a plus.

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. title: Finance Generalist
description:
Job Title: Finance Generalist

Department: Finance

Reports to: Accounting Managers

Performs daily income audit functions for the Resort by reviewing, reconciling, and validating revenue activity across lodging, food and beverage, retail, waterpark, ski, adventure activities, and other resort operations. Ensures all revenue is accurately posted, supported, taxed, balanced, and reported in accordance with Camelback Resort and Peregrine policies and procedures. Research and documents variances, cash discrepancies, refunds, discounts, voids, paid outs, and system interface issues while supporting timely daily reporting and communication with Finance leadership and operating departments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform daily income audit procedures by reconciling room revenue, resort fees, activity revenue, food and beverage revenue, retail sales, parking, lockers, cabanas, ski lift tickets, rentals, lessons, waterpark admissions, zipline/adventure activities, and other resort revenue streams to PMS, POS, ticketing, and payment systems.
  • Review daily audit packs for accuracy and completeness, including cashier reports, revenue summaries, settlement reports, folios, paid-outs, refunds, chargebacks, comps, discounts, and voids.
  • Investigate and document revenue variances, missing checks, out-of-balances, incomplete postings, interface errors, and discrepancies between operating systems and the general ledger.
  • Verify proper posting and taxation of packages, deposits, advance payments, group charges, season passes, activity bundles, waterpark tickets, ski products, and third-party sales channels.
  • Prepare daily revenue reports and distribute audit findings to Finance leadership and applicable operating departments for timely correction and follow-up.
  • Assist with monthly food and beverage inventory counts, including coordinating count schedules, collecting count sheets, reviewing extensions, and validating inventory totals for restaurants, bars, banquet areas, kitchens, outlets, and storerooms.
  • Reconcile month-end food and beverage inventory results to supporting documentation and prior-period balances, research unusual variances and communicate discrepancies to Finance leadership and applicable department managers.
  • Prepare month-end journal entry support for review, including accruals, reclasses, inventory adjustments, cost of sales entries, revenue corrections, and other routine accounting entries as assigned.
  • Maintain organized month-end workpapers, supporting schedules, and backup documentation to support financial statement close, department review, and audit requests.
  • Conduct self in a professional manner always to reflect the high standards of Peregrine.
  • Perform any additional duties assigned by Finance leadership.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent (Required)
  • Completed college coursework or higher education (Preferred)
  • Must be at least 18 years of age to apply
  • Must have a commitment to follow all local and corporate policies and procedures as they relate to this position.
  • Excellent communication skills - verbal and written communication skills to facilitate resolutions to queries and discrepancies across departments
  • Strong computer skills. High proficiency in MS Excel
  • Minimum of 1 year financial experience in hotels/resorts/hospitality business.
  • Detail oriented with exceptional organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive, highly confidential guests and employee matters with utmost professionalism, tact, and sound judgment.

What’s in it for me:

  • Complimentary access to Camelbeach, Aquatopia, local amusement parks and more! Ski season passes for those working during the winter season. Plus, great friends & family perks.
  • Paid Training to gain skills, knowledge, and experience for professional development.
  • Not to be missed employee events throughout the season
  • Referral Bonuses – invite your friends to work with you!
  • Competitive wages and advancement opportunities
  • Interact with people from all over the world!
  • Next day pay, through PayActiv.
  • Tuition Reimbursement*
  • Medical, dental, vision insurance, 401K*
  • Vacation and PTO*

*Full Time status benefits

This job description is to be considered a general outline of the duties and responsibilities of this position and is subject to changes and revisions by Camelback Resort at any time. Responsibilities are listed as guidelines only and the job is not necessarily limited to these specifications.

title: Roblox Game Developer (Lua/Luau)
description:
Job Type: Temporary Contract

About the role

We are building polished, high-performance Roblox experiences for a global player base. You will own gameplay systems from concept to live deployment — writing clean, efficient Luau code across both client and server, designing multiplayer interactions, and maintaining live games post-launch.

What you'll do

  • Design and implement core gameplay systems — movement, combat, progression loops, inventory, currency, and social features using Lua/Luau in Roblox Studio
  • Build and maintain server-side logic: DataStore (player data persistence), RemoteEvents/RemoteFunctions, and server-authoritative game state
  • Architect client–server separation correctly — preventing exploit surfaces with server-side validation and filtering-enabled checks
  • Implement in-game economy systems: Developer Products, Game Passes, virtual currency flows, and reward structures
  • Optimize game performance — minimise network replication overhead, manage memory, and keep server FPS stable under concurrent load
  • Build responsive, cross-device UI using Roblox's GUI framework (Frame, ScreenGui, TextButton, etc.) with clean UX
  • Set up and operate live-ops features: timed events, A/B testing hooks, analytics telemetry, and patch workflows
  • Collaborate with designers and artists to integrate 3D assets, animations, and audio into playable experiences
  • Write modular, maintainable code using OOP patterns, ModuleScripts, and Knit/Aero/custom frameworks
  • Conduct code reviews, write technical documentation, and mentor junior developers

Must-have skills

  • 2–5 years hands-on Roblox development with demonstrable shipped games or experiences
  • Strong Lua/Luau proficiency — closures, coroutines, metatables, OOP patterns, error handling
  • Deep understanding of Roblox's client–server model, Workspace, Lighting, StarterGui, ServerStorage, ReplicatedStorage
  • DataStore and DataStore2 / ProfileService — PCalls, retry logic, versioning, data migration
  • RemoteEvents and RemoteFunctions — correct usage, rate limiting, and exploit prevention
  • Multiplayer systems — replication, lag compensation, and secure server-authoritative logic
  • Performance optimisation — Part streaming, LOD, script profiler, Micro-Profiler usage
  • Experience with Roblox monetisation APIs (MarketplaceService, Developer Products, Game Passes)
  • Familiarity with Git or Rojo/Argon for version control and team workflows

Good-to-have skills

  • Experience with community frameworks: Knit, AeroGameFramework, or self-built service architectures
  • Knowledge of TypeScript-to-Luau transpilation via roblox-ts
  • Basic 3D modelling or rigging familiarity (Blender) — not required, but reduces friction
  • Understanding of F2P game design, player retention, and in-game economy balancing
  • Analytics integration (Roblox built-in, or custom telemetry via HttpService to an external sink)
  • Anti-cheat and exploit mitigation patterns
  • Previous experience shipping a Roblox title with 10K+ concurrent players
  • Background in Unity (C#) or Godot as a secondary engine

What we look for in a portfolio

  • Links to playable Roblox games — we will play them and review scripting quality, UI polish, and performance
  • Code samples demonstrating DataStore persistence, RemoteEvent architecture, or a game economy system
  • Evidence of shipped live games, not just prototypes
  • Any open-source Roblox modules on GitHub or Roblox DevForum

title: Data Center Strategic Negotiator, AWS Infrastructure - Data Center Supply Solutions (APAC)
description:
AWS Infrastructure owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

In this role you will be part of a team that drives AWS's data center contract negotiations, with a focus on colocation projects. You will play a crucial part in expanding our data center footprint while optimizing costs, keeping apace with evolving data center design, and ensuring operational excellence. The position encompasses comprehensive ownership of both new and existing colocation agreements, including pricing structures, terms, and service level agreements, while developing and implementing market expansion strategies across existing and new markets.

The role focuses on structuring deals and serves as the primary contact with colocation providers. The position requires strong market analysis capabilities to evaluate conditions, pricing trends, and competitive landscapes, along with the ability to create and present compelling business cases to senior leadership. Success demands excellence in relationship building, stakeholder management, and driving complex multi-million dollar negotiations while maintaining AWS's competitive advantage in the global cloud infrastructure market. You will work closely with Legal, Finance, Engineering, Operations, and Project Management teams. The role requires a self-starter who is a team player and is not afraid to keep learning.



Key job responsibilities
• Serve as a key member of the team in driving data center deals and overall infrastructure strategy for target regions (Japan as the primary region and with scope for projects across Asia) as well as managing existing portfolio of data center contracts
• Understand the supplier base (primarily Colocation providers, but Real Estate developers and telecommunications companies is also a plus), develop a strong understanding of market dynamics and activity, and develop long-term strategic partnerships in support of our key markets
• Negotiate and close multi-million dollar contracts to support capacity expansion and capacity renewal
• Understand the technical requirements of our engineering teams and with their support negotiate solutions that meet technical requirements as well as our business objectives
• Ownership of business case creation and presentation to leadership (including commercial, technical and risk profile)
• Prepare and give project reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and deal execution roadblocks
• Ability to work in a high-pressure environment and pivot on the fly to changing requirements to manage competing priorities simultaneously
• Develop and implement new mechanisms to improve our customer experience
• Business Travel: 10-15%

About the team
About AWS
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Clinician CWF - Bilingual
description:
The purpose of this position is to provide direct clinical services (in-home or community based) to youth and families who are currently in the foster care system in Illinois. Client/Family Therapy

  • Within the context of critical thinking, gathers and analyzes data, completes assessments and formulates treatment plans, and implements specified treatment for routine and complex cases.
  • Formulates understanding of clients’ situations, providing appropriate services with supervisory consultation.
  • Develop and implement an aftercare plan for the client and family when nearing completion of services.

Client/Family Support

  • Provides in-home/community-based individual and family therapy with assigned clients, with the overall goal of promoting placement stability (where clinically indicated) and maintaining clients within their community.
  • Provides full range of clinical treatment duties for a caseload of clients, which may include individual, family, couple and group treatment modalities.
  • Within the context of critical thinking, gathers and analyzes data, completes assessments and formulates treatment plans, and implements specified treatment for routine and complex cases.
  • Formulates understanding of clients’ situations, providing appropriate services with supervisory consultation.

title: Lift Lead - Winter 26/27
description:
The Lift Lead is responsible and accountable for the Lift and Operators within their lift pod. The Lift Lead will ensure the lift, corral, and mazes are kept up to resort standards as well as oversee and lead the Operators. The Lift Lead oversees the scheduling of the Operator’s daily lunch breaks within their pod and provides the backup for the lunch break. The Lift Lead is responsible for covering a shift within their pod if they are short Operators. Lift Leads make sure Operators are present and performing their daily tasks and duties all while adhering to Snowbasin's grooming, uniform, and performance standards. The goal of each Lift Lead is to guide and lead their team to success while maintaining a high level of morale and accountability for themselves as well as their team. Please ensure you monitor both your inbox and spam/junk folders for any communications regarding your application status.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (other duties may be assigned):

  • Lead Lift Operators with their daily tasks and duties
  • Maintain ramps, mazes, and corrals with attention to detail
  • Verify and inspect daily procedural standards
  • Assist in training Lift Operators
  • Build a lunch break schedule within the pod daily.
  • Provide support for Pass Monitors as needed.
  • Provide pod Operators with regular guidance and feedback
  • Assist in snow removal, daily set up and routine maintenance of work areas
  • Assist with completing lift opening, closing procedures and any other tasks assigned
  • Work with all mountain departments respectfully and aid in assisting and resolving issues that could arise
  • Promote Safety and Provide excellent guest service

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Must have at least a high school diploma or a General Education Certificate (GED).
  • Must be able to read, write and speak English.
  • Must have leadership experience
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to speak effectively before groups of guests or employees.
  • Must have advanced ski/snowboard skills.
  • Must be available full time and able to work weekends, holidays, and nights when needed.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand for long periods of time.
  • The employee must frequently climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, shovel, rake, or ice chip.
  • The employee must regularly lift and /or move up to 25 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; moving mechanical parts; outside weather conditions and extreme cold. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud
  • Must have ability to pay attention to detail

title: President of Operations | PAM Health Corporate
description:
Overview

The primary responsibilities of the President of Operations are to provide strategic and operational leadership for the organization's hospitals and related business enterprises, ensuring the effective management of operations, resources, and performance. The President of Operations is responsible for driving operational excellence, supporting growth initiatives, optimizing organizational efficiency, and achieving the Corporation's mission by delivering the highest quality services and exceptional outcomes across all areas of responsibility.

Responsibilities

Position Responsibilities

  • The President of Operations is responsible for the execution of corporate goals, strategic initiatives, and operational objectives across all assigned hospitals, ensuring alignment with the organization's mission, vision, and long-term business strategy.
  • The President of Operations provides executive leadership and operational oversight to drive organizational performance, growth, quality outcomes, patient satisfaction, and financial success throughout the enterprise.
  • The President of Operations develops and fosters collaborative relationships with hospital leadership, physicians, healthcare partners, regulatory agencies, community stakeholders, and other key constituents to advance the organization's strategic priorities.
  • The President of Operations leads the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of operational programs, service lines, and care delivery models to optimize efficiency, quality, patient experience, and market growth.
  • The President of Operations partners with executive leadership to identify opportunities for expansion, operational excellence, and innovation across the organization.
  • The President of Operations reports to the Chief Executive Officer and is responsible for carrying out the mission, vision, and strategic direction of the Corporation as established by the Board of Directors.
  • Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned in support of organizational objectives.

Leadership

  • Inclusiveness: Promotes cooperation, fairness and equity; shows respect for people and their differences; works to understand perspectives of others; demonstrates empathy; brings out the best in others and in his/her team
  • Managing Staff: Coaches, evaluates, develops, and inspires staff; sets expectations; recognizes achievements
  • Stewardship and Resource Management: Demonstrates accountability and sound judgment in managing company resources; appropriate understanding of confidentiality and company values; adheres to and supports company policies, procedures and safety guidelines
  • Problem-Solving: Identifies problems and involves others in seeking solutions; conducts appropriate analysis and searches for best solutions; effectively and efficiently implements appropriate responses to correct problems; responds promptly and effectively to new challenges
  • Decision-Making: Makes clear, consistent decisions; acts with integrity in all decisions; distinguishes relevant from irrelevant information; makes timely, appropriate decisions.
  • Strategic Planning and Organizing: Understands company vision and aligns priorities accordingly; measures outcomes; uses feedback to redirect as required; evaluates alternatives; appropriately organizes complex issues to desirable resolution
  • Communication: Connects with peers, subordinate employees and all customers; actively listens; clearly and effectively shares information; demonstrates effective oral and written communication skills; negotiates effectively.
  • Quality Improvement: Strives for efficient, effective, high-quality performance in self and in the department; delivers timely and accurate results; resilient when responding to matters that are challenging; takes initiative to make improvements
  • Leadership: Motivates others; accepts responsibility; maintains high morale in department; develops trust and credibility; expects honest and ethical behavior of self and staff
  • Teamwork: Encourages cooperation and collaboration; builds effective teams; works in partnership with others; is flexible; responsive to the needs of others
  • Development: Maintains up-to-date skills through involvement with professional organizations and/or continuing education

Customer Service

  • Maintains the highest level of customer service via courtesy, compassion and positive communication.
  • Promotes the mission and vision of PAM Health within the work environment and the community.
  • Respects dignity and confidentiality by adherence to all applicable policies and procedures.

Health and Safety

  • Works in a manner that promotes safety; wears clothing appropriate to the performance of the job.
  • Participates in OSHA required training.
  • Follows universal precautions as appropriate for position; complies with Employee Health requirements for continued employment.
  • Reports unsafe practices to management.
  • Knows own role in case of an emergency.

Qualifications

Education and Training: Master's Degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or an appropriately related field required. Advanced leadership education, certifications, or executive development training preferred.

Experience:

  • Ten (10) years of progressive healthcare leadership experience, including executive oversight of multi-hospital operations.
  • Demonstrated success leading operational performance, strategic growth initiatives, financial management, quality improvement, and physician alignment across complex healthcare organizations.
  • Experience in inpatient rehabilitation, long-term acute care, post-acute care, or related healthcare settings preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead large-scale organizational change and drive enterprise-wide operational excellence.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

title: Designer
description:
Janicki Industries is an innovative, family-owned aerospace company located at the foot of the Cascades. We focus on engineering and manufacturing complex projects for companies in the aerospace, defense, and space industries. We are looking for a Designer to join our growing team.

This position is located on-site in Hamilton, Washington State.

POSITION DESCRIPTION

Designers use CAD software to develop 3D models and drawings. Designers are responsible for ensuring that each part of the design and fabrication process is consistent and that all measurements, calculations, and specifications are correct. Designers are heavily involved in the design stages, research and development, construction, testing, and production phases.
As well as being proficient in the use of CAD design software, designers must have design for manufacturability skills. They need to understand the technical aspects of their work, be precise and methodological, and use analytical thinking to arrive at innovative solutions for design problems. A designer has to consider the entire manufacturing and construction process of a tool, product, or component, and consult with subject matter experts throughout the process.

The following essential job functions are performed as a Designer:

  • Develop details CAD Models ensuring compliance with aerospace standards and project specifications
  • Support Manufacturing Processes: Collaborate with manufacturing teams to ensure design packages are producible and assist with tooling, fixture, documentation, and design changes to maintain design and specification requirements
  • Conduct Design Reviews: Participate in, lead and initiate design reviews to present CAD models, provide technical explanations, and incorporate feedback from multidisciplinary teams, including assembly, manufacturing, and engineering teams
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Production and Customer Teams
  • Maintain Documentation: Generate and maintain detailed technical process documentation, material and component BOMs, revision histories, and revision notes
  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Behavior: The incumbent must work well under pressure, meeting and completing multiple deadlines. The incumbent shall, at all times, demonstrate cooperative behavior with colleagues and supervisors
  • Communicate status and issue or roadblocks as required
  • Capable of complex surfacing and lofting. Highly functional solid modeling operations and other methodologies, and the ability to create complex parametric assemblies
  • Fundamental understanding of GD&T and mechanical design, inclusive of the ability to apply it to designs
  • Adept at collaborating with others
  • Being at work on time and maintaining good attendance is a condition of employment and is an essential function of the job
  • Aircraft Configuration Control: Ensure assurance tracking and management of aerospace assembly configurations by maintaining detailed records of design revisions, part interdependencies, and version control within CAD and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Due to our ITAR and EAR regulations, applicants must be a US Citizen or of Legal Permanent Resident Status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b (a) (3).
  • This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance (U.S. Citizenship Required). Janicki will assist with gaining this access once employed. Special Access Program or other Government Access Requirements are mandatory for this position and requires candidate agreed to enter a Continuous Evaluation program.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

  • An Associates of Arts Degree in Drafting/Design Technologies or a related field is preferred
  • Education may be substituted with equivalent industry experience
  • Experience in a PLM system such as SAP/ECTR is a plus
  • Must have strong communication skills through written, verbal, and graphical mediums in the English language
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and 3D CAD System. CATIA or NX CAD software is preferred

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • Salary range for this role is between $83,000 - $110,000, plus discretionary bonus, 401(k) matching, vacation, and health benefits. Employees can also receive additional pay for off-shifts. The range provided is Janicki’s estimate of the base compensation for this role. Actual amount offered will be based on job-related and non-discriminatory factors such as experience, location, education, training, skills, and abilities
  • By applying for this job, you are expressing interest in this position and could be considered for other career opportunities where similar skills and requirements have been identified as a match. Should this match be identified, you may be contacted for this and future openings

BENEFITS

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employer contribution
  • Disability insurance as well as Life/AD&D insurance
  • HSA (Health Savings Account) with employer contribution and FSA (Flexible Savings Account)
  • 401k with employer matching
  • Paid time off and paid holidays (including two floating holidays)
  • Education reimbursement program
  • Several shift options
  • Premium pay for off-shifts

Not sure that you’ll be the perfect fit for this role? You should still apply! We’ll review your application for other opportunities. We are always on the lookout for talented people!

Janicki Industries is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Janicki Industries does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, age, retaliation, veteran/military service status, or any other legally protected status. Janicki is proud to be a military friendly employer.

Applicants or employees wishing to view a copy of Janicki Industries’ Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should notify the Human Resources Department at (360) 404-1997.

As a federal government contractor and a recipient of federal funding, Janicki is required to abide by federal drug testing requirements (including preemployment drug testing for cannabis). Additionally, because of Janicki’s work on aerospace products and the high volume of safety sensitive positions, Janicki takes the safety of its employees very seriously and requires that employees pass a preemployment drug test prior to starting employment.

title: Speciallæge i psykiatri
description:
I AS3 Psykiatri søger vi en engageret og fagligt velfunderet speciallæge i psykiatri til vores lokation i Viby J. eller København Ø. Du kommer til at spille en central rolle i et tværfagligt team, der arbejder målrettet med at hjælpe kandidater tilbage på arbejdsmarkedet gennem grundig udredning og behandling. Stillingen er fleksibel i forhold til timeantal.

OBS: Du vil kun være tilknyttet én lokation.

I AS3 Work&Care har vi opbygget en intern psykiatrifunktion, AS3 Psykiatri, med fokus på at udføre psykiatriske udredninger for de mennesker, vi har i forløb gennem pensions- og forsikringsselskaber. Vi vækster, og derfor er vi nu på udkig efter speciallæger i psykiatri til vores lokationer i Viby J. og København Ø.

DER HVOR DU KOMMER IND I BILLEDET

Som speciallæge i psykiatri vil du have en nøglerolle i at bidrage til en tværfaglig indsats med fokus på at hjælpe vores kandidater med at forblive på eller vende tilbage til arbejdsmarkedet.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Psykiatrisk udredning og vurdering: Udføre psykopatologiske udredninger med henblik på diagnostisk konklusion og vurdering af behandlingsbehov. Herunder også en prognose i forhold til kandidatens arbejdsevne.
  • Iværksættelse og opfølgning på behandling: Vurdere indikationer og iværksætte medikamentel behandling for forskellige slags psykiske lidelser, i særlig grad angst, depression, søvnlidelser og ADHD.
  • Deltagelse i behandlingskonferencer: Bidrage til tværfaglige konferencer for at kvalificere diagnoser, vurdere behandlingseffekt og beslutte yderligere behandlingsmuligheder.

Derudover er der mulighed for at varetage samtaleforløb med kandidater, hvis du ønsker det.

HVORFOR VÆLGE AS3?

Hos AS3 Psykiatri får du en attraktiv stilling i et ambitiøst og udviklende miljø, hvor vi vægter faglighed og arbejdsglæde højt. Du bliver en del af en psykiatrienhed bestående af sygeplejersker, psykologer, specialpsykologer, speciallæger i psykiatri og arbejdsmedicin samt lægesekretærer, som alle arbejder sammen om at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kandidater.

Derudover kan du se frem til:

  • Fleksibilitet: Mulighed for selvstændig tilrettelæggelse af dit arbejde.
  • Indflydelse: Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på psykiatrienhedens arbejde og opgaver.
  • Gode behandlingsmuligheder: Den målgruppe, vi arbejder med, profiterer af en koordineret, tværfaglig indsats, og vi er med til at hjælpe mange bæredygtigt tilbage i arbejde igen.
  • Faglig udvikling: Når du starter hos AS3, sørger vi for grundig oplæring. Derudover vil der være mulighed for sparring, supervision og deltagelse i fælles udviklingsaktiviteter.
  • Godt arbejdsmiljø: Hos AS3 arbejder vi aktivt med vores arbejdsmiljøpolitik. Medarbejdertrivsel er vigtigt for os, og vi gennemfører blandt andet regelmæssige trivselsmålinger.

Læs her hvad fagchef og specialpsykolog Sussie Laasby Sørensen fortæller om vores psykiatrifunktion:
”Vores nye kollega kommer til at arbejde sammen med en masse skønne og kompetente kollegaer, som består af både sygeplejersker, speciallæger, psykologer, lægesekretær osv. Vi er garant for en høj faglighed, masser af uddannelsesmuligheder og hver dag møder vi spændende kandidater, som vi både udreder og behandler. Hos os er der ikke langt fra idé til handling, vi har et utrolig godt arbejdsmiljø og ikke mindst fremragende humor.”

VORES NYE KOLLEGA

Først og fremmest er det et krav, at du er uddannet speciallæge i psykiatri.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring med psykiatrisk udredning og behandling, gerne inden for affektive lidelser som angst, depression og ADHD.
  • Har evnen til at sammenfatte og vurdere komplekse sager og kommunikere dem på en tydelig og forståelig måde.
  • Har et imødekommende og empatisk mindset, der gør dig i stand til at møde mennesker i øjenhøjde og samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper.
  • Har et biopsykosocialt syn på psykiske lidelser og drives af at hjælpe folk tilbage i arbejde.

ANSØGNING OG YDERLIGERE INFORMATION

Er du vores nye kollega? Så klik på ”Ansøg her” herunder og upload dit CV, eventuelt en kort motiveret ansøgning samt dit uddannelsesbevis.

Ansøgningsfrist: Vi vurderer løbende alle indkomne ansøgninger.
Stillingstype: Stillingstype og timeantal kan tilpasse dine ønsker og aftales individuelt, dog med min. 2 ugentlige dage.
Lokation: Hasselager Centervej 9, Viby J. eller Fanøgade 15, København Ø.

Ansættelse: Efter aftale.

I AS3 ser vi forskellighed som en styrke, og hver dag arbejder vi for, at flere kommer ind på arbejdsmarkedet, færre falder ud, og at alle kan bidrage med deres bedste. Derfor ser vi frem til at høre fra alle kvalificerede kandidater uanset køn, alder, etnicitet og religion.

title: Project Development Coordinator
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY
I-Grace is a premier luxury residential construction and advisory firm with nearly four decades of experience delivering extraordinary homes for discerning clients. We are known for the depth of our partnerships with owners, architects, and designers, and for the care and precision we bring to every project we undertake.

At I-Grace, quality and integrity are not aspirations; they are expectations. We are dedicated to providing a seamless, personalized experience at every stage of the client journey, from the first conversation to long after construction is complete.

POSITION OVERVIEW
The Project Development Coordinator is a client-facing support role within I-Grace’s Project Development Team, reporting to the Senior Vice President and supporting the cultivation of new project opportunities and the maintenance of relationships with owners, architects, and designers across the full lifecycle of a project.

Working closely with the SVP and Project Development Manager, this individual provides essential coordination and administrative support across proposals, business development initiatives, events, and digital collateral. The Project Development Coordinator brings a proactive, detail-oriented approach that keeps the team organized and client relationships well supported.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & RELATIONSHIP SUPPORT
  • Act as an initial point of contact for clients, architects, and designers on new projects
  • Support the SVP and Manager in driving prospective projects forward, maintaining momentum and regular communication with relevant stakeholders
  • Attend networking, business development meetings, and events representing I-Grace
  • Coordinate intake, development, and documentation of new project opportunities and inquiries
  • Keep detailed notes and create reports on existing relationships and active prospects
PROPOSALS & PROJECT COORDINATION
  • Assist with the development of proposals and solutions to client problems, coordinating I-Grace resources for implementation
  • Support the creation of proposals and materials for Requests for Proposals (RFPs), including editing or drafting written copy, identifying relevant portfolio items, and creating graphics using InDesign, Creative Cloud, Bluebeam, and Excel
  • Contribute to defining and developing scopes of work and potential corresponding phases of work
  • Document and organize prospective project information including drawings, photographs, written reports, and scopes of work
  • Organize and submit prospect approval forms
INTERNAL COLLABORATION & ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT
  • Partner with all I-Grace teams to develop client touchpoints, gifting, seasonal outreaches, and engagement initiatives
  • Learn I-Grace’s portfolio and stay current on the scope of active projects and relationships
  • Assist the SVP in preparing for internal Business Development meetings; attend and take meeting notes
  • Provide administrative assistance including expenses, scheduling, filing, and travel arrangements
BRAND & DIGITAL PRESENCE
  • Assist with the organization and execution of events showcasing I-Grace
  • As directed, organize, edit, and update I-Grace digital collateral and digital portfolio
  • Manage and update the contact database
QUALIFICATIONS
  • Minimum 1–2 years’ experience in architecture, interior design, project management, or high-end residential private property management
  • BA in Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field; or equivalent construction experience
  • Experience working on high-end residential projects and/or within luxury brands
  • Ability to read and understand architectural drawing sets
  • Knowledge of technical architectural components, formal architectural styles, and corresponding phases of the design process
  • Proficiency in CAD, Bluebeam, and Adobe Creative Suite including InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record; preferred for client-facing travel throughout the New York area
THE IDEAL CANDIDATE
The ideal Project Development Coordinator is an organized, proactive professional who takes pride in delivering consistent, high-quality support across every aspect of the role. You are a strong communicator who listens well, follows through on every task, and understands that the quality of your work directly shapes the client experience.

You are comfortable wearing many hats, moving between administrative tasks and client-facing moments with equal care and attention to detail. You are eager to learn the business from the ground up, ask the right questions, and contribute meaningfully to a high-performing team.
You thrive in a fast-paced environment, take ownership of your responsibilities, and bring a positive, solutions-first attitude to everything you do. A “no job too small” mindset is not just something you understand; it is how you naturally operate.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
Salary: $75,000 – $100,000 annually, based on experience.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes:
  • Health insurance – medical with virtual visits and health advocate availability, dental and vision
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Generous paid time off
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance
  • HSA & FSA
  • $50,000 employer-paid life insurance
  • Commuter benefits
  • Legal Plan benefits
  • Identity & Fraud benefits
  • Pet Solution benefits
  • Employee referral bonus
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Home & Auto discounts and more
WHY JOIN US
This is an opportunity to build your career at the intersection of luxury, design, and construction in one of the world’s most dynamic residential markets. As Project Development Coordinator, you will gain hands-on experience across business development, client relations, and project coordination in Los Angeles, working alongside a team that sets the standard for excellence, integrity, and service in the industry.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ETHICAL STANDARDS
We are committed to fostering a professional environment grounded in respect, integrity, and equal opportunity. All employees are expected to uphold the highest ethical standards in all business practices and interactions.

title: AI Founding Engineer: RF Machine Learning (SIGINT) (f/m/d)
description:
Modern conflict runs on the electromagnetic spectrum. Every drone, every radio, every radar leaves a trace in it. Datacept builds cognitive electronic warfare systems that listen to that spectrum, understand what is in it, and act on it.

At the centre of this sits one capability: models that learn directly from raw I/Q data. Not from decoded protocols, not from hand-built feature extractors, but from the signal as it arrives at the antenna. This is how we handle emitters no system has seen before, in environments where new frequencies, new protocols, and new platforms appear faster than any rulebook can follow.

We are looking for engineers who have this capability.

Tasks

Your role

You are the founding engineer for RF machine learning at Datacept. You take responsibility for the cognitive core of our systems. The layer that turns received I/Q data into detection, classification, and understanding of emitters for SIGINT and COMINT missions.

We build the foundation model in a space where no foundation models exist. The domain of RF machine learning is just in its starting phase. Methods that work in audio and computer vision like self-supervised pretraining, learned representations, large pretrained backbones carry over to RF only if you understand why they work.

Second, the models have to run in the field. Our systems are deployed at ports, stadiums, critical infrastructure, and military sites, on hardware with real limits on compute and power.

Our cloud platform enables scalable processing of the largest RF datasets, here we can deploy the full power of the foundation model. We maintain one of the largest RF datasets in the world which is constantly growing.

Besides being the integral part of the engineering team you will directly work with the founders. You set the direction for RFML at Datacept, you make the architectural decisions, and as we grow you build the team around you.

What you will do

  • Design and train models that learn from raw I/Q recordings: detection, classification, and more
  • Research and implement ML methods from other domains to improve our data pipelines
  • Define how we evaluate: test sets, metrics, and scenarios that reflect real conditions such as domain shift between sensors, sites, and interference environments
  • Make models fit the hardware: Besides the foundation model we need expert models that are also compact and deployable on edge
  • Continuous testing of all pipelines in real world conditions provides continuous feedback
  • Integrate new data sources into our data platform

How we work

  • Fast learners over specific backgrounds. We care more about how quickly you pick up new skills than where you have worked before – the spectrum changes faster than any CV
  • Intellectual honesty. The right answer matters more than being right. You challenge assumptions, test ideas against real recordings, and pivot when the data says so
  • Adaptability. We are organised, but things change quickly – a new idea, a customer trial, a funding deadline. You find a way to make it work and balance short-term deliverables with the long-term architecture
  • Ownership of outcomes. You optimise your own time, focus on what matters to deliver quickly, and cut out inefficiencies. Nobody manages your calendar for you
  • Not building in a vacuum. You stay connected to hardware, to the founders, and to the customers at the sites we protect, so that all the pieces fit together in the field

Requirements

Skills

  • You have built and shipped ML systems that people depend on, preferably on signal-like data: audio, time series, sensor streams, images, video or ideally RF
  • You understand self-supervised learning well enough to explain why a given method works, and you can move ML ideas between domains with intent
  • You have strong mathematical fundamentals and are comfortable when the problem first has to be formulated before it can be solved
  • You go from idea to prototype to deployed model on your own, and you ask for help when it speeds things up rather than when you are stuck
  • You work well with few fixed structures and changing priorities
  • You are prepared for the intensity of a founding role: long and unconventional working hours, field trials, deployments
  • You want to contribute to Europe's technological sovereignty in a domain where it is currently lacking

Helpful, not required

Datacept GmbH, founded in Hamburg in 2025, builds cognitive electronic warfare systems for spectrum awareness, counter-drone defence, and the protection of critical infrastructure.
