description:
Position Details

School of Engineering

Location: University of Birmingham, Edgbaston, Birmingham UK

Grade 8 Full time starting salary is normally in the range £47,389 to £56,535 with potential progression once in post to £63,606

Grade 9 Full time starting salary is normally in the range £58,225 to £67,468 with potential progression once in post to £87,974

Grade: 8 or 9

Full Time, Permanent

Closing date: 12th October 2026

Background

This is an exciting time to join the University of Birmingham and advance your academic career. Following the creation of the School of Engineering in 2016, which brought together Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Electronic, Electrical and Systems Engineering, we are now entering the next phase of our development.

The School has invested significantly in both people and infrastructure, including our new £65m signature engineering building, the world-leading £26m National Buried Infrastructure Facility, and the £28m UK Rail Research and Innovation Network (UKRRIN). These facilities have strengthened our research capabilities and reinforced Birmingham’s position as a leading institution for engineering research and education.

Our strong culture of collaboration with industry ensures that pioneering research is translated rapidly into practice. This strength was recognised in the 2021 Research Excellence Framework (REF), where Engineering at Birmingham was ranked among the top ten institutions in the UK.

In line with these developments, we seek to appoint a highly research-active academic to join the Department of Civil Engineering. The Department of Civil Engineering undertakes research across geotechnical engineering; structures and fluids; resilient systems and climate action; and railway engineering, while working closely with other research groups across the School and the wider University.

For this recruitment we are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate ambition, innovation and leadership, and who undertake research and teaching in structural engineering. This could cover but is not limited to, research ranging in:
• Structural engineering and advanced structural design in infrastructure
• Modern methods of construction
• Innovative construction materials and structures
• Advanced computational modelling and statistical techniques in structural engineering
• Structural health monitoring, digital twins, and AI-assisted modelling or testing approaches
• Risk analysis, reliability or service life modelling.

The successful candidate will be expected to create and disseminate knowledge through initiating and conducting original research, through publication and through developing and delivering undergraduate, postgraduate and CPD programmes, as appropriate to the disciplinary area. In addition, the successful candidate will contribute to the Department and School through leadership, management and enterprise activities, as appropriate.

The successful candidate will hold a PhD (or equivalent qualification) in civil engineering, structural engineering or a closely related discipline. Industrial experience, either through working in or with industry would also be desirable. They will be expected to engage actively with external partners in academia, government and industry in the UK and internationally.
The School of Engineering is dedicated to upholding the principles of Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion (EDI) in all its endeavours, and we strongly encourage applications from individuals belonging to underrepresented groups.

Role Summary

The role holder will be based in Edgbaston. The key duties and responsibilities will include but not be limited to: giving lectures and seminars and supervising undergraduate / post-graduate students, course development and innovation, taking an active part in examinations, carrying out innovative research and writing papers on topics relevant to the specialist subject area (this will include journals, books and other material), and obtaining research grant funding.

The successful applicant will have a PhD in a relevant specialist subject area, as well as postdoctoral experience. We are looking for candidates who will actively contribute to our portfolio and community, through pursuit of research that will bring new opportunities, synergies, and interdisciplinary collaboration. The successful candidate will also have a track record in teaching at a higher education institution.

Appointments will be made at either an Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level please specify which role you are applying for in the application

Grade 9

description:
Kyocera has a temp-to-hire position for a Process Technician 1 at our San Diego, CA facility.

Candidates selected for hire will be hired through one of Kyocera’s approved staffing partners.

This position may lead to a direct hire offer with Kyocera International, Inc.

Pay is $ 18.00 /hour

With nearly 80,000 employees globally, Kyocera is a leading manufacturer of high-tech ceramics in various industries, including aerospace, automotive, medical applications, and semiconductor processing. Our innovative materials are found in everything from smartphones to space shuttles!



Exempt: No
Safety Sensitive: Yes

GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF POSITION

A Process Technician performs a variety of functions associated with manufacturing operations, including working with engineers and operators in set-up and calibration tasks, as well as performing rework and quality testing related to the production of parts, components, subassemblies and final product. Uses programs to collect and evaluate operating data to conduct in-line adjustments to parts, instruments or equipment. Updates and may assist in developing methods and procedures to control or modify the manufacturing process.

REQUIREMENTS

High school diploma or GED required.
0-1 years of related experience required in a manufacturing/production environment.
Ability to read, write and comprehend instructions in English.
Ability to add, subtract, multiply, divide all units of measure including common and decimal fractions.
Ability to use a microscope, depending on the specific function.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision and depth perception.
20/20 corrected vision may be required - varies by division
Willingness to wear PPE (examples: goggle, gloves, apron, finger cot, masks, and/or cleanroom apparel.
Ability to grab small parts or hand tools with hands.
Eligible to work in an ITAR environment


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Monitors and documents the operation of machines in a production environment. Maintains flow of production parts; reports inconsistencies, and suggests improvements in the production process.
  2. Troubleshoots complex or troublesome equipment, may work with facilities team or outside vendor or repair or modification.
  3. May run engineering tests prescribed by engineer and analyzes results. Perform periodic calibration.
  4. May recommend process improvements based on test and process results and experience. Troubleshoot machine set up issues.
  5. Visually inspects parts at required steps in the process with attention to detail, ensuring the parts are within specified tolerances. May disposition of reject parts and train operators and inspectors to improve efficiency.
  6. Maintains and orders/tracks tools according to safety and vendor recommendations. Will use measuring devices, such as micrometers, calipers.
  7. Participates in the 5S program.
  8. Knowledgeable of Excel and able to accurately enter data into spreadsheets and create graphs.
  9. Complies with applicable requirements of Kyocera International, Inc. policy, ISO 9000, ISO 14001 requirements, ITAR regulations.
  10. May setup/program production or test machinery.
  11. Reads specifications and mechanical drawings.
  12. May assign and check work of lower-level technicians and operators. Perform the duties or an operator or material handler on occasion as needed.

Perform any other related duties as required or assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty mentioned satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

PHYSICAL ACTIVITIES

While performing the functions of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to work near moving mechanical parts, work in high, precarious places, fumes or airborne particles.

title: Principal Layout Engineer
description:
NXP’s Industrial & IoT Edge solutions range from the smallest MCUs to very high-performance processors to provide real-time insights and efficient automation when performance matters most. NXP’s advanced portfolio of edge processing solutions lets developers explore their most innovative ideas with confidence, enabling applications across the autonomous home, industrial automation, and personal electronics.

NXP is building new teams in Catania to create high impact microcontrollers (MCU) as part of NXP’s intelligent AI at the Edge.   • Develop the expertise of the team and drive innovation

  • Provide accurate estimates on area, performance and timeline

  • Drive the team to meet aggressive schedules without sacrificing quality

  • Work closely with analog design engineers to ensure seamless integration of layout and design

  • Develop and maintain layout scripts and automation tools

Your Profile

  • MSEE/BSEE or working equivalent

  • 10+ years’ experience in the layout of analog blocks and systems

  • Solid fundamentals of transistor level integrated circuits and device physics.

  • Knowledge of layout matching and parasitics, latch-up, ESD, etc.

  • Rigorous and methodical with good analytical skills for debugging issues in design and on silicon

  • Proficiency in analog layout tools, such as Cadence Virtuoso, Siemens Calibre ..

  • Experience with signal chain and power design layouts

title: Digital Production Designer
description:
The Digital Production Designer is responsible for conceptualizing, designing, and producing high-quality visual assets and user experiences across Desert Financial Credit Union’s digital properties and deliverables, including the website, email, digital advertising, and other member-facing digital experiences. This role owns digital creative execution and serves as a key contributor to the look, feel, usability, and effectiveness of the credit union’s digital presence.

This position translates marketing strategy and brand standards into compelling, conversion-focused designs that engage members and prospects at every stage of their journey. It blends creative craft with a digital-first, mobile-first, user-centered performance mindset, ensuring every asset and experience is on-brand, intuitive, and optimized for the channel it lives in.

This is a hands-on role responsible for both design production and cross-functional collaboration. The Digital Production Designer ensures that monthly creative deliverables are published on schedule.

What you will do here:

Digital Design and Production

Design and produce digital assets across owned and paid channels, including but not limited to website pages, email templates, digital ads, and online banking ads

Translate campaign briefs, marketing strategy, and brand guidelines into polished, on-brand visual designs that drive engagement and conversion

Apply UI/UX best practices to design intuitive, user-centered digital experiences that improve usability and conversion

Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and mockups to visualize and validate design concepts before production

Create responsive, mobile-first designs optimized for performance across devices, screen sizes, and email/web rendering environments

Prepare, optimize, and hand off assets for development and deployment, ensuring proper file formats, specs, and quality across platforms

Manage digital advertising in online and mobile banking platforms

Leverage AI-powered design and productivity tools to scale creative output, improve efficiency, and accelerate speed to market across digital deliverables

Use performance data and analytics to inform creative decisions and strategy

Collaboration and Project Execution

Partner with web developers, lifecycle/marketing automation, designers, content, and channel strategy teams to deliver design assets that are production-ready and technically feasible

Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and incorporate user feedback and usability findings into design iterations

Manage and organize digital design files and assets within the team’s digital asset management and file systems

Design Systems and Brand Consistency

Build and maintain reusable design components, UI patterns, templates, and layouts that support speed to market and brand consistency across digital touchpoints

Ensure all creative adheres to brand standards, legal/compliance requirements, and disclosure guidelines for financial services marketing

Design with accessibility in mind, applying inclusive design principles and supporting accessibility standards across digital deliverables

Testing, Optimization, and Iteration

Support A/B testing and experimentation by designing creative variants and iterating based on performance data and insights

Apply usability testing and user research findings to continuously improve the member experience across digital properties

Stay current on digital design, UI/UX, and accessibility trends, tools, and best practices, bringing fresh ideas to elevate the member experience

Perform other job duties as required.

What you will need:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communication, Business, or another related field preferred.

Equivalent combination of experience and education required.

4+ years of professional design experience, with a focus on digital deliverables (web, email, digital ads) and UI/UX design required.

Manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment required.

Proficiency with Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) required.

Portfolio demonstrating strong digital design and UI/UX skills across multiple channels and formats required.

Experience designing user-centered digital experiences, including wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and responsive web/landing page design required.

Working knowledge of designing for digital environments, including responsive/mobile-first design and email/web constraints required.

Strong understanding of layout, typography, color, visual hierarchy, and UI/UX principles required.

Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment required.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with marketing, web, and creative teams required.

Experience with prototyping and usability testing tools and methods preferred.

Experience designing within a CMS and/or marketing automation platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Optimizely, HubSpot) preferred.

Familiarity with basic HTML/CSS as it relates to email and web design preferred.

Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and inclusive design practices preferred.

Experience with motion graphics and/or animation preferred.

Understanding of digital marketing and conversion principles, including A/B testing and design optimization preferred.

Experience working in a regulated industry (e.g., financial services) preferred.

title: Counsel, Legal, HBO and HBO Max Productions
description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Your New Role

This position assesses and manages legal risk and handles a wide array of production-related agreements for HBO and HBO Max domestic and internationally produced, critically-acclaimed and award-winning original scripted programming during pre-production, production, and post-production under the supervision of more senior project attorneys (e.g., VP, Senior Director, Director).

Under the supervision of more senior project attorneys (e.g., VP, Senior Director, Director), the Counsel drafts and negotiates time-sensitive production or post-production-related agreements, including casting director and department head agreements; location and lease agreements; artwork releases and clip/photo licenses; confidentiality/non-disclosure agreements; nudity/simulated sex riders; and visual effects agreements. Additionally, the Counsel: assists senior project attorneys with documentation related to production incentives and tax credits for both domestic and international productions; conducts training sessions with intimacy coordinators regarding nudity/simulated sex protocol and workflow; assists with overflow drafting of above-the-line agreements for projects in development or production; updates template agreements and handles other special projects as assigned by VP and/or SVP, Head of Legal, including negotiating studio, security, stock footage, catering and other master agreements for use across multiple productions..

On international productions, the Counsel will liaise with local counsel regarding production-related agreements, including reviewing proposed templates to ensure they comport with HBO/HBO Max policies and required legal language.

It is an essential function of this position that the work be performed partially from the Company’s offices, i.e., in office for no fewer than three (3) days per week.

Your Role Accountabilities

  • Draft and negotiate agreements for approximately 4-5 projects in active pre-production, principal photography, or post production.
  • Liaise with and supervise local counsel on international productions with respect to production-related agreements, including reviewing proposed templates to ensure they comport with HBO/HBO Max policies.
  • Assist with overflow drafting of above-the-line agreements for projects in development and production.
  • Update template agreements and handle other special projects as assigned by VP and/or Chief Counsel.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum 2 years relevant legal experience as a practicing lawyer in a law firm, in-house legal department of a media company or government agency, or judicial clerkship.
  • J.D. from an accredited law school and an outstanding academic record.
  • Must be licensed to practice law and a member in good standing of the California or New York Bar.
  • Must be able to analyze, draft, and negotiate contracts.
  • Must have sufficient experience as a practicing lawyer to advise production personnel and management of legal implications of production decisions.
  • Must be able to confidently research legal questions and communicate resulting analysis effectively to all levels of corporate and production staff.
  • Must be able to write in a well-organized, concise, and precise manner.
  • Knowledge of copyright, defamation, trademark, defamation and privacy laws.

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, skill set, experience, and/or performance. title: Senior Digital Design - MCU
description:
NXP’s Industrial & IoT Edge solutions range from the smallest MCUs to very high-performance processors to provide real-time insights and efficient automation when performance matters most. NXP’s advanced portfolio of edge processing solutions lets developers explore their most innovative ideas with confidence, enabling applications across the autonomous home, industrial automation, and personal electronics.

NXP is building new teams in Catania to create high impact micro-controllers (MCU) as part of NXP’s intelligent AI at the Edge. This team will include a wide range of engineering talent from analog to SOC digital design. Full product development local will product world class products at a world class pace.

This team will include all key engineering disciplines in Analog and Digital Design, Architecture definition, Verification, DfT and Physical Design to produce high performance and quality products.

Your Responsibilities.

  • Lead and execute the full digital IC design flow for complex System-on-Chip (SOC), including specification definition, architectural design, RTL coding (Verilog/SystemVerilog), synthesis, static timing analysis (STA), formal verification, and power analysis. Contribute to design for testability (DFT) implementation and verification.
  • Collaborate closely with analog, mixed-signal, and software teams to define interfaces, optimize system performance and ensure seamless integration.
  • Develop and implement innovative digital architectures and design methodologies to meet challenging performance, power, and area targets.
  • Perform comprehensive design verification using simulation tools, formal verification techniques, and hardware emulation.
  • Participate in post-silicon validation and debug activities, identifying and resolving issues to ensure product quality.
  • Mentor junior engineers, provide technical guidance, and contribute to continuous improvement of design processes and methodologies.
  • Generate detailed design documentation, including specifications, test plans, and design reviews.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in digital IC design methodology shared in the team.

Your Profile.

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in digital IC design.
  • Expertise in Verilog/SystemVerilog for RTL design and verification.
  • Proven experience with industry-standard EDA tools for synthesis, STA (e.g., Synopsys Design Compiler, Cadence Genus, Primetime), formal verification (e.g., Synopsys Formality), and simulation (e.g., VCS, QuestaSim).
  • Strong understanding of digital design principles, clock domain crossing (CDC) issues, power integrity, and low-power design techniques.
  • Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, Perl, Tcl) for automation and design flow optimization.
  • Familiarity with mixed-signal integration challenges and verification methodologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
  • Ability to take initiative, work independently, and lead technical discussions.

title: Senior AI Security Engineer
description:
Wilson Sonsini is the premier legal advisor to technology, life sciences, and other growth enterprises worldwide. We represent companies at every stage of development, from entrepreneurial start-ups to multibillion-dollar global corporations, as well as the venture firms, private equity firms, and investment banks that finance and advise them. The firm has approximately 1,100 attorneys in 17 offices: 13 in the U.S., two in China, and two in Europe. Our broad spectrum of practices and entrepreneurial spirit allow exceptional opportunities for professional achievement and career growth.

Wilson Sonsini is looking for a Senior AI Security Engineer to join the Security Operations team. The Senior AI Security Engineer, under the direction of the Director, Security Engineering and Operations, sits at the frontier of AI infrastructure and enterprise security — a rare opportunity to architect how one of the world’s leading law firms builds and deploys AI systems with security and trust at their core. This role is designed for someone who understands how models are attacked and how to harden them, and who is energized by the challenge of securing AI-native workflows in a legal environment. You will own the firm’s AI security engineering function: designing secure AI pipelines, evaluating MCP server integrations and agentic architectures, and serving as the technical authority for AI security across the firm’s growing ecosystem of AI-powered tools and platforms.

This position is available as a fully virtual opportunity.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate on designing secure-by-default patterns for LLM integration, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and MCP server deployments across firm systems
  • Lead security architecture reviews for MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations — evaluating tool definitions, server trust boundaries, prompt injection attack surfaces, and tool call authorization models before any MCP server is connected to firm data or workflows
  • Build and operate AI threat modeling and red teaming capabilities — developing adversarial test suites for prompt injection, jailbreaking, data exfiltration via LLMs, model inversion, and supply chain attacks on AI/ML dependencies
  • Engineer secure data pipelines for AI systems — implementing data loss prevention controls, confidentiality boundaries, and least-privilege access patterns for LLMs interacting with firm data
  • Partner with IT, Information Security, and practice group leaders to evaluate and approve AI vendor integrations
  • Develop and maintain security standards and engineering guardrails for AI development across the firm — including secure coding practices for AI-adjacent code, model output validation, hallucination detection controls, and audit logging for AI-assisted attorney workflows
  • Perform related duties as assigned by supervisor
  • Maintain compliance with all company policies and procedures

Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, cybersecurity, or a related technical field required
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, cloud security, or AI/ML engineering, with at least 2 years focused on AI system security — building, breaking, or hardening LLM-based or agentic AI systems in production environments
  • Hands-on familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) — including how MCP servers are structured, how tool definitions are exposed to models, how to audit MCP server codebases for injection vulnerabilities, and how to implement secure MCP deployment patterns in enterprise environments
  • Demonstrated experience with AI threat modeling — including OWASP LLM Top 10, adversarial ML attack techniques (prompt injection, jailbreaking, data poisoning, model extraction), and practical mitigations that work in production rather than just in theory
  • Solid command of cloud security fundamentals (AWS, Azure, or GCP) as applied to AI workloads — including secure API gateway configuration, secrets management for model API keys, network isolation for AI inference endpoints, and identity-aware proxy patterns for LLM access control
  • Experience securing agentic AI systems — understanding how multi-step reasoning pipelines, tool-using agents, and autonomous AI workflows introduce novel attack surfaces, and how to implement guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and scoped permissions that prevent runaway or adversarially manipulated agents
  • Experience in a law firm is a plus — more important is the ability to communicate complex AI security concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including attorneys and firm leadership who need to make informed decisions without a security background
  • Relevant certifications (OSCP, GREM, Azure Security Engineer, or similar) are valued; more important is demonstrated hands-on work — a strong GitHub profile, original research, or CTF wins speaks louder than credentials alone
  • Intellectual curiosity and a builder’s mindset — this role is for someone who gets energized by the pace of AI development and who stays current not just by reading about AI security but by experimenting with models, tools, and attack techniques firsthand
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where the AI landscape shifts faster than any governance framework can keep up — able to make sound risk judgments under ambiguity and bring stakeholders along with you
  • Self-directed and resourceful — able to build a program from the ground up, prioritize intelligently across competing demands, and drive work to completion without waiting to be told exactly how
The primary location for this job posting is in Palo Alto, but other locations may be listed. The actual base pay offered will depend upon a variety of factors, including but not limited to the selected candidate’s qualifications, years of relevant experience, level of education, professional certifications and licenses, and work location. The anticipated pay range for this position is as follows:Palo Alto, New York, San Francisco: $163,200 - $220,800 per year.Austin, Boston, Boulder, Century City, Delaware, Los Angeles, Salt Lake City, San Diego, Seattle, Washington, D.C., and all other locations: $147,050 - $198,950 per year.

The compensation for this position may include a discretionary year-end merit bonus based on performance. We offer a highly competitive salary and benefits package.

Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview
In 1971, Yale University established Yale Health to provide health services to its facility, staff and students through a multidisciplinary health maintenance organization located on campus. Yale Health has more than 50,000 members including students, staff, faculty and their families who come from every state in the country and almost every country in the world. With over 50 years of service to the Yale community, our state-of-the-art facility at 55 Lock Street, is where our members receive most of their care from our 150+ providers. It is a 144,000 square foot medical facility with over 90 exam rooms, an Acute Care Department, a 15-bed inpatient facility with two negative pressure rooms, a diagnostic imaging suite including MR and CT scan, x-ray and ultrasound and a full-service retail pharmacy.

The RN, Occupational Health provides professional nursing care in the Occupational Health Department at Yale Health. Facilitate an Occupational Health program conducting employee health screenings and triage for work-related injuries and exposures. Plan, implement, and evaluate all assigned patient care functions in collaboration with department clinicians. Promote occupational health and work safety improvements., Work closely operational and medical leadership, University departments, Occupational health vendors, building services.

Responsibilities include:

  • Coordinate patient care and perform triage of work-related injuries and exposures and assure proper referrals are coordinated. Assume responsibility for incoming calls that require clinical decisions and for follow-up patient phone calls that require clinical evaluation.

  • Perform patient rooming, vital signs, point-of-care testing, EKGs, and additional applicable screenings.

  • Perform ancillary testing including the administration of immunizations and ordering of titers in accordance with established policies and procedures as well as local, state, and national regulations.

  • Provide assistance to workers compensation designee with case management for employees. Coordinate plan of care with providers, worker's compensation representatives and the employee.

  • Plan, implement, and conduct annual health screenings for Yale Health and the University.

  • Assist and conduct animal handler clearances for employees at the University level.

  • Assure appropriate documentation of patient encounters and provide administrative support in EPIC, Workday, Health On Track when applicable, and other University systems.

  • Provide input in the development of policies and procedures in collaboration with Occupational Health leadership to ensure standards meet JCAHO, OSHA, CMS, CDC and other nationally recognized Occupational health organizations.

  • Provide updates and appropriately adjusts modifications as requirements evolve.

  • Participate in investigations of infectious outbreaks in the organization and at times, with the CDC.

  • Participate in Quality Improvement measures and activities.

Schedule: Full-time, 37.50 hours; Generally scheduled M-F, 8:30 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. Occasional evenings, weekends, holidays/recess periods may also be required.

2. Minimum of three years of clinical experience in an occupational healthcare setting, including strong clinical assessment, telephone triage, critical thinking, and troubleshooting skills.

3. Demonstrated initiative, accuracy, attention to detail, and ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

4. Proficiency with electronic health records and healthcare technology, including Epic, EMR systems, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, Excel, Salesforce, and other computerized databases.

5. Current CPR certification and a demonstrated record of excellent attendance, punctuality, reliability, and professional accountability

Experience with public health initiatives. Occupational Health RN certification, or eligible and obtained within the first 12 months of job.

title: CISA - Geospatial Data Engineer

cFocus Software Incorporated is seeking a Geospatial Data Engineer to own the data backbone of a national-level infrastructure analysis capability for DHS CISA. You will acquire, validate, structure, and govern the federal telecommunications datasets that power the Government's infrastructure mapping platform — designing the data architecture that analysts and national decision-makers depend on during emergencies.

Required Qualifications

  • Active, final Top Secret/SCI clearance granted by the U.S. Government; U.S. citizenship

  • Advanced SQL and enterprise geodatabase administration

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
About Cinder

Cinder is the mission-critical infrastructure that keeps the world's most important digital platforms true to what they stand for. The internet has always been abused by bad actors, and AI is making it exponentially worse, driving fraud, abuse, and manipulation at a scale and speed no human team can fight alone. Cinder gives platforms one command center to fight back: to write and enforce policy, deploy AI agents against abuse in real time, investigate threats, file NCMEC reports, and prove their safety programs are working.

Our customers are some of the largest internet platforms in the world. The decisions made in our software directly determine what stays up, what comes down, and how users are treated.

We're a small, fast-moving team backed by Accel and Y Combinator. We care about being intentional, direct, and deeply focused on solving real customer problems.

Why this role

Cinder's product surface is expanding fast: new agent-facing workflows, multiple product lines, and a growing brand and GTM footprint. We're building out design to match, and we're looking for a second senior designer to own significant surfaces end to end.

You'll operate as a co-lead and thought partner with our current designer. You'll take full ownership of your own surfaces, shape design direction and craft standards together, and give each other real, two-way critique. We expect you to get fluent in Cinder fast, so you can operate independently and make your own thoughtful decisions on Cinder design. This is a chance to help define how design works at Cinder from an early stage, not just execute inside an existing structure.

What you'll work on

  • Own end-to-end design for assigned surfaces, from framing the problem to shipped UI, working directly with product and engineering.

  • Run discovery with product: talk to Trust & Safety customers and users, and turn what you hear into design direction and Linear tickets an engineer can pick up and build from.

  • Prototype at high fidelity to pressure-test flows and align engineering before build starts.

  • Contribute to and help maintain our design system as the product scales.

  • Take on design work beyond core product when it counts. This could include brand, GTM, decks, website, and marketing. We're a small design team, so we're looking for real appetite to proactively own broader design projects, not just tolerate them.

  • Sit in critique with our design lead. Give and take direct feedback, and help hold the bar on craft.

What we're looking for

  • Strong visual and graphic design craft: the eye to judge quality, and the ability to produce clean work without leaning on AI tools.

  • 6+ years designing software at senior to staff level, with real depth on technical products built for expert users.

  • Expert in Figma: wireframing, flows, prototyping, and production-grade delivery.

  • Fluent with AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude, Codex) for designing and prototyping, not just experimenting with them.

  • A high tolerance for ambiguity. You can create your own clarity and make calls without a finished PRD or research.

  • Proactive by default. You flag and fix design debt before anyone asks you to.

  • Comfortable talking to customers directly and turning what you hear into product opportunities.

  • Strong systems thinker. You see how changes in one part of the product affect the rest

  • Experience building or maintaining a design system, including component libraries or patterns.

  • Front-end fluency: comfort prototyping in code and picking up interim engineer-designer work.

  • Experience designing SaaS, especially multi-product platforms and information-dense interfaces.

  • Empathy for the trust & safety problem space.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing for AI or agentic products.

  • Motion design skills or a sense for delightful detail.

  • Comfort with website CMS builders for brand and marketing support.

  • Appetite to help build design team culture and rituals from scratch: crits, standups, lunch-and-learns.

  • A design background or lineage different from what's already on the team. We're intentional about building that kind of range.

Location & Benefits

We're based in NYC and would relocate the right person for this role. We believe in working together in person and hold at least two all-company events per year. We offer health, vision & dental benefits, a 401(k) plan with employer matching, fully paid commuter benefits, and a fully stocked office with paid lunch and dinner.

title: Digital Verification Engineer
description:
Digital Verification Engineer

Location: Milan, Italy – NXP Semiconductors

We are looking for a motivated Digital Verification Engineer to join our R&D team in Milan. The successful candidate will contribute to the verification of complex mixed-signal ICs targeting automotive and industrial applications. Working closely with design, system, architecture and validation teams, the engineer will be responsible for planning, developing and executing verification activities to ensure high-quality silicon delivery.

This position is ideal for candidates with solid verification experience who are ready to take ownership of verification tasks and contribute to the development of advanced automotive semiconductor products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute verification plans for digital IPs, subsystems and SoC-level designs.
  • Create and maintain UVM/SystemVerilog-based verification environments.
  • Develop reusable verification components, sequences, scoreboards and coverage models.
  • Perform functional verification using simulation and regression environments.
  • Analyze simulation results, identify root causes of failures and drive issue resolution with design teams.
  • Define and monitor functional and code coverage metrics.
  • Contribute to verification methodology improvements and automation initiatives.
  • Support mixed-signal verification activities in collaboration with analog and AMS teams.
  • Participate in design reviews and technical discussions throughout the development cycle.
  • Contribute to the achievement of project quality, schedule and automotive requirements.

Required Skills

  • Master's Degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering or related field.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in digital verification of ASIC or SoC designs.
  • Solid knowledge of SystemVerilog and UVM methodology.
  • Experience with constrained-random verification techniques.
  • Familiarity with functional coverage, assertions and regression management.
  • Good understanding of digital design fundamentals and RTL concepts.
  • Experience with industry-standard EDA verification tools.
  • Good debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in automotive semiconductor development.
  • Knowledge of low-power verification methodologies.
  • Understanding of mixed-signal IC development flows.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, Perl or Tcl.
  • Experience with formal verification techniques.
  • Knowledge of communication protocols commonly used in automotive applications (SPI, I2C, CAN, UART).

title: Payment Integrity Analyst II
description:

  • Comfortable interfacing with clients and the C-Suite
  • Demonstrate ability to manage multiple projects, set priorities and adhere to committed schedule
  • Strong interpersonal skills and adaptive communication style, complex problem solving skills, drive for results, innovative
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven track record of delivering concrete results in strategic projects/programs

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

PAY RANGE:

Pay Range: $66,941 – $101,258

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

About CERIS

CERIS, a division of CorVel Corporation, a certified Great Place to Work® Company, offers incremental value, experience, and a sincere dedication to our valued partners. title: Skötare till barn- och ungdomspsykiatriska avdelningen
description:
I Region Kronoberg arbetar vi för att människor i länet ska kunna leva ett tryggt och hållbart liv. Varje dag möter vi kronobergarna i vården, i kollektivtrafiken och i arbetet med länets utveckling. Här tas idéer tillvara, det finns stora möjligheter till utveckling och ett arbetsklimat som är välkomnande, öppet och präglat av vänlighet.

Specialistpsykiatrin barn, unga och vuxna bedriver en kunskapsstyrd och specialiserad psykiatrisk vård i samverkan med patienten, närstående och andra vårdgivare inom och utanför Region Kronoberg. En god arbetsmiljö med motiverade och kompetenta medarbetare är en förutsättning för att vi ska lyckas med vårt uppdrag. Verksamheten är organiserad i olika enheter där personalen arbetar utifrån integrerade team, öppenvård och heldygnsvård vilka följer patienten i hela vårdkedjan. Vårt uppdrag är att bedriva specialistpsykiatri för patienter med allvarlig psykisk sjukdom, komplex problematik och ofta samsjuklighet. Vi vill skapa goda förutsättningar för att våra patienter ska få effektiv behandling av bästa möjliga kompetens som leder till förbättringar för patienten.

Specialistpsykiatrin för barn och unga bedriver länsövergripande psykiatrisk vård på specialistnivå i Kronobergs län och vänder sig till barn och ungdomar under 18 år. Verksamheten som ingår i Specialistpsykiatrin barn, unga och vuxna har mottagningar i Ljungby och Växjö samt akutverksamhet med mottagning och avdelning i Växjö. 

Vi söker nu två skötare till barn- och ungdomspsykiatriska avdelningen och vi söker dig som vill vara delaktig i vårt fortsatta arbete i att utveckla Region Kronobergs barnpsykiatri framåt. 
Är du vår nästa kollega?

2 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
På vårdavdelningen för barn och unga, arbetar du nära tillsammans med sjuksköterskor och läkare i team. Som skötare på avdelningen har du varierande arbetsuppgifter där du deltar i ronder samt är med i planering av vård och behandling. Du är närmaste kontaktperson för patienten och familjen, sitter med som matstöd, har sedvanligt omvårdnadsarbete och anordnar olika aktiviteter för patienterna. Avdelningen har fem platser och här vårdas barn och ungdomar med olika psykiatriska sjukdomstillstånd tillsammans med vårdnadshavare. Du arbetar utifrån ett helhetsperspektiv med både psykiatrisk och somatisk sjukvård.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som är utbildad skötare alternativt undersköterska. Du är engagerad i ditt arbete och bidrar till ett gott arbetsklimat. 
Som person är du flexibel, har lätt för att ställa om till rådande situationer och tycker om när din dag är innehållsrik och varierande och har lätt för att sätta dig in i andras situation, lyssnar, förstår och visar hänsyn.
Du har en naturlig förmåga att skapa kontakt och bygga förtroende hos både patienter och deras vårdnadshavare och möter människor med värme, engagemang och lyhördhet.
Det är även viktigt att du har en trygghet i din profession och vana av att arbeta självständigt och kan göra egna bedömningar.

Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.
I samband med rekryteringen begär vi utdrag ur brotts- och misstankeregistret. Vi önskar därför att du i din ansökan anger ditt fullständiga personnummer.

Löneform: Månadslön.
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
Arbetstid: Schema.

Frågor om specifika jobb besvaras av den rekryterare eller kontaktperson som anges i annonsen. För att skicka in din ansökan, klicka på ansökningslänken i annonsen.

Informationen du anger kan komma att lämnas ut avseende regler för allmän handling enligt offentlighetsprincipen och dina uppgifter behandlas enligt Dataskyddsförordningen (GDPR).

Kontakta ansvarig rekryterare hos Region Kronoberg vid skyddad identitet för vidare information om hur du ansöker och hantering av dina personuppgifter.

Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringstjänster i samband med den här annonsen.

title: Program Planner
description:
At Janicki Industries, we turn complex ideas into real-world solutions through advanced engineering and manufacturing. Our teams design and build innovative structures, tooling, and systems that support industries including aerospace, space, defense, marine, and architecture.

Across every role, from engineers and technicians to operations and support teams, our people help solve challenging problems, push the limits of design and manufacturing, and create solutions that make a lasting impact.

This position is located in Bellingham, Washington State.

DEPARTMENT SUMMARY

The Program Planner supports Project Management and Operations in the design, creation and execution of project schedules and budgets using SAP Project Management software. This position provides support to Project Management, Operations Management and Accounting by performing a variety of requested tasks, project schedule performance, critical path analysis, job cost tracking and global/project performance.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create and maintains project schedules in SAP using templates and calculators or based on SOW, drawings/ proposals. Enters WBS / activity details, resource loading/budgeting, activity durations, logic and relationships. Defines the critical path for projects and monitors schedule and budget performance
  • Responsible for keeping project plans and schedule accurate in SAP including but not limited to adding activities, adjusting budgets, adjusting schedule, and changing work centers
  • Communicate with PMs and Operations Managers about schedule needs including, but not limited to flowing down project information from one part to another, linking work products and documents to activities, making PDFs of documents, and running work orders when needed
  • Create reports about project cost and Schedule performance
  • Meet with Project Managers, Program Management, and customers to provide schedule support for large projects
  • Field daily schedule and budget questions and concerns from Program Management and Operations Management; understand our business systems, procedures, and processes and how they are integrated
  • Keep up to date with the activities associated with each process we perform; must possess knowledge of the materials and scheduled duration that will be needed for these processes and an understanding of each cell’s capability. This involves visiting each cell, when possible, to watch the work in progress, learn about the processes, and aid in updating the status of each project
  • Invoicing – Compiling milestone costs according to contract requirements.
  • Sales Support – Gathering information to assist in the generation of sales proposals
  • Estimating – Reviewing project requirements during the sales process and generating cost tables
  • Perform other duties as assigned
  • Behavior: The incumbent must work well under pressure, meeting and completing multiple deadlines. The incumbent shall, at all times, demonstrate cooperative behavior with colleagues and supervisors.
  • Being at work on time and maintaining good attendance is a condition of employment and is an essential function of the job.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must be able to work independently and at a fast pace, climb stairs while carrying a vacuum and supplies, and have the ability to lift up to 25 lbs.
  • Minimum requirement for all positions is a high school diploma or GED
  • Must have excellent communication skills, both verbal and written in the English language
  • Due to our ITAR and EAR regulations, applicants must be a US Citizen or of Legal Permanent Resident Status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b (a) (3).

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

  • A bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Manufacturing Engineering/Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Business Management, or a similar field is preferred.
  • Previous experience with scheduling software such as Microsoft Project, Primavera or SAP. SAP experience is considered a strong plus. PMP and previous ERP experience preferred.
  • Equivalent work experience in manufacturing, logistics and production systems will be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Must have effective verbal and written communication skills in the English language
  • Must be familiar with a variety of the fields' concepts, practices, and procedures; must be able to rely on extensive experience, problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.

DETAILED WAGE INFORMATION

Wage range for this role is between $83,000 - $115,000/year, plus a discretionary bonus, 401(k) matching, vacation, and health benefits. Employees can also receive additional pay for off-shifts, off-site work, and access pay. The range provided is Janicki’s estimate of the base compensation for this role. Actual amount offered will be based on job-related and non-discriminatory factors such as experience, location, education, training, skills, and abilities

BENEFITS

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance with employer contribution
  • Disability insurance as well as Life/AD&D insurance
  • HSA (Health Savings Account) with employer contribution and FSA (Flexible Savings Account)
  • 401k with employer matching
  • Paid time off and paid holidays (including two floating holidays)
  • Education reimbursement program
  • Several shift options
  • Premium pay for off-shifts
  • Premium pay for security clearance if applicable

Not sure that you’ll be the perfect fit for this role? You should still apply! We’ll review your application for other opportunities. We are always on the lookout for talented people!

By applying for this job, you are expressing interest in this position and could be considered for other career opportunities where similar skills and requirements have been identified as a match. Should this match be identified, you may be contacted for this and future openings.

Janicki Industries is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Janicki Industries does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, age, retaliation, veteran/military service status, or any other legally protected status. Janicki is proud to be a military friendly employer.

Applicants or employees wishing to view a copy of Janicki Industries’ Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should notify the Human Resources Department at (360) 404-1997.

As a federal government contractor and a recipient of federal funding, Janicki is required to abide by federal drug testing requirements (including preemployment drug testing for cannabis). Additionally, because of Janicki’s work on aerospace products and the high volume of safety sensitive positions, Janicki takes the safety of its employees very seriously and requires that employees pass a preemployment drug test prior to starting employment.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Must be at least 21 years of age.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred but can be substituted for experience.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to perform these operations using units of American money and weight measurement, volume, and distance. Must be able to efficiently and accurately count money and gaming chips and make a change. Possess the ability to operate an adding machine and have basic computer skills.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply commonsense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Team members must be able to qualify for licenses and permits required by federal, state, and local regulations.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here represent those that must be met by a team member to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the team member is regularly required to stand and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls. The team member frequently is required to reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and peripheral vision.

The team member must regularly lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds, and must have the ability to push, pull, reach, bend, twist, stoop, stack, crouch, kneel and balance when performing job duties in varying work areas such as confined spaces.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Team member will be exposed to an environment containing unrestricted secondhand tobacco smoke.

title: Metabolic Specialist
description:
Position Summary

The Metabolic Specialist provides technical leadership and training to Personal Trainers, Metabolic Technicians and members in the areas of metabolic testing and heart rate monitors. They consistently provide metabolic testing and heart rate monitor services coinciding with company values and vendor guidelines. They are responsible for ensuring Personal Training department markets promote and implement metabolic testing and heart rate monitor programs along with educational seminars for members that compliment all exercise programming.   • Communicates company values and vendor guidelines for performing metabolic measurements with scientific accuracy and applies heart rate monitor products with technical expertise to Personal Training departments
  • Develops and maintains safe, professional, and comprehensive metabolic programs specific to member satisfaction with test procedures, test interpretation, test results, and cardiovascular programming
  • Oversees quality assurance checks on metabolic testing and heart rate monitor product administration
  • Conducts, coordinates and prepares educational seminars related to metabolism, heart rate training, and heart rate monitor products that are consistent and factually based adhering to company values and vendor guidelines
  • Oversees metabolic programs and heart rate monitor products sale’s performance including product mix, supply cost, cost of goods sold, and pricing integrity
  • Monitors, tracks, and reports revenue performances of metabolic programs and heart rate monitor products
  • Communicates financial performances of metabolic programs and heart rate monitor products to Regional Metabolic Specialist
  • Assists and oversees the quality of metabolic program education and heart rate monitor product education for the Personal Training department according to company values and vendor guidelines
  • Implements all corporate communication regarding standard operating procedures and policies at club level regarding metabolic programs and heart rate monitor products
  • Attends meetings and teleconference calls regarding metabolic programs and heart rate monitor products

Position Requirements

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in Health and Fitness

  • CPR and AED Certified
  • 2 advanced certifications or equivalent education
  • Knowledge of Heart Rate monitors, Polar Tri-Fit and ProTrainer 5 software and Anaerobic Threshold testing
  • Ability to stand, walk, reach, climb and lift up to 50 pounds

Preferred Requirements

  • Cardiovascular Athlete
  • 1 year of experience with heart rate training and heart rate monitor products
  • 1 to 2 years of experience performing metabolic tests and test interpretation
  • Degree in Kinesiology, Sports Medicine or other related field

Life Time is a place for everyone. title: CAC Tech
description:
The CAC Test Technician is responsible for executing controlled tests of energetic products used in oilfield applications, specifically within simulated downhole configurations that replicate velocity, impact, pressure, temperature, and fluid conditions encountered in actual wellbores. The technician ensures that all testing is carried out safely, accurately, and in accordance with internal procedures and industry regulations. Products tested may include cutters, detonators, boosters, detonating cord, power charges and shaped charges used in perforating systems.

Job Description and Responsibilities:

  • Complies with all applicable work instructions and HSE/QA ISO procedures. Job may include performing work safely and efficiently around moving parts.
  • Prepare and execute energetic tests in engineering developed downhole simulations.
  • Assemble test configurations to test in electronic firing systems, pressure containment vessels and instrumentation.
  • Set up and operate data acquisition systems, pressure transducers, temperature loggers and x-ray machine (as applicable).
  • Accurately measure and document product performance and behaviors post-test within the Quality Control (QC) database provided in real-time.
  • Strictly adheres to explosives safety procedures, including ATF/DOT regulations and company policies for handling, storage, and transport of energetic materials.
  • Maintain a clean and organized environment, including housekeeping, preventive maintenance, and inventory tracking.
  • Collaborate with Production, Engineering and R&D teams to support product development and troubleshooting.
  • Ensure calibration and verify test equipment is functioning properly to maintain accuracy and compliance.
  • Participate in new hire training, additional area specific training, safety meetings, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Education and Training:

  • High school diploma or the equivalent is required.

General Requirements / Technical Requirements & Skills:

  • Safety conscious with critical thinking skills.
  • Effective communication and team building skills.
  • Ability to multitask in a high stress environment.
  • Ability to perform basic measurement and conduct basic math.
  • Competent in basic computer applications.
  • Ability to read and follow detailed work instructions, engineering drawings, and safety procedures.
  • Comfortable working in a structured, high-risk test environment with strict controls.

Certificates, Licenses & Registrations:

  • Forklift Operation Certification preferred
  • Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) Training preferred

Work Authorization / Security Clearance:

  • Able to meet ATF & regulatory security requirements.
  • Must be US citizen, or lawful permanent resident of the United States, in accordance with ATF regulations.

Physical Demands / Working Conditions:

Employees working in general manufacturing facilities must meet certain physical requirements to perform their duties safely and effectively. These typically include the ability to stand and walk for long periods, often throughout an entire shift. Workers should be able to lift, carry, and/or move up to 50 pounds occasionally when lifting devices are not present. Repetitive use of hands, wrists, and arms is common, along with regular bending, kneeling, and climbing. Visual and hearing acuity are necessary for reading instructions, inspecting products, and responding to equipment alerts, and manual dexterity is essential for operating tools and machinery.

The working conditions in manufacturing environments can be physically demanding and vary based on the facility and type of production. Employees may be exposed to fluctuating temperatures, high noise levels, and potential hazards such as moving machinery, chemicals, or sharp objects. The use of personal protective equipment (PPE) including gloves, safety glasses, ear protection, and steel-toed boots is often required. The work is typically fast paced with performance expectations to meet frequent deadlines. Schedules may involve shift work, overtime, weekends, or holiday hours to meet production demands.

title: Lead Navy Engineering Consultant
description:
Overview

MPR is seeking a Lead Navy Engineering Consultant for a full-time position at our Alexandria, Virginia office. This role requires an experienced engineer with Navy background to serve as both a technical consultant and team leader. The successful candidate will contribute to MPR's Navy business across multiple technical disciplines, develop and strengthen trusted client relationships, and build team capabilities to deliver comprehensive engineering solutions to Navy clients.

The ideal candidate brings 8-15+ years of experience including active duty or civilian Navy experience, combines technical excellence with business acumen, and has established credibility and relationships within the Navy community. This individual will interface with Navy clients, lead complex multi-discipline projects, mentor junior engineers, and drive business development to further grow MPR's Navy portfolio across electrical, mechanical, structural, thermal-hydraulic, instrumentation & control systems engineering as well as programmatic and project controls.

MPR values the leadership, loyalty, integrity, and commitment to excellence developed during military service. This role leverages those attributes to deliver specialty engineering solutions with the technical excellence MPR is known for across multiple industries.

  • Oversee project controls support services including schedule development and analysis, earned value management, cost estimating, and independent project assessments
  • Ensure deliverables meet technical standards, quality requirements, and program schedules

Team Development and Mentoring

  • Build MPR's Navy team capabilities by coaching and mentoring engineers across disciplines
  • Integrate MPR's multi-discipline capabilities to deliver comprehensive solutions to Navy clients
  • Review and validate technical work products to ensure excellence and accuracy
  • Transfer Navy-specific knowledge, standards, and practices to MPR team members
  • Support recruiting and hiring to grow Navy-focused engineering staff

Client Engagement and Relationship Management

  • Engage regularly with Navy engineering, program management, and operations personnel
  • Understand client business challenges and frame problems into workable technical solutions
  • Communicate technical results effectively to diverse audiences including flag officers, program managers, and technical staff
  • Build confidence through consistent delivery and responsive client service
  • Maintain active security clearance and handle sensitive program information appropriately

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Nuclear, or related discipline) from an ABET-accredited university required
  • Professional Engineer (P.E.) license is a plus

    • Navy Nuclear Power School and Prototype training highly valued

    • EOOW/PPWO/EDO qualifications are highly valued
    • Post-service experience with NAVSEA, NAVFAC, PMS organizations, or Navy shipyards preferred
    • Established network of relationships within Navy engineering community

Technical Experience

  • 8-15+ years of engineering experience, including active duty and/or civilian Navy experience
  • Broad understanding of shipboard systems including propulsion plants, electrical distribution, mechanical systems, fluid systems, and auxiliaries
  • Familiarity with Navy reactor plant systems preferred• Experience with Navy technical standards, specifications, and qualification requirements (MIL-STDs, Navy Ship Technical Manuals, NAVSEA standards)
  • Demonstrated success in client-facing roles with Navy organizations
  • Strong analytical skills with fundamental understanding of engineering first principles across multiple disciplines
  • Experience leading technical projects from concept through design, analysis, procurement, testing, and installation
  • Familiarity with project controls methodologies including scheduling, earned value management, and schedule risk analysis; experience with Navy shipyard operations or ship maintenance/construction projects is a plus
  • Familiarity with engineering analysis tools (ANSYS, MATLAB, ETAP, thermal-hydraulic codes, etc.) is a plus

Leadership & Communication Skills

  • Persistent, questioning attitude and the ability to accept that in others.
  • Ability to multi-task across teams of engineers and managers on various projects.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across functional teams.
  • Ability to accept and grow from constructive feedback.
  • Motivated to expand skills and knowledge, as well as tackle new problems and take on new responsibilities.
  • Ability to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
  • Solution oriented with a goal of enabling our clients’ success.

Required

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.

Logistics

Locations: Alexandria VA (HQ)

Position Type: Full-time, exempt

Travel: Likely 20-25%, but this will vary based on project assignments. This includes travel to Navy shipyards, shore facilities, client sites, and visits between MPR offices.

Compensation: The salary range for this position is $150,000 to $220,000 annually. We offer comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts, a 401(k) and profit sharing, as well as paid time off.

About MPRMPR Associates is a thriving multi-discipline, specialty engineering services and consulting firm founded in 1964. Headquartered in Alexandria, Virginia, with additional offices in East Lyme, Connecticut; Burlington, Massachusetts; and Salt Lake City, Utah, MPR serves a wide and continually growing client base across the power and energy industries, federal services (DOE, DOD, and DHS), and the health and life sciences sector throughout the United States and internationally. title: [Job-31203] AI Engineer Master, Brazil
description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

We are building the client's AWS enterprise cloud foundation from the ground up, and we are building it with an Agentic Software Development Life Cycle (Agentic-SDLC). We are not looking for an architect who reviews what agents produced. We are looking for one who builds the agents, defines the intents they execute, and treats the delivery system itself as part of the architecture they own.

This is the senior technical seat on the account. You will own the architecture across workstreams — the multi-account AWS landing zone (Network, Shared Services, and Workload Non-Prod and Prod), the application architecture running on top of it, and the platform architecture that comes next. You will also lead the operational team as tech lead: setting the technical direction, unblocking engineers, and shipping code yourself. This is a hands-on role. The person who owns the diagram is the person who writes the CDK.

Responsibilities

  • Architecture Ownership: Own the AWS enterprise architecture end to end — multi-account governance and guardrails, Transit Gateway topology, hybrid connectivity to on-premises data centers, centralized traffic inspection, hybrid DNS, and the security posture that holds it all together. You write the ADRs, you defend them to the client, and you revisit them when they stop being true.
  • Tech Leadership with Your Hands On: Lead the operational team day to day — technical direction, design review, code review, and the architectural decisions that unblock delivery. You are also expected to build: CDK stacks, Lambda functions, agent tooling.
  • Agent Development & Orchestration: Design and extend the agents that carry our delivery — intent decomposition, design artifact generation, implementation scaffolding, validation, and gate reporting. Author the capability instructions they run on so agents produce architecture-compliant work without a human restating the standards each time. When you see the same correction made twice, you encode it once.
  • Intent-Driven Execution: Work within our Intent-Driven Framework, where intent describes client outcomes rather than task lists, ambiguity stops execution instead of getting interpreted, and every user-visible change ships behind a feature flag. High-velocity delivery in fixed-scope cycles, without scope creep or accumulated technical debt.
  • Legacy Modernization: Help systematically retire a live VB6 desktop application by moving its functionality into cloud services, while the legacy system keeps running untouched. Coexistence design — read-only replication, parity proof, staged cutover — is a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought.
  • Platform Direction: Lead the platform evaluation for the external digital front: understand what the client's dealers and commercial customers actually need, assess the options, and produce a recommendation leadership and the client can act on. Then design the reuse path — external identity, tenancy, API contracts that hold once a partner integrates against them.
  • Client-Facing Architecture: Be the person in the room with the client's IT and security leadership explaining why the design is what it is, and the person who translates their constraints back into design changes.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Cloud Architecture Depth: Extensive years in software engineering with architecture, on production systems you were accountable for. Serverless application architecture — API Gateway, Lambda, CloudFront, Cognito with SAML federation, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and X-Ray.
  • Infrastructure as Code, Exclusively: AWS CDK in TypeScript, with opinions about stack boundaries and construct design. No console provisioning, no drift.
  • Software Engineering: Java and TypeScript at a level where you can review and write, not just discuss. Our stack is Java 25 with Spring Cloud Function on Lambda, React 19 with TypeScript, CDK in TypeScript. REST contract design, versioning, and backward compatibility. GitHub Actions with OIDC-based cloud authentication.
  • AI/ML Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Prompt Engineering, RAG, and Agentic Frameworks (e.g. Claude Agent SDK, Strands, LangChain, or CrewAI). Tool and MCP integration, context engineering, and a real point of view on how agent output gets verified at a scale where you cannot read all of it. AWS Bedrock and AgentCore are a plus.
  • Hybrid and Legacy Reality: Experience shipping something that had to coexist with a system nobody was allowed to touch.

Soft Skills

  • Adaptive and Agentic Mindset: Ability to pivot quickly. You should be comfortable with a "startup within a corporate" feel where priorities shift based on impact, and where the highest-value thing this week was not on the plan two weeks ago.
  • Architectural Thinking: Understanding of the "Agentic SDLC" and the ability to build systems that reduce human intervention over time. You should find it satisfying, not threatening, when something you used to do by hand becomes automatic.
