title: School Engagement Coordinator
description:
School Engagement Coordinator

Capitol Dental Group

Capitol Dental Group is seeking an organized, outgoing, and relationship-focused School Engagement Coordinator to support our school-based dental programs. This position will play a key role in strengthening relationships with schools, increasing the return of dental consent forms, and coordinating successful dental sealant events.

The ideal candidate enjoys working with school staff, families, and community partners and is comfortable spending significant time in the field visiting schools throughout our service area.

What You’ll Do

As the School Engagement Coordinator, you will serve as a primary connection between Capitol Dental Group and our participating schools. Your focus will be increasing school engagement and student participation in our dental programs.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with school administrators, office staff, nurses, teachers, and other key school contacts.
  • Develop strategies with school staff to increase the return rate of dental consent forms and student participation.
  • Coordinate the delivery and pickup of dental consent forms across approximately 160 schools.
  • Maintain an organized schedule and tracking system for consent distribution, follow-up, and collection.
  • Provide regular follow-up and in-person support to schools to encourage timely consent returns.
  • Conduct presentations and informational sessions for school staff, parents, and other stakeholders about Capitol Dental Group's school-based dental services.
  • Coordinate and organize school dental sealant events, including scheduling, school communication, logistics, and day-of-event support.
  • Help coordinate appropriate staffing for school presentations, outreach activities, and sealant events.
  • Work closely with Capitol Dental Group's clinical and operations teams to ensure schools are prepared for scheduled events.
  • Identify barriers affecting school participation or consent returns and develop practical solutions with school partners.
  • Track school engagement activities, consent results, upcoming events, and follow-up needs.
  • Represent Capitol Dental Group professionally and positively within schools and the communities we serve.

Schedule

  • Full Time, Monday through Friday

What We’re Looking For

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Bilingual strongly preferred
  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively with school personnel at all levels.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage schedules, deadlines, and activities across a large number of schools.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in the field.
  • Strong follow-through and persistence when coordinating with busy school teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly when school schedules change.
  • Comfortable traveling regularly between participating schools.
  • Computer knowledge and experience.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
  • Experience in school engagement, community outreach, healthcare outreach, education, event coordination, or a related field is preferred.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means building strong partnerships with our schools and making it easier for students to access preventive dental care. Key measures of success will include increased dental consent return rates, strong school participation, well-organized sealant events, timely communication, and positive relationships with our school partners.

Why Join Capitol Dental Group?

This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on children's oral health by connecting students with preventive dental services in their schools. You'll have the opportunity to build meaningful community relationships while helping Capitol Dental Group expand participation in its school-based dental programs.

Capitol Dental Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Associate Director, Insurance & Investor Insights
description:
Create your best future and join Westpac as Associate Director, Insurance & Investor Insights


What’s the role?

As Associate Director, Insurance & Investor Insights, you’ll play a key role in growing Westpac Institutional Bank’s Insurance franchise by managing and deepening relationships across a portfolio of priority insurance clients. Based in Sydney in a permanent, full-time position, this is a client-facing relationship management and origination role focused on identifying client needs, originating new opportunities and delivering tailored banking, capital markets, investment and risk solutions.

You’ll combine relationship management, commercial drive and industry insight to uncover opportunities that create value for clients and support sustainable revenue growth for WIB. You’ll work closely with teams across global FIG coverage, Products, Risk and Customer Insights & Analytics to mobilise the right expertise, lead internal deal teams and convert client priorities into executable opportunities.

You’ll be part of the global Financial Institutions & Government (FIG) coverage team, using your understanding of insurance markets, balance sheets, capital, liquidity, funding and investment themes to develop senior client conversations, increase share of wallet and strengthen WIB’s position as a trusted strategic adviser to priority insurance clients.

We’re interested in candidates from institutional banking, relationship management, structuring, advisory, markets, credit, insurance or other client-facing financial services backgrounds.

What do I need?

You’ll bring strong relationship-building skills, commercial drive and the ability to originate, shape and execute client opportunities by working across internal teams and senior client stakeholders.

  • Strong relationship management and origination capability, ideally gained in institutional banking, financial services, structuring, advisory, markets, credit, or insurance.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships and engage confidently with senior client stakeholders, including Treasury, Capital, Investments/CIO, CFO and broader executive stakeholders.
  • Commercial mindset with the ability to identify client needs, develop strategic opportunities and convert insights into revenue-generating outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and collaborate across product, risk and insights/solutions teams to deliver client outcomes.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex financial, market, credit or regulatory information into clear, practical client ideas.
  • Understanding of insurance, banking or financial services, including capital, liquidity, funding, balance sheet or investment concepts.
  • Curiosity to build deeper sector knowledge and contribute to the continued growth of WIB’s global Insurance & Strategic Investors franchise.
Why join us?

We’re obsessed with becoming our customers' #1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return, we’re committed to making Westpac the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that:

  • Special offers on banking products and discounts from top brands, including generous employee-only mortgage rates!
  • Flexible work arrangements to help you achieve a greater work/life balance, and a variety of leave options including Culture, Lifestyle and Wellbeing leave.
  • Tailored learning and development opportunities to help your grow your career within the bank.
  • Lots of opportunities to ‘give back’ to the Community by getting involved in our many volunteering initiatives.
  • Specifically, as part of Insurance & Investor Insights, you'll work at the intersection of insurance, institutional investors, capital markets and whole-of-bank solutions. Be part of a growing franchise, influence strategy and create long-term impact for clients and the bank. You'll also gain exposure to the growing global insurance sector, increasing strategic capital flows and investor activity, and the role Australia plays in attracting institutional capital and investment globally.
  • You'll gain exposure to some of the most strategic and intellectually challenging conversations facing clients today in this rapidly evolving sector!
Create your future today
To get started, simply click on the APPLY or APPLY NOW button
We’re all about creating a supportive and inclusive community. We welcome everyone – no matter your age, gender, background, or abilities. We also provide additional support to welcome our veterans, Indigenous Australians and neurodiverse community.

title: Security Engineering Manager
description:
hackajob is collaborating with Just Eat to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

Ready for a challenge?

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

About this role

JET's Information Security organisation protects a technology-led, cloud-native platform serving millions of customers across multiple markets. JET's building security into the foundations of how we design, engineer, and operate our cloud-native platforms at scale, across our technology organisation.

JET's Security Engineering team builds the tools, guardrails and controls that let every engineer at JET ship secure code, over 100 times a day. As a Senior Security Engineer, you'll design, build and run the security solutions our 1st and 2nd line InfoSec teams and wider engineering community rely on daily, from vulnerability scanning and access monitoring to AI security guardrails. You'll work hands-on within JET's global Security Engineering team, turning security policy into code and every engineer into a security-conscious one.

These are some of the key components to the position:

  • Design, build and deploy security controls and guardrails across JET's cloud-native platforms, including AI security solutions protecting customer-facing products.

  • Run password audits, network and web application vulnerability scans, and intrusion detection to identify and close gaps before they're exploited.

  • Automate security processes as code, embedding compliance and IaC checks into CI/CD pipelines shipping over 100 times daily.

  • Conduct risk audits and assessments, translating findings into practical recommendations for engineering teams.

  • Monitor and analyse system access logs, flagging anomalies and supporting incident response.

  • Plan and test security backup and disaster recovery processes to keep JET's platforms resilient.

  • Partner with 1st and 2nd line InfoSec teams as customers of your solutions, translating technical work for product and engineering audiences.

What will you bring to the team?

  • Practical experience writing and deploying applications or tooling into cloud-native environments (AWS, Azure or GCP).

  • Strong, demonstrable skills deploying AI security solutions, guardrails, and defences for AI systems used by customers.

  • Proficiency in at least one of C#, Python, Java, PowerShell or Bash, with a track record of automating security processes.

  • Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and Compliance as Code practices.

  • Comfort operating in Agile, DevOps-driven teams with frequent, continuous delivery.

  • Confident stakeholder management, translating security risk and technical decisions into language product and engineering teams act on.

  • A collaborative, evangelist mindset, building trust so others choose secure defaults rather than having security imposed on them.

At JET, this is how we play

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.

Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.

At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again.

Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

What else are we delivering?

Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET journeys.

Are you ready to join the team? Apply now!

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; bilingualism an asset.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
  • Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Company benefits package
  • Ongoing learning and development
  • Home-based position

About Indero


Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.


Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale..


Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.



Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Canada.

﻿

Description de poste

Le coordonnateur de projets II offre un soutien en coordination et en opérations pour les activités d’activation et de maintien des sites à toutes les phases de l’étude. Ce rôle comporte un plus grand niveau d’autonomie et de prise en charge, avec une responsabilité directe des projets et des livrables assignés. Le coordonnateur de projets II veille à la réalisation précise et dans les délais de la documentation liée aux sites et aux projets, à une communication proactive et au respect des échéanciers de l’étude.

Ce rôle est fait pour vous si :

  • Vous possédez de l’expérience en administration de projets et en recherche clinique ;
  • Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement collaboratif ;
  • Vous désirez avoir un impact au sein d’une entreprise en forte croissance.

RESPONSABILITÉS

Plus précisément, le coordonnateur de projets II :

  • Dirige les activités d’activation des sites qui lui sont assignées, en assurant leur réalisation selon les échéanciers et les normes de qualité établis.
  • Coordonne, recueille, révise et approuve les documents réglementaires essentiels et ceux liés aux essais cliniques provenant des sites investigateurs.
  • Agit comme point de contact principal pour les sites assignés en ce qui concerne les questions opérationnelles et administratives.
  • Communique efficacement avec les équipes internes (p. ex. opérations cliniques, affaires réglementaires, gestion des données) afin d’aligner les priorités et de résoudre les enjeux pouvant affecter l’activation ou le maintien des sites.
  • Identifie les risques ou retards potentiels liés à l’activation des sites et les escalade au gestionnaire de projet, au besoin.
  • S’assure que les documents essentiels sont exacts, complets et conformes afin de faciliter une révision réussie dès la première soumission et l’activation des sites.
  • Maintient l’information à jour dans le CTMS, l’eTMF et les autres outils de suivi.
  • Prépare les comptes rendus de réunions, les outils de suivi des études et les rapports destinés aux mises à jour internes et aux clients.
  • Soutient les soumissions aux comités d’éthique et les exigences réglementaires propres à chaque pays, lorsque requis.
  • Coordonne les affectations de formation et assure le maintien de la documentation liée aux activités de formation spécifiques aux projets.
  • Prépare et diffuse la correspondance de l’étude, les communications aux sites et la documentation de suivi.
  • Gère la logistique liée aux réunions des investigateurs, aux fournitures de l’étude et à la distribution des dossiers maîtres de l’investigateur (ISF).
  • Participe aux audits et aux inspections en fournissant la documentation requise et en appuyant les réponses aux observations.
  • Contribue à l’amélioration des processus, à la documentation des meilleures pratiques et aux initiatives de conformité aux SOP au sein de l’équipe de coordination de projets.
  • Offre un encadrement aux coordonnateurs juniors en lien avec les processus standards et les activités administratives.

Profil recherché

PROFIL IDÉAL

  • Baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent à la recherche clinique ou expérience équivalente.
  • 1 à 2 ans d’expérience en recherche clinique, idéalement au sein d’une CRO, d’une entreprise de biotechnologie ou d’une société pharmaceutique.
  • Bonne compréhension des BPC (Bonnes pratiques cliniques), des lignes directrices de l’ICH et des normes en matière de documentation clinique.
  • Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles et organisationnelles, avec la capacité de prioriser et de gérer plusieurs tâches simultanément.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite en anglais ; le bilinguisme est un atout.
  • Capacité démontrée à travailler de façon autonome et en collaboration au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires.
  • Bonne connaissance des bonnes pratiques cliniques ainsi que des réglementations et lignes directrices applicables de Santé Canada et de la Food and Drug Administration (FDA).


Notre entreprise


L’environnement de travail


Chez Indero, vous travaillerez avec des collaborateurs compétents et dynamiques. Nos valeurs sont la collaboration, l’innovation, la fiabilité et la réactivité. Nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant et des possibilités d’avancement intéressantes.


Dans ce role, vous bénéficierez des avantages suivants :

  • ﻿Horaire de travail flexible
  • Poste permanent à temps plein
  • Avantages sociaux complets (soins médicaux, soins dentaires, soins de la vue, REER, vacances, jours personnels, clinique médicale virtuelle, rabais sur le transport en commun, activités sociales)
  • Formation et perfectionnement continu


À propos Indero


Anciennement connue sous le nom d’Innovaderm, Indero est un expert de renommée mondiale et un chef de file en recherche clinique en dermatologie. Nous comptons plus de vingt ans d’expérience couvrant un vaste éventail d’indications, de populations de patients, de voies d’administration et de classes de médicaments, avec une présence à l’échelle mondiale.


Indero est une CRO à double spécialisation en dermatologie et en rhumatologie, cumulant plus de 25 ans d’expérience en recherche clinique et en réalisation d’essais cliniques. Notre approche de services complets — allant de la conception des protocoles et du recrutement des patients à la surveillance des essais et à la biométrie — offre aux promoteurs des secteurs biotechnologique et pharmaceutique la rigueur scientifique et l’expertise sur mesure nécessaires pour mener leurs études à terme de façon efficace et performante. Grâce à nos capacités en Amérique du Nord, en Europe, en Asie‑Pacifique et en Amérique latine, à nos relations étendues et en constante évolution avec les investigateurs et les patients, ainsi qu’à une clinique de recherche dédiée où nous concevons et réalisons nos propres études, Indero est le partenaire CRO idéal pour répondre à des besoins cliniques à l’échelle mondiale.


Indero s’engage à offrir un traitement équitable et l’égalité des chances à toutes les personnes. À ce titre, Indero offre, sur demande, des mesures d’adaptation aux candidats en situation de handicap tout au long du processus de recrutement et de sélection.


Indero accepte uniquement les candidats pouvant légalement travailler au Canada.

title: Head of Digital Publishing
description:
At ININ Games, we believe video games are more than entertainment. They are part of our cultural heritage and deserve to be preserved for future generations. We bring classic titles from the 80s, 90s and 00s back to modern platforms, and we do more than re-release them: we provide historical context, add thoughtful improvements and make them available to a global audience.

We work with legendary partners such as SEGA, Taito, Irem, NatsumeAtari and Yu Suzuki, and we revive iconic franchises including Space Invaders, Bubble Bobble, Cotton, Turrican, Wonder Boy, Simon the Sorcerer and Shenmue. Alongside our heritage portfolio, we publish original games by indie studios that carry retro game design forward into new IP.

ININ is a digital-first publisher and part of United Games Entertainment, an independent developer and publisher with a global focus on North America, Europe and Japan. Remote, Germany-based. Occasional travel to industry events and partner meetings.
  • Own the digital-first publishing pipeline across PC and console: Steam, Epic, GOG, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo.
  • Plan and execute go-to-market for every release: positioning, store presence, wishlist campaigns, PR, creator and community activation, pricing and promotion planning.
  • Own the Digital Publishing P&L, including title-level cost and revenue planning, forecasting, margin management and profitability tracking.
  • Manage licensor relationships and approval processes, with a strong focus on Japanese partners.
  • Source, evaluate and negotiate new projects across classic re-releases, remakes and retro-inspired indie titles, and own term sheets and contract negotiations.
  • Oversee external development partnerships at portfolio level: set delivery expectations, quality standards and escalation paths, while day-to-day milestone execution sits with the Publishing Producer reporting to you.
  • Build and maintain direct relationships with platform holders such as Sony, Microsoft, Nintendo and Valve.
  • Grow catalogue revenue through pricing strategy, promotional planning and platform featuring.
  • Translate objectives into measurable KPIs across the full conversion funnel, from wishlists through conversion, sell-through, returns and review metrics, and report performance directly to the CEO.
  • Lead and grow the ININ publishing team, spanning product management, business development and publishing production, ensuring strong performance and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Shape the team structure and talent strategy together with the CEO, including hiring priorities and individual development plans.
  • Represent ININ towards platform holders, partners and the developer community at industry events.
  • At least 7 years in games publishing, including 3 years in a leadership role with team responsibility.
  • Proven track record of multi-platform releases on PC and console, from submission and certification through to launch and post-launch support.
  • Strong command of digital storefronts, first-party relations, pricing and promotion mechanics.
  • Confident in commercial and contractual matters: term sheets, licensing agreements, milestone and delivery terms. ININ has no in-house legal function, so contractual literacy is essential.
  • Experience working with licensors and development partners across cultures, ideally including Japanese companies.
  • Genuine knowledge of and passion for retro and classic games and their cultural relevance. This is a working requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • Analytical, structured and hands-on. Comfortable making decisions with incomplete data and owning the outcome.
  • Fluent English and German at B2 level or higher.
  • Self-directed in a fully remote setup.
Nice to have:
  • Experience with retro-inspired indie titles and their communities.
  • Japanese language skills.
  • Network among indie studios, porting partners and localisation providers.
  • Direct responsibility for iconic franchises and a portfolio with an established global fanbase.
  • Full ownership of the digital publishing business, including P&L and team.
  • Short decision paths, flat hierarchies and direct access to the CEO.
  • Fully remote setup with flexible working conditions.
  • Competitive compensation and participation programme.
  • A label with a clear digital-first strategy and room to shape how it grows.

title: Health Communications Video Script Writer/Producer
description:
🚨 READ THIS FIRST

No Easy Apply. No AI.

This is not a typical “content” role.

This role is a health and medical video scriptwriter/storyteller with some interview-driven producing experience.

If your experience is more of a field producer / post producer hybrid with some medical scriptwriting/storytelling experience, consider applying for this role:

Why This Role Matters

The stories we tell influence:

· whether patients seek treatment

· how quickly clinicians adopt new technology

· how efficiently life-changing therapies reach the people who need them

The right fit for this role has experience in:

· understanding complex medical science quickly

· thinking critically

· connecting deeply with patients and clinicians

· turning those connections into creatively engaging, interview-driven videos

Who We Are…

We are an award-winning B2B creative video agency specializing in medtech and pharma. We create branded, documentary-style interview-driven video content aimed at clinicians, patients, and employees.

Our core focus is to help patients get access to the life-changing medical innovations they need through our engaging, authentic storytelling.

Our big, hairy, audacious goal? Help bring 150 life-changing medical innovations to patients who need them by 2034. And everyone on our team is deeply committed to the cause with team tenure ranging from four years to eleven years!

What This Role Actually Is

You are the internal subject matter expert and narrative lead on each project.

This is a client facing role where you develop and own the story end-to-end — from needs assessment, pre-script writing, pre-production, on set interviews, through post production and editing.

You are responsible for shaping the narrative before the shoot, directing and adapting it in real time during interviews, and ensuring the story comes together clearly and accurately in the final edit.

Approximately 60% of this role focuses on clinician-facing content and 40% on patient-centered storytelling.

You will:

· Listen to clients explain their business problem and learn as much as you can about the medical innovation and disease states they support

· Learn from clinicians who explain how they use the innovation, which features and benefits matter to them, and how it benefits patients.

· Interview patients with compassion and understanding of their unique situations

· Speak and write in a way that earns respect and understanding from clinicians as well as be able to switch gears/TOV into patient-facing storytelling, depending on the audience.

What We’re Really Looking For

You are someone who:

· Understands and has some end-to-end experience with the corporate/branded documentary film production process

· Can quickly learn complex medical and engineering innovation topics and explain them clearly

· Is both analytical and emotionally intelligent

· Is outgoing and warm, comfortable engaging in conversations with clients, experts, and patients alike

· Has demonstrated the ability write compelling interview-driven scripts.

· Thrives in ambiguity and can create structure

What You’ll Do

This role requires ownership across the full storytelling lifecycle:

1.) Learn Fast, Go Deep

  • Independently research and synthesize complex medical topics—often with limited public information—so you can engage clients and clinicians as a credible, informed partner from the very first conversation

2.) Discovery & Client Partnership

  • Lead early discovery conversations with clients to understand the business problem

  • Translate client goals into clear storytelling strategies

3. Shape the Story Concept Before Production

Work with clients to define:

  • audiences (clinicians/patients/employees)

  • messaging

  • creative strategy

  • Conduct in-depth pre-interviews to uncover emotional truth, narrative arcs, and key story beats—not just facts

  • In a pre-script, layout the story structure, dialogue and visual opportunities that will make an audience care

  • Work with production team to spec visuals (b-roll and graphics) and to ensure scripts can be executed by the production team within the budget and timeline

4. Lead Interviews On Set

  • Conduct on-camera interviews

  • Charm patients and clinicians to help them be their best on camera

  • Gather content that closely matches the pre-script, plus extra unexpected goodies

5. Create the Narrative

  • Turn interviews into video scripts that match the creative brief, balancing emotional truth, clinical accuracy, and regulatory guidelines

  • Work with producers and post-production team to ensure content stays on brief through final delivery

  • Support the editorial process to completion with your subject matter expertise, keeping the client’s interests in mind.

You May Come From

· Healthcare or science journalism (patient or clinician storytelling)

· Medical communications, MedTech or pharma marketing, or clinical communications

· Healthcare-focused PR (especially within MedTech or pharma)

· Non-fiction or interview-driven storytelling (with exposure to complex subject matter)

Must-Haves

· Experience working in healthcare, medtech, pharma, or clinical environments

· Proven ability to learn complex topics fast and explain them succinctly

· Strong writing + storytelling ability

· Experience interviewing patients and clinicians Meticulous communication and thinking—able to operate in highly regulated environments where precision, accuracy, and professionalism are non-negotiable

· High attention to detail

· Willingness to travel

Bonus Points

· Experience navigating legal, medical or compliance guidelines in regulated content environments

Not a Fit If Your Experience is Limited to:

· Creating content for broad, B2C audiences rather than crafting stories for highly targeted, expert audiences with defined needs

· Scripted narrative content

· Reality TV

What Success Looks Like

· You can hold and navigate depth across multiple complex projects simultaneously—quickly getting up to speed, retaining critical details, and switching between projects without losing accuracy or context

· Concepts are strategically grounded and well-researched, using clinical evidence, audience insight, and thoughtful pre-interviews to support the client’s goals

· Content remains on brief throughout the project lifecycle, accurately reflecting the client’s messaging strategy and objectives from concept through final delivery

· Pre-interviews and interviews are conducted with professionalism and high emotional intelligence, resulting in authentic, engaging stories that align with both patient experience and client intent

· Scripts clearly and effectively deliver on messaging targets, integrating clinical accuracy and patient/clinician perspective while staying true to approved positioning and tone

· Patients and clinicians feel respected and supported, and clinician audiences find the content credible, relevant, and worth their time

Details

· We’ll train you in the Authentica Way, but you need strong instincts and experience coming in with the desire to get the job done using Authentica’s process.

· 40 hr/week contract → potential full-time

· Must work PST/MST hours

· Salary is $70,000—$100,000/year, DOE

WPMG hospitalists work closely with our Cardiologists and Neurosurgeons to provide comprehensive care. Central Hospital provides medical and surgical inpatient services with the addition of telemetry for low acuity patients. Physician care is administered by an IM/FM Hospitalist team, Surgeons and Consultative Specialists. Radiology, laboratory and pharmacy services are available 24 hours a day. title: Restaurant Chef
description:
Job Title: Restaurant Chef

Department: Food & Beverage

Reports to: Executive Chef

The Restaurant Chef is responsible for coordinating, supervising, and directing all aspects of food production for assigned outlets. This role ensures profitable operations, high-quality products, and exceptional service while upholding company standards in food preparation, sanitation, and portion control. The Restaurant Chef is also responsible for managing food and labor costs, training and developing associates, and supporting overall guest satisfaction.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Oversee daily operations of kitchen and food production areas, ensuring portion size, taste, temperature, presentation, and recipe standards are consistently met.
  • Ensure compliance with requisition and ordering procedures.
  • Maintain knowledge of daily forecasts and customer counts to manage par stock levels and staffing needs.
  • Monitor food costs, inventory levels, waste, and portion control to support departmental profitability.
  • Monitor product receiving and storage to ensure quality, freshness, proper rotation, and appropriate storage procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with all food safety, sanitation, and health department regulations, including proper food handling, storage, labeling, and temperature control.
  • Respond promptly to guest complaints and take appropriate action to resolve concerns.
  • Monitor kitchen equipment and facilities, report maintenance needs, and communicate with Engineering to ensure issues are addressed.
  • Prepare and submit required reports in a timely manner.
  • Participate in departmental and leadership meetings as requested.
  • Ensure recipes, preparation methods, product specifications, and presentation standards are consistently followed.
  • Implement and monitor corporate promotions in outlets, including buffet and three-meal concept standards.
  • Perform all other duties as requested.

Leadership Acumen:

  • Actively recruit, train, coach, and develop associates to achieve optimal performance and growth opportunities within the company.
  • Conduct performance reviews in line with company standards.
  • Prepare and manage associate schedules based on business levels, forecasts, and operational needs.
  • Monitor labor levels to ensure appropriate staffing while maintaining operational and financial goals.
  • Create and maintain a professional, educational, and positive kitchen environment.
  • Promote a safe working environment and ensure associates follow all safety, food safety, and sanitation procedures.
  • Collaborate with other F&B managers and communicate effectively regarding operational needs and issues.
  • Consistently make decisions in the best interest of guests, associates, and the organization.

Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Must be at least 18 years of age to apply.
  • Associate degree in Culinary Arts or related field preferred.
  • At least 5 years of progressive culinary experience in a hotel or similar environment.
  • Advanced cooking skills, including strong knife-handling ability.
  • Previous supervisory experience required.
  • Flexible schedule with the ability to work extended hours as needed.
  • Ability to promote and maintain a safe environment for guests and associates.
  • Ability to speak and read English; additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods (up to 8–10 hours per shift).
  • Frequent bending, reaching, stooping, and crouching to access ingredients, ovens, and storage.
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 lbs. (e.g., pots, pans, bulk ingredients, or equipment).
  • Ability to work safely around hot surfaces, open flames, steam, and sharp objects.
  • Tolerance for working in hot, humid, and sometimes crowded environments.
  • Ability to perform repetitive motions (e.g., chopping, stirring, plating) safely and efficiently.
  • Ability to move quickly and efficiently in a fast-paced kitchen environment.

description:
Kyocera has a temp-to-hire position for a Process Technician 1 at our San Diego, CA facility.

Candidates selected for hire will be hired through one of Kyocera’s approved staffing partners.

This position may lead to a direct hire offer with Kyocera International, Inc.

Pay is $18.75
With nearly 80,000 employees globally, Kyocera is a leading manufacturer of high-tech ceramics in various industries, including aerospace, automotive, medical applications, and semiconductor processing. Our innovative materials are found in everything from smartphones to space shuttles!


Process Technician 1 (TPH3181)

Exempt: No
Safety Sensitive: Yes

GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF POSITION

A Process Technician performs a variety of functions associated with manufacturing operations, including working with engineers and operators in set-up and calibration tasks, as well as performing rework and quality testing related to the production of parts, components, subassemblies and final product. Uses programs to collect and evaluate operating data to conduct in-line adjustments to parts, instruments or equipment. Updates and may assist in developing methods and procedures to control or modify the manufacturing process.

REQUIREMENTS

High school diploma or GED required.
0-1 years of related experience required in a manufacturing/production environment.
Ability to read, write and comprehend instructions in English.
Ability to add, subtract, multiply, divide all units of measure including common and decimal fractions.
Ability to use a microscope, depending on the specific function.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision and depth perception.
20/20 corrected vision may be required - varies by division
Willingness to wear PPE (examples: goggle, gloves, apron, finger cot, masks, and/or cleanroom apparel.
Ability to grab small parts or hand tools with hands.
Eligible to work in an ITAR environment


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Monitors and documents the operation of machines in a production environment. Maintains flow of production parts; reports inconsistencies, and suggests improvements in the production process.
  2. Troubleshoots complex or troublesome equipment, may work with facilities team or outside vendor or repair or modification.
  3. May run engineering tests prescribed by engineer and analyzes results. Perform periodic calibration.
  4. May recommend process improvements based on test and process results and experience. Troubleshoot machine set up issues.
  5. Visually inspects parts at required steps in the process with attention to detail, ensuring the parts are within specified tolerances. May disposition of reject parts and train operators and inspectors to improve efficiency.
  6. Maintains and orders/tracks tools according to safety and vendor recommendations. Will use measuring devices, such as micrometers, calipers.
  7. Participates in the 5S program.
  8. Knowledgeable of Excel and able to accurately enter data into spreadsheets and create graphs.
  9. Complies with applicable requirements of Kyocera International, Inc. policy, ISO 9000, ISO 14001 requirements, ITAR regulations.
  10. May setup/program production or test machinery.
  11. Reads specifications and mechanical drawings.
  12. May assign and check work of lower-level technicians and operators. Perform the duties or an operator or material handler on occasion as needed.

Perform any other related duties as required or assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

title: Director, RNG Asset Management
description:
Summary

As a member of the RNG Upstream Investment team, the Director, RNG Asset Management will serve as a key commercial and operational coordination resource for the company's upstream Renewable Natural Gas portfolio. The role will focus on financial performance, portfolio reporting, partner coordination, farm and counterparty relationship management, asset optimization, capital prioritization, and coordination of legal and contractual issues across operating and development-stage RNG projects.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

o Own a portfolio-level view of operating and financial performance across assigned RNG assets, including value-creation opportunities.

o Lead or support cross departmental recurring asset reviews other stakeholders to identify underperforming assets and improvement plans.

o Translate operating constraints, feedstock limitations, equipment issues, downtime events and partner-related problems into clear commercial recommendations and action plans.

o Serve as a primary commercial coordination point with JV partners, farm hosts, operators, vendors and other project counterparties, while ensuring appropriate executive escalation for major decisions.

o Coordinate recurring partner touchpoints and ensure follow-through on commercial, operational, and legal workstreams.

o Support business cases for capital projects, including expected production uplift, cost savings, payback, execution risk, partner approvals, and tracking of actual benefits after completion.

o Support coordination of business facts, commercial impacts, documentation, and escalation strategy for contractual matters, amendments, notices, counterparty issues, and other legal or commercial workstreams.

o Become conversant in material project agreements, including JV agreements, management services agreements, manure supply agreements, ground leases, O&M agreements, offtake arrangements, interconnection agreements, environmental credit arrangements, tax credit monetization documents and major vendor contracts.

o Prepare clear, concise updates for senior leadership, JV boards, internal asset reviews and other stakeholder meetings, including facts, business impact, options, and recommendations.

o Drive accountability without relying solely on direct reporting authority and promote a culture of ownership, transparency, fact-based decision making and continuous improvement across the RNG asset portfolio.

Travel will be required an estimated five (5) days per month or as necessary to project sites.

Other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

May directly supervise one or more employees. Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience

Bachelor's Degree, 5-7 years of related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Engineering or Science degree preferred.

Preferred experience:

Renewable energy, RNG, biogas, infrastructure, asset management, project finance, operations, commercial management, strategy, engineering or related fields.

Complex asset portfolios with operational, financial, contractual, compliance and external stakeholder components.

Familiarity with RNG, dairy digesters, landfill gas, environmental credits, RINs, LCFS, 45Z / PTC, ITC monetization, project finance or JV governance.

Financial reporting, variance analysis, budget management, capital project evaluation and executive-level communication.

Partner, customer, vendor, operator, lender, farm or other external counterparty management.

 

Other Skills and Abilities Desired

• Strong commercial judgment and ability to connect operating facts to financial outcomes.

• Exceptional organizational skills and ability to manage multiple complex workstreams at the same time.

• Strong analytical skills and ability to evaluate budgets, forecasts, operating reports, contracts and technical summaries.

• Ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Environmental Compliance, Commercial, Construction and external partners.

• Ability to establish and maintain project schedules, issue logs, action trackers and management reporting cadences.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear executive summaries and board-ready materials.

• Solid interpersonal skills and the ability to influence and motivate others without relying solely on formal authority.

• The ability to learn new processes, tools, contracts, markets and methods quickly.

• The ability to achieve goals and solve problems independently while escalating material issues appropriately.

Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

Mathematical Skills

Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

Reasoning Ability

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Computer Skills

Knowledge of Database software; Project Management software; Microsoft Word and Excel.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

None required.

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following behaviors:

Quality: Consistently produces high quality work (accurate, neat, and thorough). Strives to improve productivity, processes and quality. Demonstrates strong knowledge and skills related to the job. Presents a professional image with dress, demeanor, and manners. Maintains clean work space, company equipment and company vehicles. Safety is a high priority; performs job safely.

Communication: Communicates clearly, concisely, effectively, professionally and timely.

Exhibits good listening and comprehension skills. Keeps others appropriately informed and shares ideas even when unpopular. Listens to what others have to say. Maintains open and active communication with colleagues. Effectively uses knowledge and experience in asking, probing, and anticipating issues to ensure quality is provided.

Teamwork: Fosters the spirit of working with each other. Displays respect, courtesy, politeness, tact, and openness. Handles conflict in an appropriate and professional manner. Builds relationships, promotes cohesiveness, models collaboration with others. Considers impact and issues for our customer and other departments. Engages other impacted departments early for solutions.

title: CISA - Geospatial Data Scientist
description:
Senior Geospatial Data Scientist (TS/SCI) — ArcGIS / Python

Location: Arlington, VA (on-site at federal facilities)
Clearance: Active Top Secret/SCI security clearance
Citizenship: U.S. citizenship required
Position Type: Full-time

About the Role

cFocus Software Incorporated is seeking a Senior Geospatial Data Scientist to serve as the analytic engine of a TS/SCI-cleared team supporting DHS CISA's mission to model, monitor, and protect the nation's communications infrastructure, including undersea cables. You will design and operationalize geospatial data science workflows on the ESRI platform that deliver near real-time situational awareness to Government decision-makers before, during, and after national emergencies.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and operationalize geospatial data science workflows using ArcGIS Pro (desktop analytics and geoprocessing), ArcGIS Enterprise and ArcGIS Online (web GIS publishing, analysis, and content management)
  • Automate reproducible analytics and enterprise system integration using Python libraries including ArcPy and the ArcGIS API for Python
  • Perform exploratory data analysis, clustering, hot-spot detection, suitability modeling, route optimization, and predictive modeling on large infrastructure datasets using ArcGIS Pro and Python
  • Publish analytic outputs as web maps, web scenes, and analytical services; configure sharing, groups, roles, and collaboration across enterprise portals
  • Integrate analytic services with downstream applications including ArcGIS Dashboards and Experience Builder consistent with agency architecture
  • Conduct network-based and technology-based analyses of critical undersea and terrestrial communications infrastructure, including infrastructure mapping, performance assessments, and data validation
  • Develop and present Analysis Decision Briefings to Government stakeholders prior to initiating assigned analyses
  • Monitor enterprise geospatial tool accounts in accordance with security clearance level; interface with critical infrastructure sector representatives and DHS components
  • Respond to initial analytic requests, perform preliminary research, and conduct rapid triage on questions, issues, or events involving the nation's critical communications infrastructure before elevating to Government leads
  • Provide analyses before, during, and after national security and emergency preparedness (NS/EP) events, including surge support outside normal business hours
  • Deliver tool training in lecture, demonstration, and desk-side formats upon delivery of new capabilities and semi-annually thereafter
  • Produce concise, professional-quality written products including analytic reports, briefings, and documentation on 5-business-day Government review cycles

Required Qualifications

  • Active, final Top Secret/SCI clearance granted by the U.S. Government; U.S. citizenship
  • Bachelor's degree with six (6) years of specialized experience, Master's degree with four (4) years, or ten (10) years of equivalent specialized experience
  • Advanced proficiency with the ESRI ArcGIS product suite: ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, and ArcGIS Online
  • Demonstrated experience automating geospatial analysis with Python, ArcPy, and the ArcGIS API for Python
  • Demonstrated experience developing geospatial products from large datasets, including spatial statistics (clustering, hot-spot analysis), suitability modeling, route optimization, and predictive modeling
  • Specialized experience in, or demonstrated aptitude for, telecommunications network modeling and analysis spanning the Public Switched Network (Internet, PSTN, and wireless), including associated methodologies, tools, data, and procedures
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity and IT security principles
  • Strong research, analysis, and technical writing skills producing deliverables to formal Government acceptance standards
  • Familiarity with the National Response Framework (NRF) and Emergency Support Function (ESF) #2
  • Availability for after-hours, weekend, and holiday surge support during NS/EP events

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with telecommunications, utility, or other critical infrastructure datasets (e.g., HIFLD or comparable national-scale data programs)
  • Experience operating in classified environments and handling classified and sensitive unclassified mission data
  • Experience working under DHS 4300A/4300B or comparable federal security policy frameworks
  • Dashboard and geospatial visualization design for senior government or executive audiences
  • Experience supporting emergency operations, incident response, or 24/7 watch environment

title: RN VCC PRN (12hr Shifts)
description:
PRN (As Needed) - See Guidelines Below

Eligible for $5.00/hour PRN Shift Differential for All Hours Worked

JOB SUMMARY

The Registered Nurse provides professional nursing services in accordance with physicians’ orders or plan of care. The registered nurse is responsible for determining the nursing problems for an assigned group of patients/residents, making plans to solve them, initiating the plan or assigning others to implement it, and evaluating the extent to which the plan was effective in resolving the problems identified. Supportive of the Village’s mission, values, and service/hospitality (PRIDE) expectations. Completes training hours as required by policy.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Effectively and timely provides for the comfort and well-being of patients by assessing conditions, processing physicians’ orders, providing treatments and administering prescribed drugs.
  • Timely and effectively coordinates nursing care for patients and educates the patients/residents and family about the care.
  • Timely delegates appropriate aspects of nursing care to staff which includes evaluating, monitoring and assuring delivery of care.
  • Accurately and timely documents patients/residents progress toward goals and other observations.
  • Accurately and timely completes required documentation of nursing care to meet all state and Village requirements.
  • Reports patients/residents changes, needs and/or requirements to the appropriate staff.
  • Adheres to all safety regulations and requirements.
  • Handles stress well and gets along with others within the workplace and with customers outside the department.
  • Maintains acceptable standards of workplace conduct.

The responsibilities described above represent the primary responsibilities of the job. Other responsibilities may be assigned by the supervisor as warranted by business needs. The incumbent is expected to perform all assigned responsibilities.

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

  • This job requires an associate's degree professional nursing (ADN).

Licenses/Certifications:

  • Must be a Registered Nurse by the Missouri or Kansas State Board of Nursing.
  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification or ability to obtain within 6 months of hire.
  • Valid driver’s license.

Knowledge and Skills (required unless otherwise noted):

  • Basic level knowledge of Microsoft operating system and Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and responsibilities at the same time.
  • If working in Home Health and Village House, must be able to work autonomously.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
  • Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals; calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions; and deal with a variety of abstract and concrete variables.

SPECIAL WORK ING CONDITIONS

  • The associate is subject to inside environmental conditions which provide protection from weather conditions but not necessarily from temperature changes.
  • The associate is exposed to infectious diseases.
  • The associate is required to function around individuals with challenged mental capacities.
  • Required to drive from one location to another if necessary for services provided through the department.
  • Depending on services offered in the department, this position may have “on-call” responsibilities.
  • The Home Health RN may be exposed to outdoor elements while accessing a patient’s residence.
  • All associates may be called upon to assist other departments in a declared emergency situation.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an individual to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Maximum occasional lift of 50 lbs from floor to waist level; maximum occasional lift of 10 lbs from floor to shoulder; maximum occasional carry of 5 lbs for 100 ft; maximum occasional push/pull horizontal of 40 lbs at 36 in height for 100 ft; maximum frequent push/pull horizontal of 10 lbs at 46 in for 100 ft; maximum occasional grip force of 40 lbs; maximum occasional lateral pinch force of 15 lbs; maximum occasional climb of 8 in; frequent forward reach; frequent bend; frequent fine motor coordination; occasional foot coordination; occasional balance; frequent sitting; continuous standing; and continuous walking. PDC Level: Medium

SUPERVISION RECEIVED/GIVEN

Receives daily supervision.

May provide direction to care givers on a daily basis.

**THIS POSITION IS OPEN TO INTERNAL APPLICANTS OR EXTERNAL APPLICANTS WHO HAVE NOT BEEN EMPLOYED AT JKV WITHIN THE LAST 60 DAYS & HAVE A MINIMUM OF 1 YEAR EXPERIENCE**

Will be scheduled to work 7a-7p or 7p-7

Village Care Center NURSING POOL GUIDELINES

VCC Nursing Pool is a staffing plan and program created to provide flexibility with the staffing assignment schedule throughout the Village Care Center. Associates working exclusively in the Pool are classified as PRN and scheduled as needed. Guidelines regarding the VCC PRN staffing plan include:

  1. PRN associates are not eligible for Paid Time Off or health benefits; however, they may contribute to the TSA plan offered by the Village per the current provisions of the TSA plan.
  2. Nursing Pool associates must work a minimum of three (3) shifts per month. At least one (1) of these shifts must include a weekend shift (weekend shift is defined as beginning Friday at 7:00a and ending at 7:00a on Monday). Additionally, Nursing Pool associates will be scheduled to work at least three (3) of the six (6) holidays, as defined by JKV Associate Policy #327, per calendar year. Failure to meet this minimum requirement may jeopardize the PRN status and result in separation of employment. Additional hours are usually available upon request. Scheduled switch shift agreements will not count as meeting the minimum shift requirement.
  3. Nursing Pool associates must provide the Staffing Office a calendar of preferred work shifts (hours/days) for the upcoming month by the 20th of the prior month, but no later than the 1st day of that month. (Example: by Dec 20th for January, but no later than January 1st).
  4. Must sign up to work the shift in its entirety. No partial shifts permitted unless at the request of Staffing. (7a-7p OR 7p-7a)
  5. Nursing Pool associates must work where assigned throughout the care center.

These VCC Nursing Pool guidelines are subject to change. Benefits and pay are subject to change based on a change in status or other relevant change.

EOE/D/V

Nicotine-Free & Drug Free Workplace

Post-Offer Background Check and Health Screening Required

title: PSM Coordinator
description:
Ensure compliance with OSHA 1910.119 (PSM) and 40 CFR Part 68 (RMP) across all company facilities. Coordinate PSM/RMP activities, support field operations, and maintain accurate process safety documentation. Responsibilities include participating in Process Hazard Analyses (PHAs), updating and managing Process Safety Information (PSI), and controlling all PSM-related documents. This role also supports Mechanical Integrity (MI) initiatives and contributes to improvements in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) and Piping and Instrumentation software.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Assist with adherence to all PSM and RMP regulations, objectives, policies, and procedures; use sound judgment to maintain compliance.
  • Serve as backup liaison among Project Management, Operations, and external engineering firms to ensure facility and equipment purchases meet design requirements.
  • Engage with government agencies to uphold compliance, including audits and annual reporting.
  • Serve as backup administrator for the corporate electronic Management of Change (MOC) system.
  • Participate in emergency planning and preparedness, including drills, training programs, and incident investigations.
  • Collaborate with regulatory bodies, first responders, and third parties on safety compliance and enforcement matters, as needed.
  • Retrieve, compile, and report PSM/RMP key performance indicator data; ensure accuracy and relevance.
  • Promote the PSM program for all regulated assets and ensure plant and management personnel understand their roles.
  • Establish, develop, implement, and maintain PSM and RMP program elements in compliance with requirements.
  • Audit plant processes, procedures, and practices; manage and update PSM program documentation.
  • Coordinate PHA to ensure analyses are completed before new covered process startups and at five-year revalidations for existing processes.
  • Support Mechanical Integrity initiatives; drive CMMS enhancements and electronic P&ID workflows to improve compliance and efficiency.
  • Maintain regular interaction with Operations, Maintenance, and Engineering at assigned facilities to resolve process safety issues.
  • Conduct routine facility walkthroughs to assess units, observe work in progress, and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Support construction and startup activities, including PSI collection and review, PHA/LOPA review, and MOC.
  • Track and drive closure of action items from audits, internal reviews, incident investigations, and PHA recommendations using the electronic tracking system.
  • Research and draft operations and engineering PSM/RMP guidance documents.
  • Collaborate with HR on onboarding training for new employees and developing training materials.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office; familiarity with CMMS.
  • Technical knowledge of process safety principles and regulatory compliance.
  • Excellent organization for managing compliance documentation and multiple priorities.
  • Clear written and verbal communication for training, reporting, and cross-functional work.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and resolve process safety issues.
  • Ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • Comfortable working in field environments and conducting facility walkthroughs; strong attention to detail.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Industrial) or related field; equivalent directly related experience accepted.
  • 3+ years of direct PSM experience (e.g., PSM Engineer, PSM Coordinator, Process Facility Manager) with working knowledge and hands-on application of all PSM elements, including PSI, MOC, MI, PSSR, audits, and document control.
  • PHA participation; facilitation experience preferred.
  • Experience supporting construction and startups, including PSI compilation and conducting Pre-Startup Safety Reviews.

Certifications:

  • None required.
  • Preferred: CSP (Certified Safety Professional); PHA Leader; Mechanical Integrity certificate; completion of recognized process safety training.

Physical Demands and Hazard for Field Employees:

This position may require occasional travel to remote sites, potential exposure to flammable material, adherence to safety protocols, compliance with operating regulations, and will require rigorous physical demands.

The Senior Backend Developer is responsible for designing, building and evolving the backend services that support PayXpert's Payment Gateway, Secure Store and other security‑sensitive components within the core payments platform

The role spans mainly on the PHP‑based e‑commerce gateway but also on the Java/Kotlin payments platform components, working across these stacks to deliver and maintain secure transaction services

Key Responsibilities


Backend Development & Secure Domain Ownership

  • Design, develop, and maintain payment-oriented backend services across both PHP (e‑commerce gateway) and Java/Kotlin (core payments platform) codebases
  • Contribute to core payment backend applications with a strong focus on security-sensitive transaction flows.

Security, Reliability & Performance

  • Apply secure coding practices appropriate for transaction-critical and sensitive data environments.
  • Support the implementation of payment protocols and security-related service interactions.
  • Participate in incident analysis and troubleshooting related to payment services.
  • Ensure backend services meet reliability, performance, and data integrity requirements.
  • Critically review AI-assisted code for security, correctness and compliance before it reaches production, treating AI output as a draft to be validated rather than trusted by default. Ensure no sensitive transactional data, secrets or regulated information is exposed to AI tooling.

Testing, Quality & Continuous Integration

  • Design and perform unit and integration testing for payment services.
  • Debug and resolve defects identified during CI pipelines and iterative builds.
  • Maintain and continuously improve test coverage and backend quality standards.
  • Participate actively in code reviews to ensure consistency, quality, and security standards.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Collaborate with peer developers, QA engineers, and release teams across the Core Business Domain.
  • Provide technical support for complex production issues and internal problem-solving when required.

Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to improving backend architecture, service interactions, and development practices.
  • Support documentation and knowledge sharing related to Secure Store services.
  • Actively contribute to improving system robustness and long-term maintainability.
  • Help mature the team's practices for effective and responsible AI-assisted development, sharing prompts, patterns and guardrails that improve productivity without compromising security.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
  • 7–10 years of total backend development experience, including secure, high‑risk backend systems.
  • 4–6 years in similar senior PHP/Java/Kotlin backend roles, owning production services and developing secure backend features.
  • Experience working with REST-based backend architectures and service-oriented systems.
  • Strong familiarity with development and delivery tools: Git, GitLab, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and issue-tracking tools.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants in a professional software development workflow, with an understanding of their security and data-confidentiality implications.
  • Experience working in payments, fintech, or other regulated and security-sensitive environments is a strong plus.
  • Exposure to or ability to collaborate on systems built with Java / Spring Boot is a great plus.
  • Fluent English is mandatory.
  • French and/or Spanish are a plus.


Our Culture & Ways of Working

Our culture is built around people, ownership and continuous progress. We strive to create an environment where individuals feel trusted, supported and challenged to grow, with regular feedback and meaningful follow-up.

We value collaboration over hierarchy. Ideas can come from anywhere, and every voice matters; we expect our teams to contribute, challenge and shape the way we work.

We are strongly product-oriented, with a hands-on mindset and a genuine openness to new ideas. Innovation is not limited to specific teams; it is a shared responsibility.

We believe in continuous improvement over perfection. Each quarter, we actively look for ways to optimise our processes, enhance our solutions and raise the bar as an organisation.


At PayXpert, we want you to grow, feel valued and enjoy your work experience. Here’s what we bring to the table:

  • Flexible working hours and a wellbeing-focused intensive summer schedule.

title: Lube and Tire Technician
description:
Overview

Join the winning team at Plaza Tire Service! In business since 1963, Plaza Tire Service has 75 locations across Missouri, Illinois, Kentucky, and NW Arkansas. We are a growing business and a leader in our industry. Plaza Tire Service is big enough for you to make a career and small enough to care that you do.

As a Lube and Tire Technician, you will perform non-technical service repairs such as oil changes, tire and wheel related services, alignments, flushes, and more. You will also be driving customers, picking up parts, and maintaining the cleanliness of the shop as needed.

COMPENSATION: Pay ranges from $16- $19 per hour depending on experience.

Benefits:

  • Competitive Bi-Weekly Pay
  • Tuition Reimbursement, up to $3,000 annually
  • Paid Vacation and Sick Time
  • 6 Paid Holidays
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance (Company paid)
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with Company Match
  • Discounted Services on Personal and Immediate Family Vehicles
  • Opportunity for Advancement!

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Safely transports customers to and from their place of residence or business using the company vehicle.
  • Picks up parts, supplies, tires, etc. from vendors and/or the corporate office using the company vehicle.
  • Operates company vehicle in a safe and courteous manner obeying all traffic laws.
  • Conducts State Safety and Emission Inspections on vehicles in an ethical manner following all company and state guidelines.
  • Performs tire mounting/dismounting, wheel balance and tire rotation.
  • Performs oil changes and other basic services at the direction of the Shop Foreman or Store Manager.
  • While performing basic services, observes general vehicle condition and points out any obvious needed repairs or safety concerns to the Shop Foreman or Store Manager. Utilizes the company’s Multi-point Inspection and/or Repair Order to properly document the vehicle condition.
  • Maintains cleanliness of the shop to include the service area, tire racks, showroom and outside the building to maintain a clean and inviting appearance.
  • Follows all safety procedures and reports any concerns to the Shop Foreman or Store Manager.

Qualifications:

  • Possess valid driver’s license
  • Must be at least 18 years old
  • Ability to work a minimum of five days, including Saturday's
  • A general understanding of automotive mechanics preferred

Working Conditions and Physical Demands:

The Lube and Tire Technician will be exposed to moderate to loud noises, dust, exhaust fumes, lubricants, petroleum products, vapors, caustic materials, and other hazardous and non-hazardous materials. The temperature in the work environment varies and could include extreme heat and/or extreme cold depending on the ambient temperatures outside. The use of safety goggles or other PPE may be required when working in these conditions.

The Lube and Tire Technician must be able to meet the following physical requirements:

  • Stand up to eight hours per day in the shop and able to walk to gain access to various areas of the building
  • Bend, stoop, kneel and crouch regularly throughout the day; must have full range of motion with arms and hands and be able to feel, handle or finger objects frequently
  • Lift and/or move up to 10 pounds regularly, lift and/or move up to 70 pounds frequently.
  • Communicate with customers and shop personnel
  • Vision sufficient to detect color, depth, and re-focus

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Sun Auto Tire & Service provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Principal Research Scientist (Recommender Systems)

The Job

The Principal Research Scientist (Recommender systems) will lead large and complex technical projects by developing innovative machine learning algorithms and directing the work of talented Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) researchers and engineers towards building scalable ML solutions for HBO Max. This role will be focused on advancing personalization and recommender systems and search to drive user experience and growth.

The person in the role will partner closely with product, engineering, content, marketing, and research stakeholders across WBD to identify ML opportunities, accelerate AI innovation, and to ensure delivery of impactful solutions for the business.

The Daily

  • Develop innovative data science solutions that utilize machine learning and deep learning algorithms, statistical and quantitative modeling approaches to support product, engineering and marketing initiatives.
  • Be a hands-on leader to mentor the team in the latest machine learning approaches, and to introduce new technologies and processes.
  • Partner with ML engineering leadership to design and develop scalable machine learning systems to accelerate the learning cycle.
  • Identify data science opportunities that deliver business value.
  • Formulate key areas of the ML/AI roadmap, and educate both internal and external stakeholders at all levels to drive implementation and measurement.
  • Provide thought leadership to enable ML/AI applications.
  • Develop and evangelize best practices for scoping, building, validating, deploying, and monitoring ML/AI products.
  • Prepare and present ML modeling results and analytical insights that help drive the business to senior leadership.

The Essentials

  • Masters in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, or other equivalent quantitative fields (PhD preferred)
  • 8 + years of work experience in Machine Learning, AI and Data Science with a proven track record to drive innovation and business impacts
  • Strong experience in Recommender systems, personalization systems, collaborative filtering and information retrieval systems.
  • Strong machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling expertise, such as causal inference modeling, ensembles, neural networks, NLP, reinforcement learning and bandits
  • Familiarity and experience with modern large language model based techniques for recommender systems and personalization.
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL and experience with big data platform (AWS, Snowflake, Spark, Google Cloud etc.)
  • Proficiency in machine learning and deep learning languages and platforms (Python, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch etc.)
  • Experience in deploying machine learning algorithms and advanced modeling solutions
  • Proven ability to deliver results in a fast-paced, high-energy environment
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex analysis and algorithms to non-technical audience
  • Works effectively cross functional teams to build trusted partnership
  • Working experience in digital media and entertainment industry preferred

  • Reports delays, accidents, and traffic violations.
  • Inspect bus and maintain proper levels of gas, oil, and water before departure.
  • May load or unload baggage or express checked by passengers in baggage compartment.

  • Spends a majority of the day driving a sedan or a bus.

  • Must have excellent customer service and listening skills.
  • Adheres to all safety regulations and requirements.
  • Handles stress well and gets along with others within the workplace and with customers outside the department.
