Required

  • Minimum of 2 years of real estate finance and/or investment experience at an investment bank, financial advisory or brokerage firm, private equity firm, real estate investment firm, or similar institution.
  • Advanced financial modeling and analytical capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of commercial real estate valuation, credit metrics, capital structures, and investment returns.
  • Exceptional written communication skills and experience preparing detailed investment or credit memoranda.
  • Ability to manage complex transactions, multiple workstreams, and time-sensitive deliverables.
  • High degree of accuracy, judgment, accountability, and attention to detail.

Preferred

  • Familiarity modeling office, retail, and industrial transactions via Argus Enterprise and Excel.
  • Experience underwriting and executing complex structured finance transactions.
  • Advanced experience modeling complex debt and equity investments.
  • Experience preparing institutional-quality investment committee materials.
  • Experience in US-based bankruptcy and restructuring transactions is valued but not required.
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude is highly beneficial.

  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and data‑driven decision‑making skills

You must show how you meet the basic qualifications listed above in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education sections of the application. Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT.

title: Principal System Architecture
description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Your New Role:

The Principal, Systems Automation reports to the Sr Director, Application Engineering – Converged AdTech & Linear Systems and leads the architecture for WBD’s most critical advertising technology platforms. This role owns and drives the systems automation architecture of core adtech platforms to improve scalability, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency across the ecosystem. This role is accountable for the architecture, scalability, and operational excellence of systems spanning converged planning, linear and digital advertising, scheduling, and affiliate distribution. By architecting the platform rationalization, cloud migration, and next-generation AI/ML-enabled capabilities, the Principal ensures WBD’s ad-tech stack is positioned to maximize monetization, enable automation, and deliver premium advertising experiences across all platforms.

Your Role Accountabilities:

‑Driven & Agentic Systems Automation: Lead the design and implementation of enterprise‑scale automation leveraging AI and agentic architectures, including autonomous and human‑in‑the‑loop agents that orchestrate deployments, infrastructure lifecycle management, incident response, and operational workflows across large‑scale adtech systems, with strong focus on reliability, governance, observability, and measurable efficiency gains.

Solution Design & Technical Delivery
Partner with product, data science, infrastructure, privacy, and platform teams to ensure architecture aligns with business, regulatory, and performance requirements. Identify and resolve architectural bottlenecks impacting scale, latency, throughput, and availability

Engineering Execution
Review and approve high‑impact design decisions; provide hands-on technical leadership for complex initiatives. Influence engineering execution without direct authority through technical credibility and clear communication

Innovation and mentorship
Mentor senior engineers and architects on system design and tradeoff analysis. Evaluate and introduce technologies related to streaming, storage, orchestration, observability, and resiliency

Qualifications & Experience

· Systems Architecture Leadership: 15+ years of experience architecting and scaling enterprise-grade data platforms, with a proven track record in large-scale ingestion, transformation, and activation pipelines.

· Automation Expertise: Experience automating high‑availability, high‑throughput production environments, leveraging AI and agentic architectures.

· Distributed Data Expertise: Advanced knowledge of open data Lakehouse formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi), distributed compute frameworks (Spark, Flink, Presto), and streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub).

· Cloud & Modern Architecture: Hands-on expertise in cloud-native data design (AWS, GCP, Azure), microservices, APIs, and serverless architectures; demonstrated success in modernizing legacy platforms into modular, cost-efficient systems.

· Identity & Audience Platforms: Familiarity with identity resolution, audience graphs, and cross-platform measurement systems in media, advertising, or adjacent high-scale transaction domains.

· Engineering Excellence: Deep knowledge of data engineering best practices, CI/CD automation, observability, data lineage, and governance frameworks that ensure reliability and compliance.

· Performance & Optimization: Skilled in cost modeling, benchmarking, and optimizing large-scale distributed systems for throughput, latency, and cost efficiency.

· Industry Awareness: Strong grasp of emerging trends in ad-tech, programmatic ecosystems, ML/AI-driven data products, and privacy-first architectures (GDPR, CCPA, VPPA).

· Partnerships & Ecosystem: Experienced in leading technical evaluations, vendor integrations, and collaborations with third-party data providers, cloud platforms, and open-source communities.

· Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline required

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

title: Lead Rad Tech - Surgery
description:
This position provides leadership in the imaging department to ensure consistent high-quality standards of care and patient outcomes. Maintain a positive working relationship with other department leaders, OR staff, providers, and additional ancillary services. This position provides direct care, coordinates the daily activities, and role models professional practice and customer service behaviors. The primary function of this position will be for OR needs but will step in for other imaging staff and leaders whenever necessary. This position is full-time 0.8 position, 8 hour shifts Monday - Thursday within the hours of 645 am and 715 pm with rotating call evenings, weekends and holidays.

Provides leadership in the Imaging department to ensure consistent high-quality standards of care and patient outcomes. This position provides direct care, coordinates the daily activities, and role models professional practice and customer service behaviors.

Specific duties are determined by the work setting or patient population served; however, in all positions, serving patients with challenging and complex conditions requires a concentration of specialized staff able to work in highly coordinated teams. We organize care around each patient’s condition which requires staff at multiple levels and across many departments to exhibit exceptional teamwork qualities including communicating efficiently and effectively and adopting the behaviors required for high functioning integrated teams.

Compensation & Benefits

The hourly wage for this opportunity is $31.36/hour to $45.44/hour. Pay is dependent on several factors including number of hours worked within the field, education, and certification/licensure. Hourly pay just one part of the compensation package for employees. Gillette supports career progression and offers a competitive benefits package that includes a retirement savings match, tuition and certification reimbursement, paid time off, and health and wellness benefits.

Primary Job Responsibilities

Utilize Information

  • Finds, effectively uses, and provides information. Readily adjust to shifting priorities and work assignments.
  • Maintains effective operation of timely and efficient imaging services, coordinating staff to match patient flow.
  • Provides support and serves as a technical resource regarding imaging exam details, image quality, imaging systems and equipment.
  • Monitors and holds staff and providers accountable for timely and accurate documentation of patient care.

Accurate and Efficient Work

  • Demonstrates accuracy, efficiency, and completeness in products and processes. Performs tasks with appropriate urgency and accuracy while reducing waste through proactive time management.
  • Functions competently and efficiently as an Imaging Technologist.
  • Takes initiative and follow-up as needed.
  • Respect others’ priorities and meet urgent requests whenever possible.
  • Effectively manages time, adhering to department attendance policy.
  • Demonstrates flexibility in rotating service assignments to meet various customer needs as requested by leadership.
  • Patient and family needs supersede other activities; respond to patient/family requests for information and assistance in a timely, courteous manner, with respect for professional boundaries and ethical conduct. Keeps families informed of delays.
  • Ensures imaging equipment is operational, troubleshoot equipment issues and oversee service and preventative maintenance to resolution. Works with leadership to ensure quality control testing, and regulatory mandates are met or exceeded.

Active Engagement

  • Active involvement in committees, task forces, meetings and the work of the department or work group.
  • Integrates high ethical standards and core values into everyday work activity.
  • Actively represents the department and disseminates information and decisions to colleagues and peers.
  • Effectively communicates pertinent patient information to ensure continuity is maintained.
  • Identifies and/or investigates the potential impact on users, workflow, and existing systems as new equipment, systems, and upgrades are considered or implemented.

Staff Management

  • Holds staff accountable for expectations. Addresses performance issues promptly and corrects poor performance. Enables employees to grow and succeed through feedback, instruction, and encouragement.
  • Collaborates with other Lead Technologists, support cross-training and utilization of staff appropriately across modalities.
  • Actively participates in staff meetings.
  • Contributes to an environment conducive to the education of health care professionals.

Setting Expectations

  • Sets clear, meaningful, challenging, and attainable individual and group goals and expectations that are aligned with those of the organization.
  • Provides oversight to ensure images meet the expectations of the ordering physicians and radiologists.
  • Ensures accountability through the use of quality dashboards and promotes transparency through reporting of near misses and medical errors.
  • Provides meaningful feedback to staff and peers.
  • Coordinates, collaborates, negotiates within the Imaging leadership team to positively resolve issues and work towards attainment of the team and organization goals.

Qualifications

Required

  • Experience in one or more of the modalities within area(s) of responsibility
  • Current ARRT and CPR certification
  • Graduate of an accredited school or equivalent certification

Preferred

  • Bachelors degree in imaging, management, or other healthcare related discipline
  • Active involvement in professional associations
  • Experience with pediatric and/or disabled populations


At Gillette Children’s, we foster a culture where every team member feels a sense of belonging and purpose. We act first from love, embrace the bigger picture, and work side-by-side with our patients, families, and colleagues to help every child create their own story. Together, we work to ensure patients of all backgrounds and abilities reach their full potential.

Gillette Children's is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of an individual's race, color, creed, sex, religion, national origin, age, disability, marital status, familial status, genetic information, status with regard to public assistance, sexual orientation or gender identity, military status or any other class protected by federal, state or local laws.

Gillette Children’s is a global beacon of care for patients with brain, bone and movement conditions that start in childhood. Our research, treatment and supportive technologies enable every child to lead a full life defined by their dreams, not their diagnoses.

title: Strategic Account Director
description:
At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!

What We Do…

We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online - quickly and simply.

We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.

And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 50,000 hotels in 150+ countries - with over 130 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.

About the Strategic Account Director role...

The Enterprise team at SiteMinder is responsible for the Groups & Chains segment. We manage collections and portfolios of hotel brands as well as multi-property operators, and provide a suite of technology solutions to the Groups, including some of the largest hotel groups in the world.

The core focus of this role is to establish and grow SiteMinder’s enterprise business throughout Asia, by creating new partnerships and unlocking growth within existing accounts, with special attention to the East Asia markets.

In an individual contributor role, you will be joining an established and highly-performing team. You will assume responsibility for new revenue generation through acquisition of new Groups & Chains and by fostering excellent relationships with existing clients in the region.

You will be an experienced commercial operator and a strategic thinker, with a background in software-as-a-service business development, strategic partnership management, or a similar senior commercial profile with strong business acumen and creative problem solving skills.

What you'll do...

  • Active listening: deep understanding of customer goals, strategy and long term objectives, to formulate plans to unlock new revenue opportunities and solutions that deliver against customer buying needs

  • Consultative selling: you will hold a creative and ambitious talent for driving new business and strategically managing customer solutions, demonstrating an in depth understanding of revenue management and hotel technology

  • Hyper collaboration: working with multiple teams and stakeholders to create a winning strategy for unlocking growth, ensuring SiteMinder is the preferred partner for Groups & Chains in the region.

  • Stakeholder management: influencing and liaising with variety of internal stakeholders, across multiple departments (Product solutioning, Onboarding, Support, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Support, Customer Success)

  • Proactive engagement: implementing plans to increase product adoption, service satisfaction, product updates and customer feedback

  • Protection of revenue by ensuring customers are committed to term agreements and managing the contract renewal process

  • Travel requirements: regular travel within the region to attend trade shows, conferences and Quarterly Business Reviews with high value accounts

What you have...

  • Hotel or travel industry experience: in-depth understanding of the hospitality/hotel industry and the travel technology landscape, as well as the infrastructure of large hotel groups

  • Experience in SaaS sales or product/technology partnership management: you will have solid experience in consultative selling to C-level personas within a technology or hospitality-travel technology business

  • Proven track record in closing >$1m new business

  • Strong communication skills to build rapport and trusted, long-term relationships with customers

  • Ability to bring together multiple stakeholders internally and externally to match buying authority and knowledge sets

  • Excellent negotiation skills to overcome objections and navigate complex buying structures to influence multiple buying identities

  • Consultative approach to solution sell, and present as a subject matter expert in the hospitality technology field

  • Creative problem-solving skills and ability to manage expectations

  • Highly resilient self starter, operating well independently, with positive attitude to winning deals

  • Proactive and tenacious at unlocking opportunities

  • Language requirements: Fluent in English, additional languages - Mandarin and/or Cantonese

Our Perks & Benefits…

- Equity packages (cash bonus) for you to be a part of the SiteMinder journey

- Remote working model

- Mental health and well-being initiatives

- Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy

- Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year

- Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations

- Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved

- Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement

Does this job sound like you? If yes, we'd love for you to be part of our team! Please send a copy of your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any adjustments you may need during the interview process. We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.

title: Data Analytics Engineer
description: We’re looking for a Data Analytics Engineer to join our Data team and help us shape the data ecosystem in the company. title: Field Services Technician (Early Career Program)
description:

Responsibilities

title: Medical Science Liaison Neurosciences
description:
Job Description Summary

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) Neurosciences serves as a scientific ambassador for Novartis, facilitating high-quality, peer-to-peer scientific exchange with Healthcare Professionals (HCPs), Medical Experts (MEs), investigators, and key stakeholders within the Neurosciences therapeutic area. This field-based role is responsible for building trusted scientific partnerships, generating and communicating medical insights, supporting evidence generation, and contributing to the development and execution of the local medical strategy.

The MSL acts as the bridge between the external medical community and internal cross-functional teams, ensuring that patient needs, scientific advancements, and healthcare system insights inform medical strategy and enhance patient outcomes.


Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

Scientific Engagement & External Partnerships

  • Establish and maintain credible scientific relationships with Medical Experts (MEs), investigators, and key healthcare stakeholders in Neurosciences.
  • Ensure appropriate identification, mapping, and prioritization of Key Accounts across the territory.
  • Develop and execute strategic ME engagement plans aligned with country and therapeutic area priorities.
  • Conduct compliant, evidence-based scientific exchange regarding disease state management, clinical data, and Novartis therapies.
  • Identify opportunities to engage MEs when specific medical needs, scientific questions, or evidence gaps are recognized.

Medical Insights & Strategic Contribution

  • Gather, analyze, and communicate actionable medical insights from external stakeholders.
  • Inform and help shape local medical strategy by translating field insights into meaningful recommendations.
  • Provide perspective on emerging scientific trends, unmet patient needs, treatment paradigms, and healthcare system dynamics within Neurosciences.
  • Collaborate with Medical Affairs and cross-functional teams to support launch readiness and lifecycle management activities.

Clinical Research Support

  • Support Novartis-sponsored clinical research programs through identification and engagement of appropriate investigators and study sites.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Operations to optimize trial execution and investigator engagement.
  • Provide scientific and educational support to potential and active research sites.
  • Facilitate the Investigator-Initiated Trial (IIT) process in response to investigator requests, following company policies and compliance requirements.

Scientific Education & Internal Support

  • Serve as a scientific resource for disease area and product-related training for matrix field teams and internal stakeholders.
  • Deliver scientific updates and support interpretation of clinical evidence for cross-functional partners.
  • Participate in scientific conferences, congresses, advisory boards, and educational activities to maintain awareness of the evolving Neurosciences landscape.

Compliance & Quality

  • Respond appropriately to unsolicited requests for medical and scientific information from healthcare professionals.
  • Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with Novartis Ethics, Risk & Compliance (ERC) standards and applicable regulations.
  • Report technical complaints, adverse events, and special situation cases related to Novartis products within 24 hours of awareness.
  • Support the distribution of marketing samples where applicable and permitted by local regulations.

Minimum Requirements

Education

  • Advanced scientific degree required:
    • MD, or equivalent in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, Neuroscience, or related field.

Experience

  • Minimum 2-5 years of experience in Medical Affairs, clinical research, scientific engagement, healthcare practice, or a related healthcare environment.
  • Previous MSL experience preferred.
  • Experience within Neurosciences, Neurology, Psychiatry, Multiple Sclerosis, Neuroimmunology, or other relevant therapeutic areas strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting clinical research activities and investigator interactions is desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage in high-quality scientific discussions with healthcare professionals and medical experts.

Technical & Functional Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of clinical research principles and evidence generation.
  • Ability to interpret and communicate complex clinical and scientific data.
  • Strong medical insight generation and stakeholder engagement capabilities.
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and scientific storytelling skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a matrix organization and influence without direct authority.
  • Strong planning, prioritization, and territory management skills.

Languages

  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)


Skills Desired

Biostatistics, Brainstorming, Clinical Research, Clinical Study Reports, Disease Management, Drug Development, Key Account Management, Medical Information, Medical Research, Medical Writing, Microsoft Exchange Server, Patient Care

title: Faculty Clinical Coordinator - Surgical Technology
description:

This position will initially cover clinical acquisitions for Orlando and Tampa and include an online teaching assignment with some lab space setup as campus locations have them in place.

The Faculty Clinical Coordinator for Surgical Technology will ensure that a minimum of one clinical preceptor must be designated at each recognized clinical setting. Ensure all assigned preceptors meet the credentialing requirements of assigned facilities and that all required documentation is maintained according to Herzing University Policy. The coordinator implements and teaches an orientation program for all clinical preceptors to ensure that program outcomes are being met.   • Associate's degree in related discipline, Bachelor's degree in related discipline preferred.

  • Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to convey ideas effectively to individuals and groups.

Clinical Coordination Duties:

  • Identify, select, contract with, monitor, and evaluate all clinical sites. Maintain site selection criteria and contract documentation in support of competency requirements.

title: Senior Study Lead, Cell and Gene Therapy
description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Laboratory Setting, Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)

Job Description

Senior Study Lead

Department: Cell and Gene Therapy

Location: Middleton, Wisconsin

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

Our PPD® Laboratory Services team has a direct impact on improving patient health through the expertise of scientists, industry thought-leaders and therapeutic experts. As the world leader in serving science, our laboratory professionals bring their commitment to accuracy and quality to deliver groundbreaking innovations.

Role Overview

The Senior Study Lead is responsible for overseeing and managing multiple complex or large-scale routine projects (release, stability or quality control), ensuring seamless interaction with clients and internal leadership to communicate project updates, milestones, and strategic priorities. This role delivers high-quality outputs, conducts thorough reviews and evaluations of data, and prepares comprehensive protocols and reports.

The Senior Study Lead is accountable for managing quality records and ensuring strict adherence to regulatory guidelines and scientific standards for routine testing, including release, stability, and quality control projects. The Senior Study Lead holds decision-making authority for routine investigations, deviations, and risk-based assessments, ensuring scientifically sound and compliant outcomes. Leveraging extensive knowledge of laboratory systems, regulatory guidelines, and quality requirements, the Senior Study Lead provides expert oversight of routine testing, supports data trend evaluation, and proactively identifies risks or improvement opportunities. This role actively collaborates with cross-functional teams, including internal stakeholders, quality assurance, and SMEs, to align on project goals and drive successful outcomes.

The Senior Study Lead also mentors Study Lead team members and analysts, fosters audit readiness, and contributes to a culture of continuous improvement, scientific excellence, and ethical conduct. This role is accountable for driving routine study delivery, documentation, and client alignment, but may consult with Staff Scientist + for scientific conclusions on method-related decisions as well as overall study quality, client satisfaction, and successful delivery of complex or high-impact programs beyond individual project execution, and serves as a primary escalation point for complex technical and client-related issues associated with routine testing.

What you will do:

  • Independently draft and/or approve detailed and comprehensive technical documents, perform meticulous data/report reviews, and provide constructive feedback and guidance to Study Lead to ensure high-quality deliverables.

  • Design and manage robust project study plans and complex program strategies, ensuring technical accuracy, high-quality outcomes, and alignment with client expectations and business objectives.

  • Proactively identify solutions for technical challenges associated with routine testing, develop innovative and effective solutions, and mentor scientists in advanced problem-solving methods to enhance overall project outcomes.

  • Identify and eliminate obstacles, develop strategic improvement plans, and continuously identify opportunities to optimize laboratory processes and project efficiency.

  • Lead and oversee the execution and coordination of routine projects using established methods.

  • Identify improvement opportunities and collaborate with internal stakeholders to evaluate and implement changes.

  • Hold decision-making authority for routine investigations, deviations, and risk-based assessments, ensuring scientifically sound, compliant, and well-documented outcomes.

  • Communicate complex technical information concisely and effectively with clients, lead technical visits and discussions, and prepare for audits or site visits to ensure compliance and client satisfaction.

  • Lead audit readiness efforts by ensuring studies, documentation, and processes are inspection-ready; serve as a key contact during audits and drive resolution of audit observations, including CAPAs and systemic improvements.

  • Review and/or approve client deliverable documents including routine protocols, reports, and quality records to ensure quality and compliance.

  • Develop and evaluate technical Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), collaborate closely with clients and internal stakeholders to drive continuous improvement, and ensure alignment with project goals and regulatory standards.

  • Support comprehensive contract reviews, evaluate scientific proposals with a critical eye, provide well-informed recommendations, and accurately estimate resource needs to support project planning and execution.

  • Train and mentor Study Lead and other staff on compliance, audit readiness, and unbiased problem-solving techniques, promote ethical behavior and integrity, and actively support continuous improvement initiatives to foster a culture of excellence.

  • Accountable for overall study quality, data integrity, and compliance across assigned programs, ensuring alignment with GMP, regulatory requirements, and internal standards.

Key Requirements

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.

  • Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 8+ years experience) or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Advanced knowledge of routine analytical testing, instrumentation, and laboratory systems, with the ability to troubleshoot established methods.

  • Strong understanding and application of regulatory requirements (e.g., GMP, FDA guidelines), with the ability to advise on compliance and risk mitigation strategies.

  • Expertise in data evaluation, including trend analysis, outlier detection, and interpretation of complex data sets to support scientific and operational decisions.

  • Demonstrated leadership in managing multiple complex or large-scale routine projects, balancing priorities, resolving conflicts, and meeting challenging deadlines.

  • Highly proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint), with functional skills in Power BI for data visualization and reporting.

  • Skilled in the use of laboratory information management systems (LIMS) and data collection software relevant to analytical testing environments.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft high-quality technical documents and clearly communicate complex scientific information to clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Strong technical writing skills, including authorship and/or review of protocols, reports, and quality records.

  • Ability to conduct root cause analyses, lead investigations, and develop effective corrective and preventive action plans.

  • Demonstrated capability to train, mentor, and coach junior staff and Study Lead team members, fostering problem-solving, audit readiness, and compliance awareness.

  • Proven ability to identify and implement process improvements, drive innovation, and support continuous improvement initiatives across routine testing operations.

  • Strong attention to detail, data integrity, and documentation practices in compliance with internal SOPs and external regulatory standards.

  • Ability to build and maintain positive relationships with internal teams and clients, manage expectations, and influence project outcomes through collaboration and trust.

  • Demonstrated ability to give and receive constructive feedback in a professional and solutions-oriented manner.

  • High level of integrity and confidentiality, with a consistent focus on ethical behavior, scientific rigor, and quality.

Work Environment

Thermo Fisher Scientific values the health and wellbeing of our employees. We support and encourage individuals to create a healthy and balanced environment where they can thrive. Below is listed the working environment/requirements for this role:

  • Able to communicate, receive, and understand information and ideas with diverse groups of people in a comprehensible and reasonable manner.

  • Able to work upright and stationary and/or standing for typical working hours.

  • Able to lift and move objects up to 25 pounds.

  • Able to work in non-traditional work environments.

  • Able to use and learn standard office equipment and technology with proficiency.

  • May have exposure to potentially hazardous elements, including infectious agents, typically found in healthcare or laboratory environments.

  • Able to perform successfully under pressure while prioritizing and handling multiple projects or activities.

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory with PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today!

The ideal candidate must possess an extensive professional chronology demonstrating roughly 7+ years of continuous federal management experience. This timeline should showcase strong operational leadership managing integrated schedules, deliverable registers, and contractor personnel within highly secured federal parameters.
This expert will maintain close, hands-on control over multidisciplinary technical teams delivering recurring production metrics, risk tracking registers, and quality-control coordination.

title: Accelerated Engineering Development Track
description:
Williams is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected under applicable discrimination law.

Solving Global Energy Challenges Starts Here

A career in energy has never been more important—or more rewarding. At Williams, we're looking for exceptional engineers who are ready to accelerate their development, embrace challenges, and make a meaningful impact from day one.

Our Early Career Engineer Development Track is a rigorous, accelerated program designed for high-performing engineering graduates who thrive in fast-paced, high-expectation environments. This elite development experience provides unparalleled exposure to our business, operations, and leadership while preparing participants to solve complex engineering challenges across critical energy infrastructure.

Through hands-on project work, structured learning, challenging assignments, and direct exposure to our operations, you'll build the technical and business capabilities needed to succeed in a demanding industry. You'll be expected to learn quickly, take ownership, and deliver results while living Williams' values of being collaborative, courageous, creative, and competitive.

Program Overview

Our 12-month development track is intentionally designed to accelerate the growth of top engineering talent through immersive onboarding, real-world project experience, and continuous professional development. This highly structured and rigorous program challenges participants to develop both technical depth and business acumen while contributing to projects that directly impact Williams' operations and long-term success.

Your journey begins at our corporate headquarters in Tulsa, Oklahoma, where you will participate in an intensive 6-week onboarding experience focused on:

  • Building advanced professional and technical capabilities
  • Developing business, commercial, and financial acumen
  • Strengthening communication, collaboration, and leadership skills
  • Enhancing analytical and technical proficiency, including data analysis and Excel
  • Gaining firsthand exposure to field operations through immersive site experiences
  • Developing the resilience and adaptability required to succeed in a dynamic and high-accountability industry

Participants will be expected to engage fully, demonstrate intellectual curiosity, and perform in a learning environment with high standards and expectations.

Following onboarding, you'll be placed on a project assignment aligned with business priorities and your skills, where you'll contribute to meaningful, high-impact work while continuing to expand your capabilities through real-world application. Most of these assignments will be home-based in Tulsa, Oklahoma, Houston, TX, with significant field travel or at a field location. If relocation is required, Williams will provide relocation assistance to support your move. Start dates for this role are either January 25, 2027 or June 14, 2027.

Program Benefits

  • Company-provided housing during onboarding in Tulsa
  • Relocation assistance for project assignments, as applicable
  • Opportunities to work in both office and field environments across the United States
  • Exposure to senior leaders, cross-functional teams, and critical business initiatives
  • Accelerated development and career growth opportunities for top performers

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Construction Science
  • Graduate in December 2026 or May 2027
  • This position is not eligible for sponsorship (including OPT/CPT)
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
  • Willingness and ability to relocate within the United States as business needs require

What You'll Do

  • Collaborate to Deliver Results - Partner with cross-functional teams to support safe, reliable, and efficient operations while contributing to high-priority business objectives
  • Deliver Impact in Challenging Environments - Work in field and office settings that demand sound judgment, adaptability, and accountability. Travel to project sites as needed to support critical initiatives and operational excellence
  • Solve Complex Problems - Apply engineering principles, analytical thinking, and creativity to address challenging technical and operational issues with real-world business impact
  • Demonstrate Courageous Leadership - Take initiative, speak up with ideas, challenge assumptions, and drive continuous improvement in support of team and company success
  • Perform with Excellence - Operate in an environment characterized by high expectations, continuous learning, and a commitment to delivering exceptional results
  • Learn the Business - Develop a comprehensive understanding of Williams' operations, infrastructure, customers, and strategic priorities
  • Communicate with Impact - Present technical information, recommendations, and project outcomes clearly and confidently to diverse audiences
  • Own Your Development - Seek feedback, embrace challenges, and continually expand your technical and professional capabilities

What Makes Someone Successful in This Program

Top performers in this program are:

  • Highly motivated and intellectually curious
  • Resilient and adaptable in fast-paced, demanding environments
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and solving complex problems
  • Strong communicators who build relationships across teams
  • Self-starters with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Driven to achieve results while maintaining a commitment to safety and operational excellence
  • Energized by challenge and continuous improvement

Preferred Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a collaborative mindset
  • Ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities
  • Demonstrated initiative and willingness to take on stretch assignments
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into actionable business insights
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; engineering software experience is a plus
  • Strong commitment to safety as a core value
  • FE Certification preferred

Educational Assistance

We believe exceptional talent deserves exceptional development opportunities. Williams invests in your continued growth through educational assistance, professional certifications, and learning opportunities that support your long-term success and help you build expertise throughout your career.


Pay:

Compensation is a salaried rate determined by degree type:

  • Bachelor's degree candidate = $100,000
  • Master's degree candidate = $110,000

Why Tulsa?

Because here, you don’t have to choose between career and lifestyle. Tulsa is a growing hub for innovation and energy, paired with a vibrant arts scene, great food, and a cost of living that actually lets you enjoy it all. Think shorter commutes, bigger impact and a community that feels like home from day one. Check out to learn more.


We invest in our people in ways that actually show up in your day-to-day, not just on paper. Our Total Rewards are built to support how you work, live, and plan for what’s next.


Here’s a look at what that means:


  • Strong pay plus an annual incentive program
  • Hybrid work for most office roles, plus real flexibility in many field positions
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with options that fit your life, not the other way around
  • 401(k) with company match and an annual company contribution
  • Paid time off, including company and floating holidays
  • Paid parental leave (up to six weeks per parent), plus fertility and adoption support
  • Advanced AI tools and resources to help level up and work smarter

  • Tuition reimbursement and support for continuing education
  • HSA and FSA options
  • Company-paid life insurance and disability coverage
  • Employee stock purchase plan
  • Domestic partner benefits
  • Employee resource groups, wellness support, paid volunteer time, and company matching for causes you care about

For more information, please visit Total Rewards | Williams Companies.

description:
characteristics

about us

velpTEC is an education institute focused on innovative technologies, combining experience from business, future studies, and new educational approaches. Through our educational offerings, we support people in strengthening their skills for the future in a practice-oriented way, helping them actively shape their own paths in life – and from 2027 onward, also in higher education.
VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung) is a private university of applied sciences currently undergoing the process of state recognition through the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture. Our degree programs are launching in the fields of digital technologies, engineering, and innovation-driven management – with a clear commitment to continuously expanding our portfolio and responding to new developments. We understand teaching as a space for shaping solutions for tomorrow. Our approach is project-based, competency-oriented, and closely interlinked with practice. We are looking for individuals who are eager to break new ground in higher education and want to actively help shape our innovative learning environment.

We are filling a W2-Professorship in Digital, Generative and Immersive Design (100 %).

your responsibilities

  • Program development: Contributing to the development of the Bachelor's program in Future Design and Immersive Systems, and assisting in recruiting students
  • Masterclasses and expert seminars: Conducting live sessions on generative AI in design, AI-assisted workflows, 3D design and immersive technologies in English
  • Student supervision and examination formats: Providing academic guidance, mentoring, and support for project and research work; designing and evaluating portfolio assessments, exams, and bachelor's theses
  • Applied research: Conducting practice-oriented research and transfer projects in the areas of generative AI in design, immersive technologies, and creative coding – in cooperation with industry and research institutions
  • Funding and cooperation: Initiating research collaborations and acquiring third-party funding to strengthen applied research at our university
  • Publications and presentations: Publishing research findings in academic journals and at relevant conferences, as well as representing the university at specialist presentations and industry events
  • Transfer: Willingness to participate in research-related product developments, founding/start-up ventures, and patent applications
  • University development: Contributing to the university's academic self-governance, helping to further develop the range of study programs, and participating in international collaboration

recruitment and qualification requirements

The recruitment requirements for professors are governed by § 25 of the Lower Saxony Higher Education Act (NHG):
  • A completed university degree
  • Pedagogical-didactic aptitude confirmed through practical experience
  • Special aptitude for in-depth independent scholarly work, generally evidenced by an above-average doctorate in the fields of design, media technology, computer science or related fields
  • Special achievements in the application or development of scientific findings and methods over at least five years of professional practice, of which at least three years must have been carried out outside the higher education sector – preferably in digital design, generative AI, 3D, or immersive media roles in industry

in addition, we assume

  • The ability and willingness to conduct teaching, research, and transfer activities in English.
  • Willingness to develop and further build higher education teaching competencies – particularly in (generative) AI-supported teaching.

in addition, we value

  • Innovative spirit in teaching: Motivation to develop and apply new didactic formats in digital, generative and immersive design education
  • Interdisciplinary openness: Readiness to collaborate with colleagues in applied computing and AI, digital business transformation, and immersive design
  • Practice and transfer orientation: Proven experience in industry or research projects related to generative AI and immersive design technologies
  • International perspective: Experience in international contexts or motivation to integrate international digital and immersive design projects into teaching and research.
  • Commitment to institutional development: Willingness to actively shape the foundation and growth of a new university
  • Research profile: A visible research focus in generative AI in design, immersive media, or creative coding
  • Knowledge and technology transfer: Understanding research as a bridge between science, industry, and society

what we offer

  • The opportunity to shape the development of a new university and its programmes right from its foundation.
  • A professorship with a clear focus on teaching, quality assurance, and applied research.
  • Interdisciplinary collaboration with colleagues in applied computing and AI, digital business transformation, and immersive design.
  • Modern digital infrastructure and an innovative environment without outdated structures.
  • Collaboration with the Center for Higher Education Teaching (Kompetenzzentrum Lehre) at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg on the development of higher education teaching competencies.
  • Fully remote from Germany or abroad (German working hours) or hybrid from Hanover, Munich or Leipzig
  • Flexible working hours with core working hours – medical appointments, childcare, and other important commitments are no problem
  • Fixed salary + performance-based bonus + €100 per month (for full-time employees) towards a company pension plan after 6 months + 15% employer contribution to your own payments + attractive employee discounts
  • 1 additional day of paid leave per year for volunteering
  • Annual health budget of €600 (for full-time employees) after 6 months + access to more than 13,000 fitness and wellness facilities through EGYM Wellpass
  • Regular team events and shared experiences
  • Plenty of autonomy, varied responsibilities, and a culture that encourages new ideas and innovation

application documents and further information

  • The following application documents are expected; mandatory documents are marked with *:

    • *CV (including an overview of previous employment since your first university degree, providing information on subject-related and application-oriented professional experience relevant to the advertised professorship; supporting documents such as employment references are welcome)
    • *Final certificate from the last general education school attended
    • *Certificates and/or diplomas for academic degrees (e.g., diploma, bachelor's, master's, doctorate)
    • *List of teaching activities
    • *Evidence of pedagogical-didactic aptitude (e.g., certificates for higher education teaching training, evaluation results of courses taught, teaching-related awards or scholarships)
    • *List of research activities

For your cover letter, use the "Anschreiben" upload; for your CV, use the "Lebenslauf" upload; and for your employment references, use the "Arbeitszeugnis" upload. For all other documents, please use the "Andere" upload.

title: EMT 12
description:
Full-Time

12:00pm - 12:00am

JOB SUMMARY

To provide a 24-hour emergency and non-emergency ambulance service with state approved personnel. Secondary duties to maintain up to date knowledge of Missouri Laws governing ambulances and personnel. Supportive of the Village’s mission, values, and service/hospitality (PRIDE) expectations. Completes training as required by policy.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
  • Administers basic life support to and transports sick or injured persons to medical facility, working as member of emergency medical team.
  • Responds to instructions from dispatcher and drives specifically equipped emergency vehicle to specified location.
  • Monitors communication equipment to maintain contact with dispatcher.
  • Removes or assists in removal of victims from scene of accident or catastrophe.
  • Determines nature and extent of illness or injury, magnitude of catastrophe, follows medical protocols or determines need for additional assistance, bases decisions on statements of persons involved, examination of victim(s) and knowledge of emergency medical practice.
  • Administers prescribed basic life support at site of emergency or in specially equipped vehicle performing such activities as application of splints, administration of oxygen, treatment of minor wounds or abrasions, administration of artificial resuscitation.
  • Communicates with professional medical personnel at emergency treatment facility to obtain instructions regarding further treatment and arrange for reception of victims at treatment facility.
  • Assists treatment center admitting personnel to obtain and record information related to victim’s vital statistics and circumstances of emergency.
  • Maintains vehicles and medical and communication equipment and replenishes first-aid equipment and supplies.
  • May assist professional medical personnel in emergency treatment administered at medical facility.
  • Adheres to all safety regulations and requirements.
  • Handles stress well and gets along with others within the workplace and with customers outside the department.
  • Maintains acceptable standards of workplace conduct.

The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an individual to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

  • This position requires the level of education typically acquired by a course of study leading to a high school diploma or GED.

Licenses/Certifications:

  • Missouri State EMT-B and CPR Certifications required.
  • Missouri Class E driver’s license or equivalent.

Knowledge and Skills (required unless otherwise noted):

  • Basic level keyboarding skills required.
  • Must maintain CEU hours required by current EMT and CPR certifications.
  • Experience with investigations of incidents and conflicts.
  • Experience using an ambulance.
  • Experience using an oxygen tank, air ways, suction equipment, respirator, and heart monitor.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating instructions, handbooks, and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients, and other associates of the organization.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Excellent customer service skills required.

Special working conditions

  • The associate is subject to both inside and outside environmental conditions. The associate is subject to extreme cold temperatures typically below 32 degrees and extreme heat above 100 degrees for periods of more than one hour.
  • The associate is subject to sufficient noise to cause the associate to shout in order to be heard above the ambient noise level.
  • The associate is subject to vibration of the extremities or whole body.
  • The associate is subject to hazards such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electrical current, working on scaffolding and high places, exposure to high heat or exposure to chemicals.
  • The associate is subject to atmospheric conditions that affect the respiratory system of the skin: Fumes, odors, dusts, mists, gases, or poor ventilation.
  • The associate is subject to air and/or skin exposure to oils and other cutting fluids.
  • The associate frequently is in close quarters, crawl spaces, shafts, manholes, small enclosed rooms, small sewage and water line pipes, and other areas which could cause claustrophobia.
  • The associate is required to function in narrow aisles or passageways.
  • The associate is exposed to infectious diseases.
  • The associate is required to function around individuals with challenged mental capacities.
  • All associates may be called upon to assist other departments in a declared emergency situation.

Physical and Mental Demands

title: CISA - Telecommunications Network Analyst
description:
Telecommunications Network Analyst (TS/SCI) — Critical Infrastructure

Location: Arlington, VA (on-site at federal facilities)
Clearance: Active Top Secret/SCI security clearance
Citizenship: U.S. citizenship required
Position Type: Full-time

About the Role

cFocus Software Incorporated is seeking a Telecommunications Network Analyst to serve as the domain authority on a TS/SCI-cleared team analyzing the nation's most critical communications infrastructure — including undersea cable systems, the Public Switched Network, and next-generation converged networks — for DHS CISA. Your analyses will directly inform how the Government assesses availability, resilience, and risk to national security and emergency preparedness (NS/EP) communications.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute studies evaluating the physical and logical characteristics of national and international communications infrastructure under a range of operational scenarios
  • Assess the availability, resilience, and performance of communications systems supporting NS/EP requirements, and quantify the benefits of proposed enhancements or mitigations
  • Conduct studies of Internet and network architecture relevant to undersea cable infrastructure, including next-generation networks that converge packet-switched and circuit-switched technologies
  • Evaluate industry and academic datasets and analytic tools; develop or assess routing and performance metrics; analyze the viability of emerging network technologies
  • Frame and support telecommunications risk analyses addressing route diversity, Continuity of Operations (COOP), and potential impacts to Government communications during NS/EP events
  • Apply Public Switched Network (Internet, PSTN, wireless) modeling and analysis methodologies, tools, data, and procedures to Government analytic requirements
  • Conduct rapid triage on questions, issues, or events involving the nation's critical communications infrastructure
  • Interface with critical infrastructure sector representatives, industry, and external agencies for note-taking, assessment, and information gathering; represent the team in technical meetings and discussions
  • Support geospatial analyses of telecommunications infrastructure in partnership with GIS data scientists, contributing domain validation to infrastructure mapping products
  • Provide analytic support before, during, and after NS/EP events, including surge operations outside normal business hours
  • Author concise, professional-quality analytic reports, briefings, and technical assessments on formal Government review cycles

Required Qualifications

  • Active, final Top Secret/SCI clearance granted by the U.S. Government; U.S. citizenship
  • Bachelor's degree with three (3) years of specialized experience, Master's degree with one (1) year, or seven (7) years of equivalent specialized experience
  • Strong background in a telecommunications discipline (carrier networks, transport/optical systems, submarine cable systems, wireless, or internet infrastructure)
  • Specialized experience in Public Switched Network modeling and analysis — spanning Internet, PSTN, and wireless — including associated methodologies, tools, data, and procedures
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity and IT security principles as applied to communications infrastructure
  • Intermediate proficiency with the ESRI ArcGIS product suite
  • Broad expertise in research, analysis, and technical writing, with deliverables meeting formal Government acceptance standards
  • Familiarity with the National Response Framework (NRF), Emergency Support Function (ESF) #2, and applicable national cyber incident response doctrine
  • Availability for after-hours, weekend, and holiday surge support during NS/EP events

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with submarine/undersea cable systems, landing stations, or international transport networks
  • Experience with telecommunications capacity, usage, routing, or outage datasets
  • Prior support to NS/EP communications programs, priority services, national security systems, or a 24/7 operations center environment
  • Experience developing routing or network performance metrics, or evaluating emerging technologies (SDN, 5G, converged NGN architectures)
  • Experience briefing senior Government or industry audiences on technical risk topics

title: Senior Project Coordinator, EU
description:
Senior Project Coordinator, remote: Poland, Spain or Germany

﻿

The Senior Project Coordinator works with Project Managers, Clinical Trial Managers, Site Selection Team and Clinical Research Associates (CRA) to provide administrative and coordinating support for site activation activities and other site level deliverables through all phases of the clinical trial lifecycle. As a Senior Project Coordinator, you will take the lead to ensure timeframes, targets and the quality of the deliverables are in line with internal and external customer expectations. As a Senior member of the team, you work autonomously to ensure optimized site activation and maintenance and you may be asked to mentor junior project coordinators


This role will be perfect for you if:

  • You have a minimum of 2 years of experience as a Project Coordinator or equivalent position in clinical research and in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and/or CRO industry.
  • You have proven Site Start-Up experience in the management of clinical trials and/or staff in a global/multi-regional environment.…
  • You have an interest in project administration and clinical research;
  • You want to have an impact in a fast-growing company.


More specifically, the Senior Project Coordinator:

  • Prepare Investigator Sites to conduct clinical trials through the review and approval of essential clinical trial and regulatory documents.
  • Establishes site activation timelines with selected sites and coordinates activities to meet planned activation timelines.
  • Communicate with clinical sites during site start-up
  • Collaborates with other functional departments to ensure alignment of activities to meet site activation targets
  • Escalates to the Project Manager risks to site activation schedule.
  • Communicates directly with the study teams, external site staff, to ensure tasks and priorities are aligned to the defined study timelines.
  • Collects, reviews and files sites essential documents.
  • Ensures essential documentation is complete and of good quality to successfully first pass review for site activation
  • Ensures that the electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) contains the relevant regulatory documents for site activation and ongoing study management.
  • Collects and distributes documents from / to sites
  • Produces meeting minutes from project meetings.
  • Maintains ADI log.
  • Assigns documents for internal project-specific training and coordinates training reconciliation and documentation.
  • May assist with drafting of study documents and study plans for clinical trials.
  • Acts as a main point of contact for all site correspondences for non-protocol related issues.
  • Assists sites with local ethics submissions.
  • Assist internal and external teams with access to study-specific systems
  • Assist with initiating and maintaining study files.
  • Assist with assembling and shipping the Investigator’s Study File
  • Maintains project timeline dates, enrolment tracking tools, and study material inventory.
  • Prepares shipments of study supplies to clinical sites, when applicable.
  • Assists with preparation of Investigators’ Meeting
  • Distributes study correspondence to sites.
  • Serves as in-house contact to support CRAs when traveling.
  • Reviews and reconciles investigators site and vendor payments
  • Assists with project tracking activities and status reports preparation.
  • Participates in various administrative tasks as required to accomplish the goals of the project and the needs of the project team.
  • May support Health Authority inspection and pre-inspection activities.
  • May support audit preparation & Corrective Action / Preventative Action preparation for project related issues.
  • May perform project management duties on designated trials.
  • May mentor junior Project Coordinators and assist with onboarding activities.
  • May assist with process improvement and creation of training material within the Site Activation and Project Coordination department.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research or equivalent experience.
  • Specialized graduate diploma in drug development is an asset

Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Project Coordinator or equivalent position in clinical research and in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and/or CRO industry.
  • Proven Site Start-Up experience in the management of clinical trials and/or staff in a global/multi-regional environment.…

Knowledge and skills

  • Good knowledge of essential documentation requirements for clinical trials.
  • Proficiency in English (written and oral) is required.
  • Bilingual French and English or fluency in another European or Asian language is an asset.
  • Excellent knowledge and competency in Word, Excel, and Power Point.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple assignments to meet deadlines.
  • Attention to detail. • Quick learner, good adaptability and versatile.
  • Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving and multi-tasking skills.
  • Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

OUR COMPANY


﻿The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Company benefits package
  • Ongoing learning and development


﻿About Indero

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.


Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale..


Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.


Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Europe.
